items.title_en: SpaceMCP: Vision Language Model Spatial Reasoning via Model Context Protocol
items.title_zh: SpaceMCP：通过模型上下文协议实现视觉语言模型空间推理
items.abstract_en: Despite impressive advances in large language models (LLM), vision-language models (VLM) still exhibit limited spatial reasoning capabilities. Recent progress in feed-forward 3D reconstruction has enabled precise, real-time geometric understanding from visual inputs. In this work, we propose SpaceMCP, a framework that leverages these advances to introduce an MCP-style paradigm for spatial reasoning. Our approach augments a VLM with structured function calls, allowing it to query a scene graph for spatial information such as distances, object positioning, and camera properties. The scene graph is constructed in real time using feed-forward 3D reconstruction to recover metric geometry, combined with open-vocabulary segmentation to identify and localize relevant objects within the scene. Paired with the VLM's strong reasoning capabilities, the VLM is able to combine this primitive information to solve more complex spatial tasks. Without any training, SpaceMCP achieves state-of-the-art results on VSI-Bench, MMSI-Bench and VSTI-Bench, outperforming recent spatially post-trained VLMs and improving its base VLM by 15-22 points per benchmark. We argue that, given the contrast between the relatively slow progress in native VLM spatial reasoning and the rapid advances in feed-forward 3D computer vision, this paradigm offers a promising path forward for enabling robust spatial reasoning.
items.abstract_zh: 尽管大型语言模型（LLM）取得了令人瞩目的进展，视觉语言模型（VLM）的空间推理能力仍然有限。近期前馈三维重建的进展使得能够从视觉输入中进行精确、实时的几何理解。在这项工作中，我们提出 SpaceMCP，一个利用这些进展引入 MCP 风格空间推理范式的框架。我们的方法通过结构化函数调用增强 VLM，使其能够查询场景图以获取空间信息，如距离、物体定位和相机属性。场景图使用前馈三维重建实时构建，以恢复度量几何，并结合开放词汇分割来识别和定位场景中的相关物体。结合 VLM 强大的推理能力，VLM 能够组合这些基元信息来解决更复杂的空间任务。无需任何训练，SpaceMCP 在 VSI-Bench、MMSI-Bench 和 VSTI-Bench 上取得最先进结果，优于近期经空间后训练的 VLM，并在每个基准上将基础 VLM 提升 15-22 分。我们认为，鉴于原生 VLM 空间推理进展相对缓慢与前馈三维计算机视觉快速进展之间的对比，这一范式为实现稳健空间推理提供了一条有前景的路径。

items.title_en: Learning When Diffusion Language Models Should Regenerate
items.title_zh: 学习扩散语言模型何时应重新生成
items.abstract_en: Remasking allows diffusion language models to revisit generated text, but effective correction requires knowing when and what to revise. Our diagnosis on Sudoku reveals two gaps. Hidden states contain error information that token confidence does not reliably expose, and remasking an isolated error usually reproduces it when the surrounding context remains fixed. These findings motivate DiVR , a verifier that predicts whether a partially generated sequence will reach a correct answer. Trained on the final correctness of the model's own trajectories, DiVR decides when to regenerate a block and which alternative to retain, while the generator itself stays unchanged. On five reasoning benchmarks with LLaDA-8B-Base, DiVR raises the average accuracy of the fine-tuned generator from 35.3\% to 43.4\% at $1.9$-$3.5\times$ the cost of greedy decoding, above search baselines that use $3.8$-$7.4\times$. It also complements post-training such as supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, and generalizes to other generators, including Dream.
items.abstract_zh: 重掩码使扩散语言模型能够重新审视已生成的文本，但有效修正需要知道何时修正以及修正什么。我们在数独上的诊断揭示了两个缺口。隐藏状态包含错误信息，而 token 置信度并不能可靠地暴露这些信息；当周围上下文保持固定时，对孤立错误进行重掩码通常会重现该错误。这些发现促成了 DiVR，一种预测部分生成的序列是否会得到正确答案的验证器。DiVR 在模型自身轨迹的最终正确性上训练，决定何时重新生成一个块以及保留哪个备选，而生成器本身保持不变。在 LLaDA-8B-Base 的五个推理基准上，DiVR 将微调生成器的平均准确率从 35.3% 提高到 43.4%，成本为贪心解码的 1.9–3.5 倍，高于使用 3.8–7.4 倍成本的搜索基线。它还与监督微调和强化学习等后训练互补，并泛化到其他生成器，包括 Dream。

items.title_en: NSDL: Neuro-Symbolic Division of Labor for Multi-Robot Task Planning
items.title_zh: NSDL：面向多机器人任务规划的神经-符号分工
items.abstract_en: Planning for a heterogeneous robot team from a scene image and an instruction involves two kinds of decisions. Some must be judged from the scene: which goals are already met, how the task splits, and which robot does what. Others follow from these and can be computed: prerequisite actions, handoffs between robots, and timing. We argue that each kind should go to the component suited to it: a small vision-language model learns the first, and a deterministic solver computes the second. In NSDL (Neuro-Symbolic Division of Labor), the trained model writes its judgments as a plan sketch, which lists the goals that still need action and the intended steps in order, each with a robot. The solver expands the sketch into an executable joint plan. The model calls two tools, a detector for evidence and the solver, and is trained with the solver in the loop. We evaluate on the public VIKI-L2 benchmark and on LOCUS-Bench, a new benchmark that grades the two kinds of difficulty separately. NSDL outperforms end-to-end planners and formalize-then-plan baselines on both benchmarks and with three backbones from 3B to 8B; the 7B model reaches 97.0% out-of-distribution accuracy on VIKI-L2. Ordering and scheduling errors nearly disappear once the solver writes the structure; the remaining failures are misjudged states, and most goals the model misses are ones it never lists. Code, model weights, and LOCUS-Bench are publicly available at https://github.com/Xincheng-Tan/NSDL.
items.abstract_zh: 根据场景图像和指令为异构机器人团队进行规划涉及两类决策。有些必须从场景判断：哪些目标已经满足、任务如何拆分，以及哪个机器人做什么。其他决策由这些判断推出并可计算：前置动作、机器人之间的交接以及时序。我们认为每一类都应交给适合它的组件：小型视觉-语言模型学习第一类，确定性求解器计算第二类。在 NSDL（神经-符号分工）中，训练后的模型将其判断写为计划草图，列出仍需行动的目标以及按顺序的预期步骤，每个步骤都指定一个机器人。求解器将草图扩展为可执行的联合计划。模型调用两个工具：用于获取证据的检测器和求解器，并在求解器在环的情况下训练。我们在公开的 VIKI-L2 基准和 LOCUS-Bench 上评估，后者是一个分别对两类难度进行评分的新基准。NSDL 在两个基准上、以及从 3B 到 8B 的三个骨干模型上，均优于端到端规划器和“先形式化再规划”基线；7B 模型在 VIKI-L2 上达到 97.0% 的分布外准确率。一旦求解器写出结构，排序和调度错误几乎消失；剩余失败是状态误判，而模型漏掉的大多数目标是它从未列出的目标。代码、模型权重和 LOCUS-Bench 已在 https://github.com/Xincheng-Tan/NSDL 公开。

items.title_en: DuoJEPA: Cross-Modal Translation Between Unaligned Self-Supervised Embedding Spaces
items.title_zh: DuoJEPA：未对齐自监督嵌入空间之间的跨模态翻译
items.abstract_en: Learning from paired modalities is commonly equated with aligning them: two encoders are trained until the embeddings of a pair coincide in a shared space. We study whether cross-modal retrieval and classification can instead be obtained while the two encoders' own embedding spaces remain directly unaligned. DuoJEPA trains one encoder per modality with the self-supervised LeJEPA objective and appends to each encoder a single transformer layer that translates its embedding into the other encoder's space, supervised by a contrastive objective computed entirely within that target space. No loss term compares the two own spaces directly, although the encoders are optimised jointly through the translation objective. In our experiments, the translator's residual connections determine where the cross-modal pressure is absorbed: with a residual translator the two encoders become directly aligned, whereas with a skipless (residual-free) translator a paired-cosine test detects no alignment in the final models, and at most a weak one in the ablations, at comparable cross-modal performance. The learned class-token translation is well approximated by a single scaled rotation of the source space. We evaluate DuoJEPA on two modality pairs that differ in nearly every respect. On chest radiographs and reports from CheXpert Plus, it attains a zero-shot AUC of 86.6 and a cross-modal retrieval score of 78.5, compared with 60.0 and 64.2 for our reimplementation of LeVLJEPA with the same encoders and data. On Sentinel-2 optical and Sentinel-1 radar imagery, the frozen encoders fall within the range of published Sentinel foundation models under our reproduction of the Copernicus-Bench linear-probe protocol, the translator retrieves the paired image of the other sensor among 4,000 candidates in 77-79% of cases, and a patch-level extension transfers the within-image similarity structure of the scene.
items.abstract_zh: 从成对模态学习通常等同于对齐它们：训练两个编码器，直到一对样本的嵌入在共享空间中重合。我们研究是否可以在两个编码器自身嵌入空间保持直接未对齐的情况下，仍获得跨模态检索和分类。DuoJEPA 使用自监督 LeJEPA 目标为每个模态训练一个编码器，并在每个编码器后附加一个 transformer 层，将其嵌入翻译到另一个编码器的空间，监督信号是完全在该目标空间内计算的对比目标。没有损失项直接比较两个自身空间，尽管编码器通过翻译目标联合优化。在我们的实验中，翻译器的残差连接决定了跨模态压力被吸收的位置：使用带残差的翻译器时，两个编码器变得直接对齐；而使用无跳跃连接（无残差）的翻译器时，配对余弦检验在最终模型中检测不到对齐，在消融中至多检测到弱对齐，同时跨模态性能相当。学到的类 token 翻译可以很好地由源空间的一次缩放旋转近似。我们在几乎各方面都不同的两个模态对上评估 DuoJEPA。在 CheXpert Plus 的胸部 X 光片和报告上，它达到 86.6 的零样本 AUC 和 78.5 的跨模态检索分数，而我们用相同编码器和数据重新实现的 LeVLJEPA 分别为 60.0 和 64.2。在 Sentinel-2 光学和 Sentinel-1 雷达影像上，在我们复现的 Copernicus-Bench 线性探测协议下，冻结编码器落在已发表 Sentinel 基础模型的范围内；翻译器在 4,000 个候选中的 77–79% 情况下检索到另一传感器的配对图像，并且片段级扩展传递了场景的图像内相似性结构。

items.title_en: Expanding the Decision Space of Pretrained Models through Structured Re-Decoding
items.title_zh: 通过结构化重解码扩展预训练模型的决策空间
items.abstract_en: Native decoders limit how pretrained models combine local predictions under new structural constraints. We introduce Structured Re-Decoding (SRD), a training-free framework that constructs local candidates from model scores, samples, or external specifications, jointly optimizes their selection, and verifies reconstructed outputs. We show that candidate recombination expands feasible support and can improve attainable reward under a fixed KL divergence budget. Across molecular generation, protein design, RNA structure prediction, and antibody modeling, SRD enables improved structured inference, including verified molecules absent from the original sample pool. External chemical templates further extend SRD to noncanonical amino acids, peptide cyclization, and grammar-guided molecular construction. Preliminary experiments on a physical coherent Ising machine demonstrate the feasibility of hardware-based optimization, suggesting broader opportunities for quantum and quantum-inspired approaches to structured inference and combinatorial optimization across scientific domains.
items.abstract_zh: 原生解码器限制了预训练模型在新结构约束下组合局部预测的方式。我们引入结构化重解码（SRD），一个免训练框架，从模型分数、样本或外部规范构建局部候选，联合优化其选择，并验证重建输出。我们表明，候选重组扩展可行支撑集，并可在固定 KL 散度预算下提高可达到的奖励。在分子生成、蛋白质设计、RNA 结构预测和抗体建模中，SRD 实现了改进的结构化推理，包括原始样本池中不存在的经过验证的分子。外部化学模板进一步将 SRD 扩展到非经典氨基酸、肽环化和语法引导的分子构建。在物理相干伊辛机上的初步实验证明了基于硬件的优化的可行性，表明量子及量子启发方法在跨科学领域的结构化推理和组合优化中具有更广泛的机会。

items.title_en: PISim: A Unified Photonic Inference Simulator for Hardware-Aware Cross-Layer Design-Space Exploration
items.title_zh: PISim：面向硬件感知跨层设计空间探索的统一光子推理模拟器
items.abstract_en: Photonic neural accelerators offer ultra-low latency linear algebra, yet their usable numerical precision, sustainable throughput, and application accuracy remain tightly bounded by surrounding electro-optical interfaces and physical non-idealities. Pre-fabrication design-space exploration (DSE) requires a cross-layer electronic design automation (EDA) framework capable of evaluating disparate optical topologies under identical neural workloads and physical assumptions. We present \textbf{PISim}, a unified Photonic Inference Simulator that couples pretrained deep neural network execution with physics-based models of six accelerator architecture families, six electro-optic modulator technologies, four optical source organizations, and direct or coherent readout schemes. PISim embeds stage-resolved impairment operators---covering control and analog-to-digital quantization, finite extinction ratio, shot noise, correlated relative-intensity noise (RIN), thermal drift, propagation loss, and channel crosstalk---alongside an analytical cycle-level interface timing model to expose electronic-optical bottlenecks. Using simulated MNIST multilayer perceptron (MLP) benchmarks, we demonstrate how PISim identifies optimal precision operating points under multi-impairment stress (peaking at 6 bits for Mach--Zehnder and microring modulators), quantifies a 52.5 percentage-point accuracy gap between VCSEL-array and parallel-fanout laser architectures arising, under the modeled conditions, from power partitioning and correlated source noise, and models interface-limited throughput scaling across emitter-array widths from 32 to 128 channels. This comprehensive framework establishes an extensible, reproducible foundation for accuracy-constrained Pareto optimization prior to photonic tape-out.
items.abstract_zh: 光子神经加速器提供超低延迟线性代数，但其可用数值精度、可持续吞吐量和应用准确率仍受到周围电光接口和物理非理想性的严格限制。制造前设计空间探索（DSE）需要一个跨层电子设计自动化（EDA）框架，能够在相同神经工作负载和物理假设下评估不同的光学拓扑。我们提出 PISim，一个统一的光子推理模拟器，将预训练深度神经网络执行与六类加速器架构族、六种电光调制器技术、四种光源组织方式以及直接或相干读出方案的基于物理的模型耦合起来。PISim 嵌入按阶段分解的损伤算子——涵盖控制与模数量化、有限消光比、散粒噪声、相关相对强度噪声（RIN）、热漂移、传播损耗和通道串扰——以及一个解析的周期级接口时序模型，以暴露电光瓶颈。使用模拟的 MNIST 多层感知机（MLP）基准，我们展示 PISim 如何识别多损伤压力下的最优精度工作点（Mach–Zehnder 和微环调制器在 6 比特达到峰值），量化 VCSEL 阵列与并行扇出激光架构之间 52.5 个百分点的准确率差距——在建模条件下该差距源于功率分配和相关光源噪声——并建模从 32 到 128 通道的发射器阵列宽度下受接口限制的吞吐量扩展。这一综合框架为光子流片前的准确率约束帕累托优化建立了可扩展、可复现的基础。

items.title_en: Using an energy pixels approach to estimate the size a 2nd Generation DEL must be to train a high-resolution binding model
items.title_zh: 使用能量像素方法估计第二代 DEL 必须具有的规模，以训练高分辨率结合模型
items.abstract_en: DNA-encoded libraries (DELs) are commonly used to find small-molecule binders to a target protein. But the hard part is no longer finding a hit. It is building a machine-learning model good enough to guide the medicinal chemistry that follows, one that can resolve the shift in affinity when a chemist changes a single atom. Such a model needs two things from its training data: dense sampling of the small patch of chemical space around the hit, and an adequate number of genuinely tight binders within it. A diverse naive DEL gives neither. It samples an enormous space, so any one neighborhood is covered far too thinly, and the tightest binders are rare. A model trained on that naive DEL data must extrapolate to binders tighter than any it has seen, and that is where models can fail. One way to get training data with both properties is a second-generation DEL built around the hit. We ask how complex that library must be. We treat binding as a sum of small, independent interactions, called pixels on the target and antipixels on the ligand. From the spread of affinities measured in the naive library, with no structural information and nothing yet synthesized, we estimate the complexity such a library must have to supply that dense sampling and those tight binders. The method does two useful things. It turns the number of tight binders a model needs into the number of compounds a library must contain. And it estimates the expected yield of a randomly designed second-generation DEL, so the gain from designing the library with machine learning or active learning can be measured against a baseline, without the expense of a control library as large as the experiment itself.
items.abstract_zh: DNA 编码库（DEL）常用于寻找靶蛋白的小分子结合物。但困难的部分不再是找到命中物，而是构建一个足够好的机器学习模型来指导后续药物化学，该模型能够分辨化学家改变单个原子时亲和力的变化。这样的模型需要训练数据具备两点：对命中物周围小片化学空间的密集采样，以及其中足够数量的真正紧密结合物。多样化的朴素 DEL 两者都不提供。它采样巨大空间，因此任一邻域覆盖都过于稀疏，而最紧密的结合物很罕见。在朴素 DEL 数据上训练的模型必须外推到比其见过的任何结合物都更紧密的结合物，而这正是模型可能失败之处。获得同时具备这两种性质的训练数据的一种方法是围绕命中物构建第二代 DEL。我们询问该库必须有多复杂。我们将结合视为小的独立相互作用之和，称为靶标上的像素和配体上的反像素。根据在朴素库中测得的亲和力分布，在没有任何结构信息且尚未合成任何物质的情况下，我们估计这样的库必须具有的复杂度，以提供这种密集采样和这些紧密结合物。该方法做两件有用的事。它将模型所需的紧密结合物数量转化为库必须包含的化合物数量。并且它估计随机设计的第二代 DEL 的预期产率，从而可以在没有与实验本身同样大的对照库的开支下，将使用机器学习或主动学习设计库所带来的增益与基线进行比较。

items.title_en: Morphological Simplification in Alzheimer's Disease: Computational Analysis and Identification From Connected Speech
items.title_zh: 阿尔茨海默病中的形态简化：基于连贯言语的计算分析与识别
items.abstract_en: Purpose: Morphology is often regarded as relatively spared in Alzheimer's disease (AD) and is rarely modeled in connected speech. This study asked which morphological features distinguish speakers with AD from healthy controls, how well morphology classifies AD compared with other linguistic levels and BERT-based models, and whether the signal exceeds transcript length and vocabulary. Method: Fifty-five automatic measures in eight families, seven of them new and theory-motivated, were computed from participant speech in the ADReSS Cookie Theft descriptions (78 AD, 78 controls) and analyzed with group comparisons, equivalence tests, SHAP, family ablation, likelihood-ratio tests, feature-selection classifiers, and BERT-based models. The automatic measures were validated manually, and models were transferred to two other corpora. Results: Nineteen of 38 measures differed between groups: speakers with AD produced fewer suffixed and inflected words, shorter verbs and nouns, and fewer present-progressive but more past-tense forms (largest effect r = -0.42), whereas errors were rare and statistically equivalent between groups. Eight measures survived adjustment for length and lexical frequency. With test-set feature selection, morphology reached a macro-F1 of 0.85, on par with syntax and above fine-tuned BERT (0.80 over five seeds); fully cross-validated selection gave 0.62. Adding morphology to BERT improved AUC (0.91 vs. 0.89) but not macro-F1. Transfer was limited, although two thirds of the effects kept their direction in mild cognitive impairment. Conclusions: AD connected speech shows morphological simplification and temporal reanchoring rather than breakdown. Morphology is more informative than its reputation suggests. Keywords: Alzheimer's disease; morphology; connected speech; ADReSS; inflection; tense and aspect; SHAP; machine learning; BERT
items.abstract_zh: 目的：形态学通常被认为在阿尔茨海默病（AD）中相对保留，且很少在连贯言语中建模。本研究考察哪些形态特征能够区分AD说话者与健康对照，形态学与其他语言层面及基于BERT的模型相比对AD的分类效果如何，以及该信号是否超出转写文本长度和词汇量的影响。方法：从ADReSS Cookie Theft描述任务中的参与者言语（78名AD，78名对照）计算了8个类别共55项自动测量指标，其中7项为新的、有理论动机的指标，并采用组间比较、等效性检验、SHAP、类别消融、似然比检验、特征选择分类器和基于BERT的模型进行分析。自动测量指标经过人工验证，模型迁移到另外两个语料库。结果：38项指标中有19项在组间存在差异：AD说话者产生的带后缀词和屈折词更少，动词和名词更短，现在进行时形式更少而过去时形式更多（最大效应 r = -0.42），而错误很少且组间在统计上等效。8项指标在对长度和词汇频率进行调整后仍然显著。采用测试集特征选择时，形态学达到宏平均F1为0.85，与句法相当，并高于微调BERT（五个随机种子平均0.80）；完全交叉验证的选择结果为0.62。将形态学加入BERT提高了AUC（0.91对0.89），但未提高宏平均F1。迁移效果有限，尽管三分之二的效应在轻度认知障碍中保持方向一致。结论：AD连贯言语表现出形态简化和时间重锚定，而非形态瓦解。形态学的信息量比其通常印象所暗示的更大。关键词：阿尔茨海默病；形态学；连贯言语；ADReSS；屈折；时态与体；SHAP；机器学习；BERT

items.title_en: Adapting Monocular Depth Estimation in Novel Scenes through Disparity Refinement and Robot Ego-Motion
items.title_zh: 通过视差细化与机器人自运动实现新场景中的单目深度估计自适应
items.abstract_en: The geometric understanding of a scene is a crucial component for safe and efficient robotic operations in novel and unstructured environments. The recent emergence of foundation models for Monocular Depth Estimation (MDE) has provided an opportunity to enrich robotic perception capabilities with dense long-range depth predictions, replacing expensive onboard hardware (e.g., LiDARs and stereo cameras). However, these offline models are primarily trained on affine-invariant depth representations, and their generalization to novel scenes remains unclear. In this work we present EM-ViT, a monocular depth estimation model that learns to adapt online relative depth inputs from a foundation model prior to the metric scale with observations collected during robotic operations. Motivated by the stereo camera parameterization, our method decomposes depth prediction via dense disparity refinement to recover the scene's relative structure and an effective baseline scalar prediction to determine the missing metric scale. The learning process leverages sparse LiDAR points and, optionally, the robot's Ego-Motion (EM) to rapidly train a lightweight Vision Transformer (ViT), while an internal gradient matching loss preserves the fine-grained semantic structure of the input disparity in real-time. We demonstrate the efficacy of our method on publicly available sequences, such as KITTI, and show that our online learning pipeline can adapt to novel scenes faster and with higher accuracy than existing MDE foundation models. The code and supplementary materials will be publicly available at https://emvit-mde.github.io.
items.abstract_zh: 场景的几何理解是在新颖且非结构化环境中安全高效执行机器人操作的关键组成部分。近期单目深度估计（MDE）基础模型的出现，为利用密集远程深度预测丰富机器人感知能力提供了机会，可替代昂贵的机载硬件（如LiDAR和立体相机）。然而，这些离线模型主要基于仿射不变深度表示进行训练，其对新场景的泛化能力仍不清楚。本文提出EM-ViT，一种单目深度估计模型，它学习在机器人操作期间收集的观测下，将来自基础模型先验的相对深度输入在线自适应到度量尺度。受立体相机参数化启发，我们的方法通过密集视差细化分解深度预测，以恢复场景的相对结构，并通过有效基线标量预测确定缺失的度量尺度。学习过程利用稀疏LiDAR点和可选的机器人自运动（EM）来快速训练轻量级视觉Transformer（ViT），同时内部梯度匹配损失实时保持输入视差的细粒度语义结构。我们在KITTI等公开序列上证明了方法的有效性，并表明我们的在线学习流程能够比现有MDE基础模型更快、更准确地适应新场景。代码和补充材料将公开于 https://emvit-mde.github.io。

items.title_en: FoveaDet: Software-Hardware Co-Design of Foveated CNN-Transformer for Object Detection
items.title_zh: FoveaDet：面向目标检测的中央凹式 CNN-Transformer 软硬件协同设计
items.abstract_en: Deploying real-time object detection on power-constrained edge platforms is challenging as processing full-resolution frames is often computationally redundant. Inspired by biological foveation which assigns variable resolution based on visual saliency, we propose a novel software-hardware co-design framework called FoveaDet. On the software side, FoveaDet dynamically identifies salient regions to predict fixation points, followed by aggressive patch pruning in Vision Transformers (ViT) to discard irrelevant background data. To mitigate slowdowns from sequential patch generation, we implement optimized interpolation and patch selection algorithms. Evaluated on standard GPUs, this foveated approach reduces floating-point operations by 65.4% to 92.2% and accelerates inference by 4.76x, while suffering a negligible mAP drop compared to dense baselines. To eliminate hardware bottlenecks, we complement the algorithm with a custom RISC-V core featuring specialized instructions to accelerate the foveated processing pipeline. FoveaDet provides a scalable, efficient architecture capable of unlocking advanced vision processing on severely constrained mobile platforms.
items.abstract_zh: 在功耗受限的边缘平台上部署实时目标检测颇具挑战，因为处理全分辨率帧往往存在大量计算冗余。受生物中央凹视觉（按视觉显著性分配不同分辨率）启发，我们提出软硬件协同设计框架 FoveaDet。软件侧，FoveaDet 动态识别显著区域以预测注视点，随后在 Vision Transformer（ViT）中进行激进图像块剪枝，丢弃无关背景数据；为缓解序列化图像块生成造成的减速，实现了优化的插值与图像块选择算法。在标准 GPU 上评估，该中央凹方法将浮点运算量降低 65.4% 至 92.2%，推理加速 4.76 倍，而 mAP 相比稠密基线仅下降可忽略的量。为消除硬件瓶颈，我们配套设计了带专用指令的定制 RISC-V 核，加速中央凹处理流水线。FoveaDet 提供了可扩展的高效架构，可在资源严重受限的移动平台上实现先进视觉处理。
items.highlight_zh: 中央凹式剪枝省 65%–92% 算力、提速 4.76 倍且精度几乎不降
items.digest_zh:
1. 研究了什么问题：在手机、无人机、可穿戴这类供电捉襟见肘的边端设备上做实时目标检测非常吃力。一张全分辨率图像里真正有物体的区域往往只占很小一部分，其余大片背景都被一视同仁地精算，纯属浪费。
2. 用了什么方法：借鉴人眼的“中央凹”机制——视网膜中心分辨率极高、周边很粗糙，但大脑靠扫视把注意力不断挪到关键处。FoveaDet 在软件上让模型先预测“看哪里”（注视点），再在 Vision Transformer 中大胆剪掉不相关的图像块（patch），只精算显著区域；针对逐块生成可能带来的串行延迟，还做了插值与块选择的算法优化。硬件上则设计了一颗带专用指令的定制 RISC-V 核，专门加速这条中央凹流水线，避免算法省下来的算力又被通用硬件吃掉。
3. 有什么结果：在标准 GPU 上，浮点运算量降低 65.4%–92.2%，推理速度提升到 4.76 倍，而 mAP 相比不剪枝的稠密基线只掉了一点点，几乎可以忽略。
4. 为何重要：它说明“只看该看的地方”不只是生物学上的巧妙，也能变成实打实的算力节省；而且算法、指令、芯片核是一起设计的，软硬件不脱节。这让原本跑不动的高精度检测模型有机会落到功耗极低的移动平台上，对边端视觉部署有直接参考价值。

items.title_en: Optimization principles, revisited
items.title_zh: 重新审视优化原理
items.abstract_en: The brain solves a wide range of problems, and some of these solutions are very good indeed. It is an old idea that, in some cases, these solutions may be as good as possible given the relevant constraints. If this is true we can promote this notion of optimization to a principle from which aspects of function and mechanism can be derived, ideally with no free parameters. Optimization principles are powerful and have had many successes, but they remain controversial. We start with a reminder of a classic example---diffraction limited optics in insect eyes---and then a summary of why you should worry about optimization as a more general principle. Next we turn to recent progress on the theory of optimal motion estimation in fly vision, and finally summarize recent results on the landscape for optimization, arguing that (contrary to widely held intuitions) optimal performance need not require the underlying mechanisms to have finely tuned parameters. I hope to convince you that this is a moment to take optimization seriously as the basis for theories of neural coding and computation. This is based on a rather informal lecture at the summer school LASCON X in Sao Paulo, and I have tried to preserve that tone here; pointers are given to more detailed and technical discussions.
items.abstract_zh: 大脑能解决范围广泛的问题，其中一些解决方案确实非常出色。一个由来已久的观点是：在某些情形下，这些解决方案在相关约束下可能已达到尽可能好的程度。如果这一点成立，我们就可以把这种优化观念提升为一条原理，从中推导出功能与机制方面的若干特征，理想情况下不引入任何自由参数。优化原理很有力，也已有许多成功案例，但仍然存在争议。我们首先回顾一个经典例子——昆虫眼睛中的衍射极限光学——然后概述为何应当对作为更普遍原理的优化保持审慎。接下来，我们转向果蝇视觉中最优运动估计理论的最新进展，最后总结关于优化景观的最新结果，并论证（与广泛持有的直觉相反）最优性能未必要求其底层机制具有精细调校的参数。我希望说服你：现在正是认真对待优化、将其作为神经编码与计算理论基础的时机。本文基于在圣保罗 LASCON X 暑期学校上的一次相当非正式的讲座，我在此尽量保留那种语气；文中给出了通往更详细、更技术性讨论的指引。

items.title_en: Design and optimization of multilevel zone plates for flying focus applications
items.title_zh: 用于飞行焦点应用的多级波带片设计与优化
items.abstract_en: Flying focus pulses, characterized by programmable velocities decoupled from the group velocity, offer remarkable potential for high-intensity laser-matter interactions. However, achieving low-cost manufacturing while simultaneously suppressing higher-order foci and maintaining high efficiency remains a key challenge. Here, we propose a modulated width zone plate with $2^{M}$ steps (MWZP-$2^{M}$S). By employing Monte Carlo sampling of sinusoidal random widths, the MWZP-8S design statistically mimics a Gabor zone plate, suppressing higher-order foci by four orders of magnitude. Furthermore, the multilevel phase modulation converts opaque regions into constructive phase-shifting zones, significantly boosting the focusing efficiency to 73.7$\%$ when $M=3$. Numerical simulations demonstrate that the focal velocity is flexibly tunable across subluminal and superluminal regimes while remaining stable over 100 Rayleigh lengths. This scalable and cost-effective scheme provides a robust platform for flying focus applications in EUV generation and X-ray optics.
items.abstract_zh: 飞行焦点脉冲具有可与群速度解耦的可编程速度，为高强度激光-物质相互作用提供了显著潜力。然而，在实现低成本制造的同时抑制高阶焦点并保持高效率仍是一项关键挑战。本文提出一种具有 $2^{M}$ 台阶的调制宽度波带片（MWZP-$2^{M}$S）。通过对正弦随机宽度进行蒙特卡洛采样，MWZP-8S设计在统计上模拟Gabor波带片，将高阶焦点抑制四个数量级。此外，多级相位调制将不透明区域转换为相长移相区，在 $M=3$ 时将聚焦效率显著提升至73.7$\%$。数值模拟表明，焦点速度可在亚光速和超光速区间灵活调节，同时在100个瑞利长度上保持稳定。这种可扩展且具有成本效益的方案为EUV产生和X射线光学中的飞行焦点应用提供了稳健平台。

items.title_en: A Recipe for Physical Action Model Training
items.title_zh: 物理动作模型训练配方
items.abstract_en: Choosing robot model capacity and demonstration budgets also requires decisions about data composition, representation, optimization, and deployment. We connect these decisions through a common conditional-distribution target. Nested learning oracles give exact risk accounting; local information geometry, conditional mutual information, and empirical convergence provide conditional training prescriptions. Known-target numerical checks expose capacity-data coupling, representation-induced mixture mismatch, and an example where deployment KL increases while negative log-likelihood decreases. An analysis of 206 public PushT trajectories evaluates fixed-feature information-design criteria without fitting a policy. Under asymmetric evaluation targets, the selected allocations reduce this criterion by 4.5-6.2% relative to target matching; balanced targets show no benefit. These results clarify which quantities can support training recommendations and when an apparently favorable predictive metric has a different interpretation.
items.abstract_zh: 选择机器人模型容量和示范预算还需要对数据组成、表示、优化和部署做出决策。我们通过一个共同的条件分布目标将这些决策联系起来。嵌套学习预言机给出精确的风险核算；局部信息几何、条件互信息和经验收敛提供条件训练处方。已知目标的数值检查揭示了容量-数据耦合、表示引发的混合失配，以及一个部署KL增大而负对数似然降低的例子。对206条公开PushT轨迹的分析在不拟合策略的情况下评估了固定特征信息设计准则。在非对称评估目标下，所选分配相对于目标匹配将该准则降低4.5-6.2%；平衡目标则没有收益。这些结果阐明了哪些量可以支持训练建议，以及看似有利的预测指标何时具有不同的解释。

items.title_en: Pretraining Data Statistics Shape the Phases of Learning Entity Comparison in Language Models
items.title_zh: 预训练数据统计塑造语言模型中实体比较学习的阶段
items.abstract_en: How does data shape language model (LM) behavior throughout pretraining? We investigate this question through a case study on entity comparison, e.g., Between France and Brazil, which country is larger?, across nine comparison tasks spanning five entity types. We begin with controlled experiments in which we train small LMs (163M parameters) on mixtures of natural text from pretraining corpora and synthetic task data. Our analysis identifies three distinct phases of learning: (1) an early phase where the LM selects entities by frequency, (2) a middle phase where the LM selects entities by position in the prompt (first vs. last mentioned entity), and (3) a late phase where the LM selects the entity that is the correct answer. We show that the emergence of these three phases is causally determined by statistical properties of the training data. With small amounts of task-specific synthetic data, we observe only the first two phases and the model fails to learn the task; with large amounts, the model jumps directly from the frequency-based heuristic to solving the task correctly. Moreover, changing the entity frequency distribution from a naturally occurring Zipfian distribution (a small number of entities are very common and the vast majority are rare) to a uniform one weakens the frequency phase and speeds up learning of the task. Lastly, we show that the three phases of training dynamics from our controlled experiments appear in the open source model OLMo-2 32B. Together, our findings demonstrate that properties of pretraining data are causal drivers of heuristic learning and show that small-scale synthetic experiments can predict training dynamics at larger scales.
items.abstract_zh: 数据如何在整个预训练过程中塑造语言模型（LM）行为？我们通过实体比较的案例研究来探讨这一问题，例如“在法国和巴西之间，哪个国家更大？”，涵盖五种实体类型的九个比较任务。我们首先开展受控实验，在来自预训练语料的自然文本与合成任务数据的混合数据上训练小型LM（1.63亿参数）。我们的分析识别出三个不同的学习阶段：（1）早期阶段，LM按频率选择实体；（2）中期阶段，LM按提示中的位置（最先提及与最后提及的实体）选择实体；（3）后期阶段，LM选择正确答案对应的实体。我们表明，这三个阶段的出现由训练数据的统计特性因果决定。使用少量任务特定合成数据时，我们仅观察到前两个阶段，模型未能学会该任务；使用大量数据时，模型直接从基于频率的启发式跳到正确解决任务。此外，将实体频率分布从自然出现的Zipfian分布（少数实体非常常见，绝大多数实体罕见）改为均匀分布，会削弱频率阶段并加快任务学习。最后，我们表明受控实验中的三个训练动态阶段出现在开源模型OLMo-2 32B中。总之，我们的发现表明预训练数据的属性是启发式学习的因果驱动因素，并表明小规模合成实验可以预测更大规模下的训练动态。

items.title_en: DPGS-SLAM: Diffusion-Prior and Provenance-Aware Monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM for Dynamic Visual Sensing
items.title_zh: DPGS-SLAM：用于动态视觉感知的扩散先验与来源感知单目高斯泼溅 SLAM
items.abstract_en: This paper presents DPGS-SLAM (Diffusion-Prior and Provenance-Aware Monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM) for dense mapping in environments containing dynamic objects. Dynamic observations can contaminate camera tracking and scene reconstruction in visual SLAM (simultaneous localization and mapping). Although 3DGS (3D Gaussian splatting) enables efficient dense mapping, existing 3DGS-SLAM systems may exhibit instability when dynamic objects violate their underlying static-scene assumption. Excluding dynamic observations can reduce their influence on tracking and mapping, but may leave occluded static backgrounds missing or weakly constrained. Our proposed DPGS-SLAM is a monocular RGB SLAM framework that supports provisional representations of insufficiently observed static backgrounds through asynchronous diffusion-based background completion and provenance-aware Gaussian mapping. Dynamic regions are identified through optical-flow-based motion discovery and temporally consistent mask propagation by SAM2 (segment anything model 2). For selected keyframes, a fine-tuned diffusion inpainting model generates plausible background appearance in occluded regions, while Metric3D v2 predicts metric depth from the completed images to initialize provisional Gaussian primitives. Provenance labels distinguish generated primitives from observation-supported primitives, excluding generated content from camera-pose estimation and observed-map optimization. When previously occluded backgrounds become visible, eligible generated primitives are removed, and observation-supported primitives are independently initialized from real RGB observations and predicted depth. Experimental results demonstrated competitive camera tracking, with average ATE RMSE values of 1.2 cm on TUM RGB-D and 2.7 cm on BONN RGB-D. On StaDy4D, DPGS-SLAM improved average PSNR by 4.60 dB over WildGS-SLAM using only monocular RGB input.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 DPGS-SLAM（扩散先验与来源感知单目高斯泼溅 SLAM），用于包含动态物体的环境中的稠密建图。动态观测会污染视觉 SLAM（同时定位与地图构建）中的相机跟踪和场景重建。尽管 3DGS（三维高斯泼溅）能够实现高效稠密建图，但当动态物体违反其静态场景假设时，现有 3DGS-SLAM 系统可能表现不稳定。排除动态观测可降低其对跟踪和建图的影响，但可能使被遮挡的静态背景缺失或约束不足。我们提出的 DPGS-SLAM 是一个单目 RGB SLAM 框架，通过基于扩散的异步背景补全和来源感知高斯建图，支持对观测不足的静态背景进行临时表示。动态区域通过基于光流的运动发现和 SAM2（segment anything model 2）的时间一致掩码传播来识别。对于选定的关键帧，微调后的扩散修复模型在被遮挡区域生成合理的背景外观，同时 Metric3D v2 从补全图像预测度量深度，以初始化临时高斯基元。来源标签区分生成基元与观测支持的基元，将生成内容排除在相机位姿估计和观测地图优化之外。当先前被遮挡的背景变为可见时，移除符合条件的生成基元，并由真实 RGB 观测和预测深度独立初始化观测支持的基元。实验结果表明具有竞争力的相机跟踪，在 TUM RGB-D 上平均 ATE RMSE 为 1.2 cm，在 BONN RGB-D 上为 2.7 cm。在 StaDy4D 上，DPGS-SLAM 仅使用单目 RGB 输入，平均 PSNR 比 WildGS-SLAM 提高 4.60 dB。

items.title_en: ThermalSplat: Generalizable Pose-Free Gaussian Splatting for Sparse-View Thermal 3D Reconstruction
items.title_zh: ThermalSplat：面向稀疏视角热红外三维重建的可泛化无位姿高斯泼溅
items.abstract_en: Thermal infrared imaging is vital for applications like search-and-rescue and autonomous navigation, yet trans- lating it into 3D scene representations remains a critical bottleneck. The low-texture nature and view-dependent emissivity of thermal images cause standard pose estima- tors to fail catastrophically, collapsing standard 3D Gaus- sian Splatting pipelines under sparse-view constraints. Fur- thermore, existing thermal reconstruction methods rely heavily on dense capture and computationally expensive per-scene optimization. Critically, many of these ap- proaches depend on aligned RGB-thermal datasets to ob- tain reliable camera poses and initial point clouds, ren- dering them unusable in purely thermal, unposed envi- ronments. To break this bottleneck, we present Thermal- Splat, the first generalizable, feed-forward Gaussian splat- ting framework that reconstructs 3D scenes directly from sparse thermal images without requiring known camera poses, RGB guidance, or per-scene training. We over- come thermal-specific challenges using a soft census loss for brightness-invariant structural matching and a bound- ary structure loss to explicitly supervise temperature discon- tinuities. Trained on an aggregated multi-source dataset, ThermalSplat synthesizes sharp reconstructions of unseen scenes in a single feed-forward pass. Extensive experi- ments demonstrate that ThermalSplat holds a strict advan- tage over scene-specific thermal splatting methods in the sparse regime. Furthermore, even compared against these baselines operating under their ideal dense capture set- tings, ThermalSplat achieves superior perceptual fidelity. By eliminating the need for computationally expensive per scene optimization, ThermalSplat offers an efficient and generalizable approach to thermal 3D reconstruction.
items.abstract_zh: 热红外成像对搜救和自主导航等应用至关重要，但将其转化为三维场景表示仍是关键瓶颈。热图像的低纹理特性和视角相关发射率会使标准位姿估计器灾难性失效，并在稀疏视角约束下使标准三维高斯泼溅流程崩溃。此外，现有热红外重建方法严重依赖密集采集和计算昂贵的逐场景优化。关键的是，许多这类方法依赖对齐的 RGB-热红外数据集来获得可靠相机位姿和初始点云，因而在纯热红外、无位姿环境中无法使用。为突破这一瓶颈，我们提出 ThermalSplat，这是首个可直接从稀疏热图像重建三维场景的可泛化前馈高斯泼溅框架，无需已知相机位姿、RGB 引导或逐场景训练。我们利用软 census 损失实现亮度不变的结构匹配，并利用边界结构损失显式监督温度不连续，从而克服热红外特有的挑战。ThermalSplat 在聚合的多源数据集上训练，可在单次前馈过程中合成未见场景的清晰重建。大量实验表明，在稀疏条件下，ThermalSplat 相较场景特定热红外泼溅方法具有严格优势。此外，即使与在理想密集采集设置下运行的这些基线相比，ThermalSplat 仍取得更优的感知保真度。通过消除计算昂贵的逐场景优化需求，ThermalSplat 为热红外三维重建提供了一种高效且可泛化的途径。

items.title_en: Influence of the branching geometry on SPION propagation: coupling of experiment and simulation
items.title_zh: 分支几何结构对SPION传播的影响：实验与模拟的耦合
items.abstract_en: Magnetic Drug Targeting (MDT) is an emerging therapeutic concept in cancer medicine, where superparamagnetic iron oxide nanoparticles (SPIONs) are used as carriers for medication. Their magnetic properties allow for the manipulation of particle transport within the vascular structure and thus targeted delivery to the tumor site. To develop effective concepts for particle steering and accumulation, a detailed understanding of the particle--flow interaction, especially at asymmetric vascular bifurcations, is needed. Based on hierarchical scaling laws, generalized bifurcation geometries with varying degrees of asymmetry were derived and additively manufactured. The particle distribution was investigated by in situ optical measurements under different flow conditions and magnetic field configurations and compared with Lagrangian particle and Volume of Fluid Simulations (VoFS). While the particle mass partition followed the hydraulic flow split in asymmetric bifurcations, density-driven stratification dominated in the symmetric bifurcation, where one daughter branch received only a minor fraction of the particle mass at low flow rates despite carrying half of the flow. The Lagrangian model reproduced the predominantly advective propagation, whereas only the VoFS approach captured the stratification-induced asymmetry. Magnetic actuation counteracted the stratification, reversed the passive branch preference and increased particle retention. From a molecular communication perspective, bifurcation geometry, collective volume effects and magnetic actuation thus jointly determine the received particle signal at vascular bifurcations.
items.abstract_zh: 磁药物靶向（MDT）是癌症医学中一种新兴的治疗概念，其中超顺磁性氧化铁纳米颗粒（SPIONs）被用作药物载体。其磁性允许操纵血管结构内的颗粒输运，从而实现向肿瘤部位的靶向递送。为开发有效的颗粒操控和积聚概念，需要详细理解颗粒-流动相互作用，尤其是在不对称血管分叉处。基于分层缩放定律，推导并增材制造了具有不同不对称程度的广义分叉几何结构。通过在不同流动条件和磁场配置下的原位光学测量研究了颗粒分布，并与拉格朗日颗粒模拟和流体体积模拟（VoFS）进行了比较。在不对称分叉中，颗粒质量分配遵循水力流量分配，而在对称分叉中，密度驱动的分层占主导，其中一条子分支在低流速下尽管承载一半流量，却只接收到很小一部分颗粒质量。拉格朗日模型重现了以平流为主的传播，而只有VoFS方法捕捉到了分层诱导的不对称性。磁驱动抵消了分层，逆转了被动分支偏好并增加了颗粒滞留。从分子通信视角看，分叉几何结构、集体体积效应和磁驱动因此共同决定了血管分叉处接收到的颗粒信号。

items.title_en: Metasurfaces with Anisotropic Electric and Magnetic Conductivities: Parameter Retrieval for Arbitrary Incidence and Polarization
items.title_zh: 具有各向异性电与磁表面电导率的超表面：面向任意入射与极化的参数反演
items.abstract_en: Metasurfaces come in a great variety of unit cell geometries and material composition. A common approach for describing them relies on retrieving effective surface parameters (e.g., electric and magnetic conductivities) from plane-wave scattering data. Conventional retrieval methods are often limited to isotropic unit cells, a uniform host material, or lead to increased complexity by requiring reflection and transmission coefficients from both sides of the metasurface. Here, we derive analytical expressions for the equivalent surface conductivities of an electrically- and magnetically-polarizable anisotropic metasurface under oblique plane-wave incidence with arbitrary polarization. The proposed formulation does not require bidirectional scattering information, thus simplifying the process especially in experimental studies. The method is validated through representative electric and magnetic meta-atoms at microwave and THz frequencies, respectively. Their ability for polarization conversion is demonstrated and discussed relying on the physical insight provided by the retrieved anisotropic conductivities. In addition, we present the inverse expressions for calculating the reflection and transmission coefficients from known surface conductivity tensors, which can prove useful for metasurface synthesis and radiation problems.
items.abstract_zh: 超表面具有多种多样的晶胞几何结构和材料组成。描述它们的一种常见方法是从平面波散射数据中反演有效表面参数（例如电与磁表面电导率）。传统反演方法通常局限于各向同性晶胞、均匀宿主材料，或由于需要超表面两侧的反射和透射系数而变得复杂。在这里，我们推导了在任意极化斜平面波入射下，具有电极化和磁极化各向异性超表面的等效表面电导率的解析表达式。所提公式不需要双向散射信息，从而简化了流程，尤其是在实验研究中。该方法分别通过微波和太赫兹频率下的代表性电元原子和磁元原子得到验证。基于反演得到的各向异性电导率所提供的物理洞察，演示并讨论了它们的极化转换能力。此外，我们给出了由已知表面电导率张量计算反射和透射系数的逆表达式，这对超表面合成和辐射问题可能有用。

items.title_en: HybridCT: ML Accelerated Tomography for Climate Relevant 3D Cloud Observations
items.title_zh: HybridCT：面向气候相关三维云观测的机器学习加速层析成像
items.abstract_en: Low-level clouds are one of the largest sources of uncertainty in climate predictions, partly because we lack detailed three-dimensional (3D) measurements of their internal structure. Here, we present HybridCT, a cloud tomographic reconstruction scheme accelerated by machine learning (ML) that recovers 3D cloud extinction directly from passive multi-angle observations. An ML emulator maps radiances from multiple viewing angles to cloud optical thickness (COT), producing path-integrated projections, and a Simultaneous Algebraic Reconstruction Technique (SART) explicitly inverts these projections to retrieve 3D extinction. Training observations are generated from synthetic 3D cloud fields using radiative transfer simulations for nine viewing angles between $\pm$70$^{\circ}$. HybridCT reconstructs extinction with RMSE 13.3 km$^{-1}$ in 3.5 s, compared to 22.7 km$^{-1}$ in approx. 30 min for the state-of-the-art physics-based tomography framework AT3D, a speedup exceeding 500$\times$. HybridCT thus provides a scalable route toward large-scale observations of 3D cloud structure relevant to radiative-budget interpretation and evaluation of high-resolution cloud simulations.
items.abstract_zh: 低层云是气候预测中最大的不确定性来源之一，部分原因是我们缺乏对其内部结构的详细三维（3D）测量。在此，我们提出 HybridCT，一种由机器学习（ML）加速的云层析重建方案，可直接从被动多角度观测中恢复三维云消光。ML 仿真器将多个视角的辐射亮度映射为云光学厚度（COT），生成路径积分投影，而同时代数重建技术（SART）显式反演这些投影以反演三维消光。训练观测由合成三维云场通过辐射传输模拟生成，覆盖 ±70° 之间的九个视角。HybridCT 以 RMSE 13.3 km⁻¹ 在 3.5 s 内重建消光，相比之下，最先进的基于物理的层析框架 AT3D 在约 30 min 内达到 22.7 km⁻¹，加速超过 500×。因此，HybridCT 为大规模观测与辐射收支解释和高分辨率云模拟评估相关的三维云结构提供了一条可扩展路径。

items.title_en: Indic-Task Gains and Regressions after Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 强化学习后 Indic 任务的提升与退化
items.abstract_en: We run reinforcement learning (RL) with GRPO across four environments, starting from a supervised fine-tuned 30B-A3B mixture-of-experts model covering English and eight Indic languages. We compare the model before and after RL across 34 benchmarks in one evaluation campaign. MATH improves by 36.07 points, and most Indic benchmarks also improve. Yet XQuAD-Indic F1 falls 19.32 points as English answers rise from 8.7% to 91.7%; IndicQA falls 8.64, while English XQuAD gains 11.71 F1. A second RL run from the same supervised initialization adds an Indic environment together with language and repetition rewards. Compared with the released model, it improves both passage-answering and instruction-following benchmarks, along with preserving MATH performance. But it loses ground on reasoning and coding benchmarks. Several training choices changed together, so we cannot isolate the effect of any one of the reward terms. Script compliance remains unresolved. Adding a language reward did not ensure use of the requested script. Passage answering and script compliance therefore need direct evaluation, even when other benchmark scores improve.
items.abstract_zh: 我们从覆盖英语和八种 Indic 语言的监督微调 30B-A3B 混合专家模型出发，在四个环境中使用 GRPO 进行强化学习（RL）。我们在一次评估活动中跨 34 个基准比较强化学习前后的模型。MATH 提升 36.07 分，大多数 Indic 基准也提升。然而，随着英语答案从 8.7% 升至 91.7%，XQuAD-Indic F1 下降 19.32 分；IndicQA 下降 8.64，而英语 XQuAD 提升 11.71 F1。基于同一监督初始化进行的第二次强化学习运行加入了一个 Indic 环境以及语言奖励和重复奖励。与已发布模型相比，它在段落问答和指令遵循基准上均有提升，同时保持 MATH 性能。但它在推理和编码基准上退步。若干训练选择同时改变，因此我们无法分离任一奖励项的影响。文字系统符合性仍未解决。加入语言奖励并未确保使用所要求的文字系统。因此，即使其他基准分数提高，段落问答和文字系统符合性仍需直接评估。

items.title_en: Beyond Memory Limits: A Hierarchical Spatio-Temporal Map Representation for Large-Scale 3D Autonomous Exploration
items.title_zh: 超越内存限制：面向大规模三维自主探索的分层时空地图表示
items.abstract_en: Autonomous UAV exploration is increasingly used for large-scale surveying and inspection in inaccessible or disaster-affected environments, where onboard memory and computational resources are often severely constrained. Most existing UAV exploration systems maintain globally queryable geometric map representations for motion planning and exploration decision-making, causing memory consumption and spatial-query costs to increase with the explored area. Robot-centric local mapping bounds dense-map memory and computation but discards global task context needed for long-horizon exploration.We present FLAVOR, a hierarchical spatio-temporal framework that confines dense metric geometry to a robot-centric local map while retaining compact global observation and task context. At the observation level, lightweight LiDAR-keyframe visibility records preserve ray-wise evidence for frontier reasoning. At the task level, unresolved frontiers beyond the local-map extent are retained as compact pending tasks associated with odometry anchors. A sparse topological graph connects these anchors through retained routes for future revisits.Upon returning to a task region, FLAVOR reconstructs the frontier and exploration viewpoint from observations, while the topological route is instantiated and validated against the current local map before execution. Dense-map capacity remains fixed as exploration expands, with exploration-dependent memory growth confined to compact observation and task context.FLAVOR achieves 31.98--41.88% shorter exploration time and a 94--99% smaller map memory footprint than the best baseline that completes all three simulated scenes. In real-world deployments, it reduces this footprint by 92.67% in the forest and 62.42% at the construction site relative to an explicit point-cloud ikd-tree while preserving long-term task continuity under constrained onboard resources.
items.abstract_zh: 自主无人机探索越来越多地用于难以进入或受灾环境中的大规模测绘与巡检，而这些场景中机载内存和计算资源往往严重受限。大多数现有无人机探索系统维护全局可查询的几何地图表示以用于运动规划和探索决策，导致内存消耗和空间查询成本随探索区域增加而增加。以机器人为中心的局部建图限制了稠密地图的内存与计算，但丢弃了长时程探索所需的全局任务上下文。我们提出FLAVOR，一个分层时空框架，将稠密度量几何限制在以机器人为中心的局部地图中，同时保留紧凑的全局观测和任务上下文。在观测层，轻量级LiDAR关键帧可见性记录保留用于前沿推理的逐射线证据。在任务层，超出局部地图范围的未解决前沿被保留为与里程计锚点关联的紧凑待办任务。稀疏拓扑图通过保留的路线连接这些锚点，以供未来重访。返回任务区域时，FLAVOR从观测重建前沿和探索视点，同时拓扑路线在执行前被实例化并根据当前局部地图验证。随着探索扩展，稠密地图容量保持固定，依赖探索的内存增长仅限于紧凑的观测与任务上下文。与完成全部三个仿真场景的最佳基线相比，FLAVOR的探索时间缩短31.98--41.88%，地图内存占用减小94--99%。在真实部署中，相对于显式点云ikd-tree，它在森林中将该占用减少92.67%，在建筑工地减少62.42%，同时在受限机载资源下保持长期任务连续性。

items.title_en: Emergent Vision-Shaped Thinking in Text-Only Reasoning through Multimodal Training
items.title_zh: 多模态训练下纯文本推理中涌现的视觉形态思维
items.abstract_en: Does multimodal training shape how a language model thinks, even when the input is text only? We test this with targeted causal ablations across 10 multimodal configurations from 6 model families, with matched text-only backbones and cross-family transfer controls. We contrast spatial-imagery tasks that invite mental scene construction with symbol-manipulation tasks solvable by symbolic rules alone. We identify a vision-language axis in hidden-state space and ablate its projection at inference. In Chameleon-7B, this ablation drops accuracy on BIG-Bench Hard (BBH) navigate by 27.6 pp while leaving boolean expressions intact (+5.6 pp), a 33.2 pp double dissociation. The effect is direction-specific and layer-localized, extends to mental-simulation tasks such as mental rotation, paper folding, and perspective taking, and is not explained by task difficulty, reasoning depth, or sequential update load. Together, these results reveal emergent vision-shaped thinking (EVT): text-only reasoning that causally recruits representations introduced or strengthened by vision-language training, without assuming an image-like internal format. The measured effect is spatially concentrated at 7-8B and broadens to non-spatial visual attribute binding in the tested 32B configuration. In dual-path unified models (BAGEL, Janus-Pro), the causal handle localizes to the generation pathway as a compact one-dimensional carrier. The understanding pathway also encodes spatial information in a higher-rank, probe-decodable form, but is not the causal handle. To separate decodability from causal use, we analyze concentration, alignment, and semantic location. These diagnostics explain why behavior, probing, and intervention can diverge. Multimodal training thus reshapes the geometry of text-only reasoning, not just how visual input is processed.
items.abstract_zh: 多模态训练是否会塑造语言模型的思考方式，即使输入仅为文本？我们通过跨 6 个模型族的 10 种多模态配置进行定向因果消融来检验这一点，并设置匹配的纯文本骨干和跨模型族迁移对照。我们将邀请心理场景构建的空间意象任务，与仅靠符号规则即可解决的符号操作任务进行对比。我们在隐藏状态空间中识别出一个视觉-语言轴，并在推理时消融其投影。在 Chameleon-7B 中，这种消融使 BIG-Bench Hard（BBH）navigate 的准确率下降 27.6 个百分点，同时使布尔表达式保持不变（+5.6 个百分点），形成 33.2 个百分点的双重分离。该效应具有方向特异性且定位于特定层，并扩展到心理旋转、纸张折叠和观点采择等心理模拟任务，且不能由任务难度、推理深度或顺序更新负荷解释。综合来看，这些结果揭示了涌现的视觉形态思维（EVT）：纯文本推理因果性地调用由视觉-语言训练引入或增强的表示，而不假定存在类图像的内部格式。测得效应在 7-8B 规模上空间集中，并在所测试的 32B 配置中扩展到非空间视觉属性绑定。在双路径统一模型（BAGEL、Janus-Pro）中，因果控制点定位到生成通路，表现为紧凑的一维载体。理解通路也以更高秩、可由探针解码的形式编码空间信息，但不是因果控制点。为将可解码性与因果使用区分开，我们分析了集中度、对齐和语义位置。这些诊断解释了行为、探测和干预为何可能分离。因此，多模态训练重塑了纯文本推理的几何结构，而不仅是处理视觉输入的方式。

items.title_en: ProTEUS: A mutation-resolved world model for closed-loop protein evolution
items.title_zh: ProTEUS：面向闭环蛋白质进化的突变分辨世界模型
items.abstract_en: Protein engineering requires navigating rugged fitness landscapes, where small sequence changes can produce large functional differences, but experimental screening can only sample a small fraction of sequence space. Thus, a central challenge is to efficiently traverse the large combinatorial space of mutations in silico. We introduce ProTEUS, a mutation-resolved world model for closed-loop protein evolution. Pretrained on deep mutational scanning assays, ProTEUS learns a joint representation of sequence, evolutionary, and structural information using MutationFormer, a mutation-biased attention architecture. Variants are represented as states in this joint latent space, and mutations define actions whose functional consequences are predicted. To support exploration of many mutants, we developed a fast, physics-constrained all-atom predictor that utilizes explicit geometric constraint enforcement to achieve >10 fold increase in speed than AlphaFold3 with guaranteed physical validity. Lastly, ProTEUS refines its prediction and understanding of protein activity through closed loop experimental feedback to guide evolution toward a desired phenotype. ProTEUS surpasses established models in both zero-shot and supervised fine-tuning mutation prediction tasks. We experimentally demonstrate its utility in two closed-loop multi-objective engineering campaigns on aldehyde dehydrogenase and levansucrase, yielding variants with >10 fold higher activity than wild type. ProTEUS provides a world-model framework that connects virtual evaluation of mutational outcomes with experimental learning for efficient protein evolution.
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质工程需要在崎岖的适应度景观中导航：序列上的微小改变可能带来巨大的功能差异，而实验筛选只能采样序列空间中极小的一部分。因此，核心挑战在于如何在计算机中高效遍历庞大的突变组合空间。我们提出 ProTEUS——一个突变分辨的、用于闭环蛋白质进化的世界模型。ProTEUS 在深度突变扫描数据上预训练，利用突变偏置注意力架构 MutationFormer 学习序列、进化与结构信息的联合表示；突变体被表示为该联合潜空间中的状态，突变则定义动作，并预测其功能后果。为支持大规模突变体探索，我们开发了一个快速、受物理约束的全原子预测器，通过显式几何约束的施加，在保证物理有效性的同时速度比 AlphaFold3 提升 10 倍以上。最后，ProTEUS 通过闭环实验反馈不断修正对蛋白质活性的预测与理解，引导进化走向目标表型。ProTEUS 在零样本与监督微调两类突变预测任务上均超过现有成熟模型；我们在醛脱氢酶和果聚糖蔗糖酶上开展了两个闭环多目标工程实验，得到的变体活性比野生型高 10 倍以上。ProTEUS 提供了一个把突变后果的虚拟评估与实验学习连接起来的世界模型框架，可用于高效的蛋白质进化。
items.highlight_zh: 用世界模型加闭环实验，高效导航蛋白质适应度景观
items.digest_zh:
【研究的问题】改造蛋白质（比如让酶的活性更高）本质上是在一个巨大的“序列—功能”地图上找高地。这张地图很崎岖：改一两个氨基酸，功能可能天差地别。而湿实验筛选一次只能测很少的变体，成本高、周期长。所以关键问题是：能不能先在计算机里高效地“预判”哪些突变值得做，再用少量实验验证并把结果反馈回去？

【方法】ProTEUS 把这个问题类比成强化学习里的世界模型：把每个蛋白质变体看作一个“状态”，把突变看作“动作”，模型预测执行动作后功能会怎么变。它先在大量深度突变扫描实验数据上预训练，用名为 MutationFormer 的突变偏置注意力结构，把序列信息、进化信息和结构信息融合到同一个潜空间。为了能快速评估成千上万个候选突变体，作者还自研了一个受物理约束的全原子结构预测器，通过显式施加几何约束保证结构物理上说得通，同时速度比 AlphaFold3 快十倍以上。最后，模型把真实实验测得的活性数据回灌进来，不断修正自己的预测，形成“预测—实验—再预测”的闭环，朝目标表型逐步进化。

【结果】在突变效应预测任务上，无论是零样本还是监督微调设定，ProTEUS 都优于已有成熟模型。作者还做了两个真实的闭环多目标酶工程实验：分别针对醛脱氢酶和果聚糖蔗糖酶，最终获得的变体活性比野生型高出十倍以上。

【为何重要】它把“计算预测”和“实验反馈”真正接成一个循环，而不是各自为战；同时用速度极快的物理约束结构预测打通了通量瓶颈。这为蛋白质工程提供了一种更省实验、更快迭代的通用范式。

items.title_en: Machine-accelerated extraction of experimental superconducting parameters for physical insight and prediction across thousands of materials
items.title_zh: 机器学习加速提取实验超导参数：面向数千种材料的物理洞察与预测
items.abstract_en: New superconductors could unlock next-generation technologies from nuclear fusion to lossless electronics. Machine learning can predict candidate superconductors but lacks validated experimental training data beyond the critical temperature. Here we present AutoSuperCon, a database of eight superconducting parameters, containing 20354 entries for 6793 superconductors. The data were extracted from over 47000 arXiv preprints using a large language model and validated against reference datasets ($R^2 = 0.96$ with NIMS SuperCon). Using AutoSuperCon, we show that median gap ratios rise from 3.6 in conventional superconductors to 6.4 in cuprates, 28% of upper critical fields exceed the Pauli limit, and critical temperatures lie below a ceiling proportional to the superfluid density. Further, we train composition-based predictors for the critical temperature ($R^2_{\log}=0.83$) and the upper critical field ($R^2_{\log}=0.69$), boosted by transfer learning. Within known superconducting families, composition alone is sufficient to screen candidates for both parameters. AutoSuperCon thus enables physical insight and data-driven discovery across thousands of superconductors.
items.abstract_zh: 新型超导体可能解锁从核聚变到无损电子学的下一代技术。机器学习可以预测候选超导体，但除临界温度外缺乏经过验证的实验训练数据。在此，我们提出 AutoSuperCon，一个包含八种超导参数的数据库，收录 6793 种超导体的 20354 条记录。这些数据使用大语言模型从超过 47000 篇 arXiv 预印本中提取，并对照参考数据集验证（与 NIMS SuperCon 的 R² = 0.96）。利用 AutoSuperCon，我们表明中位能隙比从传统超导体中的 3.6 升至铜氧化物中的 6.4，28% 的上临界场超过泡利极限，临界温度低于与超流密度成正比的上限。此外，我们训练了基于成分的临界温度预测器（R²_log = 0.83）和上临界场预测器（R²_log = 0.69），并通过迁移学习得到提升。在已知超导家族内，仅凭成分就足以筛选这两个参数的候选材料。因此，AutoSuperCon 能够实现跨越数千种超导体的物理洞察和数据驱动发现。

items.title_en: A Mechanistic Interpretability Study of an Astronomy Foundation Model
items.title_zh: 天文基础模型的机制可解释性研究
items.abstract_en: Foundation models are increasingly used across the sciences, but whether their internal computations correspond to known scientific operations or proceed through different mechanisms remains unclear. Understanding these mechanisms is essential for assessing reliability, identifying failure modes, and learning new science from the models. We present, to our knowledge, the first causal mechanistic interpretability study of an astronomy foundation model, AION-1, focusing on its multimodal advantage in redshift prediction, where combining imaging with photometry outperforms photometry alone. We find that this advantage is largest for spatially extended and dust-attenuated galaxies, and that most of it is localized to the first of the encoder's twelve blocks. Within that block, how well a property is linearly decodable does not predict whether it can be localized. Spatial extent is causally used, and one attention head dominates linear probing for it, yet ablating that head has negligible effect on redshift prediction: the information is distributed across heads and is decodable again one layer after we erase it. Dust attenuation shows the opposite pattern: it is only weakly decodable anywhere in the encoder, yet a single head is necessary for most of the multimodal advantage, particularly for the most dust-attenuated galaxies, and keeping that head as the only active head in its block preserves nearly all of the advantage. None of the astrophysically motivated operations we tested explains what this head computes. Whether this reflects a limitation of current interpretability methods or a computation that does not correspond to any known astrophysical operation remains open, and resolving it is a prerequisite for using interpretability as a tool for scientific discovery.
items.abstract_zh: 基础模型越来越多地用于各科学领域，但其内部计算是否对应于已知的科学操作，还是通过不同的机制进行，仍不清楚。理解这些机制对于评估可靠性、识别失效模式以及从模型中学习新的科学知识至关重要。据我们所知，我们提出了首个对天文基础模型 AION-1 的因果机制可解释性研究，聚焦于其在红移预测中的多模态优势，即结合成像与测光优于仅使用测光。我们发现，这种优势对于空间延展和尘埃衰减的星系最大，并且其中大部分定位于编码器十二个块中的第一个块。在该块内，一个属性线性可解码的程度并不能预测它是否可被定位。空间延展被因果性地使用，且一个注意力头在其线性探测中占主导，但消融该头对红移预测的影响可忽略：信息分布在多个头中，并且在我们将其擦除后的一层又可被解码。尘埃衰减表现出相反的模式：它在编码器任何位置都只能弱解码，但单个头对于大部分多模态优势是必要的，特别是对于尘埃衰减最强的星系，并且将该头保留为其所在块中唯一活跃的头，几乎保留了全部优势。我们测试的受天体物理启发的操作均无法解释该头计算什么。这究竟反映当前可解释性方法的局限，还是一种不对应任何已知天体物理操作的计算，仍悬而未决；解决这一问题是将可解释性用作科学发现工具的前提。

items.title_en: A Time-Frequency-Condition Multimodal Fusion Foundation Model for Universal Rotating-Machinery Fault Diagnosis under Multi-Element Heterogeneous Scenarios
items.title_zh: 面向多要素异构场景下通用旋转机械故障诊断的时-频-条件多模态融合基础模型
items.abstract_en: Intelligent fault diagnosis models are typically developed for a single machine under a specific set of operating conditions, such that each new machine or condition requires retraining from scratch. This one-machine-one-model paradigm scales poorly. Although transfer learning and domain generalization can reduce the labeling burden, they primarily seek domain-invariant commonality, potentially discarding machine-specific characteristics that are critical for diagnosis. This paper proposes TFC-MMFD, a time-frequency-condition multimodal fusion foundation model for rotating-machinery fault diagnosis under multi-element heterogeneous scenarios. Statistical indicators, time-frequency images, vibration sequences, and textual machine and condition descriptions are tokenized into a unified language-like space, allowing inputs of different physical origin to be represented as a single sequence. A LLaMA backbone, together with cross-modal bidirectional attention and a Q-Former, then distills this sequence into fault-mode queries. Diagnosis is performed by matching these queries against natural-language fault-mode anchors rather than fixed class indices, while regression-adversarial condition disentanglement and condition-conditioned masked pre-training improve robustness to changing conditions. Across four progressive tasks on ten public bearing datasets spanning diverse bearing types, speeds, and loads, TFC-MMFD attains 99.40% accuracy and 99.16% macro-F1, maintains over 80% accuracy on most interpolated unseen conditions without adaptation, and improves from 20.26% to 95.63% accuracy on an unseen machine with only five labeled samples per class. It outperforms the strongest of eight domain-generalization baselines by 10.57 percentage points and compares favorably with a recent bearing foundation model while using less than half of its fine-tuning data.
items.abstract_zh: 智能故障诊断模型通常针对特定工况下的单台机器开发，因此每台新机器或每种新工况都需要从头重新训练。这种“一机一模型”范式难以扩展。尽管迁移学习和域泛化可以减轻标注负担，但它们主要寻求域不变共性，可能丢弃对诊断至关重要的机器特有特征。本文提出 TFC-MMFD，一种用于多要素异构场景下旋转机械故障诊断的时-频-条件多模态融合基础模型。统计指标、时频图像、振动序列以及文本形式的机器和工况描述被标记化到统一类语言空间，使不同物理来源的输入可表示为单一序列。随后，LLaMA 主干连同跨模态双向注意力和 Q-Former 将该序列蒸馏为故障模式查询。诊断通过将这些查询与自然语言故障模式锚点而非固定类别索引进行匹配来完成，同时回归对抗工况解缠和工况条件掩码预训练提高了对工况变化的鲁棒性。在十个公开轴承数据集（涵盖不同轴承类型、转速和载荷）上的四个渐进任务中，TFC-MMFD 达到 99.40% 的准确率和 99.16% 的宏 F1，在大多数插值未见工况下无需适应即保持超过 80% 的准确率，并在每类仅有五个标注样本的未见机器上将从 20.26% 提高到 95.63% 的准确率。它比八个域泛化基线中最强者高出 10.57 个百分点，并与近期一个轴承基础模型相比具有优势，同时使用的微调数据不到后者的一半。

items.title_en: CT-SGAL-LIO: Causal Continuous Time Refinement of Discrete LiDAR Inertial Odometry
items.title_zh: CT-SGAL-LIO：离散 LiDAR 惯性里程计的因果连续时间细化
items.abstract_en: State-of-the-art LiDAR-inertial odometry methods, including those on richer state manifolds, achieve strong global accuracy, yet their pose stream alternates between propagation and correction and can oscillate over short horizons even when globally accurate. Most existing methods follow these approaches: they either modify the filter to enable faster updates or estimate a continuous-time trajectory from raw LiDAR and inertial data. The latter involves extra optimization, delaying state updates and becoming less robust during rapid rotations or accelerations. We propose CT-SGAL-LIO, a continuous-time refinement module that smooths the posterior pose stream of a discrete SGal(3) estimator without modifying the estimator itself. The key novelty is to perform continuous-time trajectory refinement directly on the projected SGal(3) posterior: we fit a cubic trajectory over a bounded window of recent poses and evaluate it at a small fixed lag. This places the query time within the observed interval, so the refined pose is obtained by interpolation rather than extrapolation, while preserving causal operation. CT-SGAL-LIO improves relative trajectory accuracy on 17 sequences from three public benchmarks. Across 17 sequences from GRAND-TOUR, MCD, and GEODE, CT-SGAL-LIO improves short-term motion accuracy while largely preserving global accuracy. RTE improves by up to 70% on GRAND-TOUR and on all seven GEODE sequences, with 9.9-51.1% reductions. A 19.5-min R-Campus run also reduces posterior jumps by 85.4% with only a 4.7 mm change in the end-to-start gap. We plan to release our source code and results to support community validation and reproducibility.
items.abstract_zh: 最先进的 LiDAR-惯性里程计方法，包括在更丰富状态流形上的方法，取得了很强的全局精度，但其位姿流在传播与校正之间交替，并且即使在全局准确时也可能在短时间范围内振荡。大多数现有方法遵循这些途径：要么修改滤波器以实现更快更新，要么从原始 LiDAR 和惯性数据估计连续时间轨迹。后者涉及额外优化，会延迟状态更新，并在快速旋转或加速期间变得不那么鲁棒。我们提出 CT-SGAL-LIO，一种连续时间细化模块，可在不修改估计器本身的情况下平滑离散 SGal(3) 估计器的后验位姿流。关键创新是直接在投影后的 SGal(3) 后验上执行连续时间轨迹细化：我们在最近位姿的有界窗口上拟合三次轨迹，并在小的固定滞后处对其进行求值。这将查询时间置于观测区间内，因此细化后的位姿通过插值而非外推获得，同时保持因果操作。CT-SGAL-LIO 在来自三个公开基准的 17 个序列上提高了相对轨迹精度。在来自 GRAND-TOUR、MCD 和 GEODE 的 17 个序列上，CT-SGAL-LIO 提高了短期运动精度，同时基本保持全局精度。RTE 在 GRAND-TOUR 上以及所有七个 GEODE 序列上最多提升 70%，降幅为 9.9–51.1%。19.5 分钟的 R-Campus 运行还将后验跳变减少 85.4%，而端到起点间隙仅变化 4.7 mm。我们计划发布源代码和结果，以支持社区验证和可复现性。

items.title_en: OnlyAct: Extracting Action Representations from Foundation Models for World Models
items.title_zh: OnlyAct：从基础模型中提取动作表示以构建世界模型
items.abstract_en: Video world models promise general-purpose interactive simulators, but their training is limited by action supervision: action labels are scarce, fragmented across incompatible specifications, and do not scale with the unlabeled video pretraining corpus. A common workaround jointly trains an action encoder to compress consecutive frames into a latent action and a decoder to reconstruct the next frame from the previous frame and that latent, forcing the latent to capture only new information. This has two limitations: learning the action space from scratch can limit generalization to unseen domains, and the bottleneck trades expressiveness for separation, with tighter settings losing nuance and looser ones risking scene leakage under domain shifts. We argue for a different starting point: rather than learning actions from scratch, we start from a pretrained foundation model (V-JEPA 2), whose embeddings of a frame pair already carry substantial action information after large-scale, diverse video pretraining. The remaining challenge is to extract the action while discarding the scene. We propose a label-free contrastive adaptation framework that pulls together frame pairs sharing the same motion under a different scene and pushes apart pairs from the same scene with different motion, reshaping the geometry of the pretrained space without imposing a reconstruction bottleneck. We introduce a unified evaluation protocol along three axes (action expressiveness, scene invariance, and action-conditioned video generation quality) across robot manipulation, camera navigation, game, and driving benchmarks, most of which are unseen during adaptation. Compared with annotation-free latent-action methods, our representations are substantially more expressive while matching their scene invariance, and they yield world models that transfer demonstrated actions to new scenes more faithfully.
items.abstract_zh: 视频世界模型有望成为通用交互式模拟器，但其训练受限于动作监督：动作标签稀缺、分散于互不兼容的规范之中，且无法随无标注视频预训练语料的规模而扩展。一种常见的变通做法是联合训练一个动作编码器（将连续帧压缩为潜动作）和一个解码器（由前一帧与该潜动作重建下一帧），从而迫使潜动作仅捕获新信息。这一做法有两个局限：从零学习动作空间可能限制对未见域的泛化；该瓶颈以表达能力换取分离性，较紧的设置会丢失细节，较松的设置则在域偏移下存在场景泄漏的风险。我们主张换一个起点：与其从零学习动作，不如从一个预训练基础模型（V-JEPA 2）出发——经过大规模、多样化视频预训练后，其对帧对的嵌入已携带大量动作信息。剩下的挑战是在丢弃场景的同时提取动作。我们提出一个无标签的对比适配框架，在不同场景下将具有相同运动的帧对拉近，并将同一场景下具有不同运动的帧对推远，从而在不施加重建瓶颈的情况下重塑预训练空间的几何结构。我们引入一个统一的评测协议，涵盖机器人操作、相机导航、游戏与驾驶等基准上的三个维度（动作表达能力、场景不变性、动作条件视频生成质量），其中大部分基准在适配过程中未曾见过。与无需标注的潜动作方法相比，我们的表示在表达能力上显著更强，同时达到与其相当的场景不变性，并且由此得到的世界模型能更忠实地将演示动作迁移到新场景。

items.title_en: EvoSurv: Evolution-Aware Multimodal Survival Modeling Reveals Complementary Prognostic Signals
items.title_zh: EvoSurv：进化感知的多模态生存建模揭示互补预后信号
items.abstract_en: Accurate cancer survival prediction remains challenging due to tumor heterogeneity. Although multimodal survival models integrate clinical and molecular data, they often overlook evolutionary information encoded in genomic alterations. To address this gap, we developed eTime, a 38-dimensional evolutionary representation comprising eight feature groups that characterize clonal and subclonal mutation burden, mutational spectra, functional consequences, copy-number alterations, and anoikis-related genomic changes. We further developed EvoSurv, a multimodal survival framework integrating eTime with clinical variables and RNA expression. Across six TCGA cancer cohorts comprising 2,782 patients, EvoSurv achieved the highest mean concordance index (C-index) in all six cancers, averaging 0.663 and outperforming three state-of-the-art survival prediction methods. More importantly, we assessed whether evolutionary features provide additional prognostic information beyond clinical and transcriptomic predictors. eTime remained significantly associated with survival in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSC) and liver hepatocellular carcinoma (LIHC) after adjustment for clinical variables and RNA-derived risk scores. Feature-group analyses further revealed cancer-specific prognostic patterns. In HNSC, T>G substitutions were associated with increased mortality risk after clinical and molecular adjustment, including in HPV-negative patients, with supporting evidence from an independent CPTAC-HNSCC cohort. Overall, these findings demonstrate that eTime captures survival-associated evolutionary information and highlight its potential to provide prognostic value beyond clinical and transcriptomic predictors.
items.abstract_zh: 由于肿瘤异质性，准确的癌症生存预测仍然具有挑战性。尽管多模态生存模型整合了临床和分子数据，它们常忽略基因组改变所编码的进化信息。为弥补这一空白，我们开发了eTime，一种38维进化表示，由八个特征组组成，刻画克隆与亚克隆突变负荷、突变谱、功能后果、拷贝数改变以及与失巢凋亡相关的基因组变化。我们进一步开发了EvoSurv，一个将eTime与临床变量和RNA表达整合的多模态生存框架。在涵盖2,782名患者的六个TCGA癌症队列中，EvoSurv在所有六种癌症中取得最高平均一致性指数（C-index），平均为0.663，优于三种最先进的生存预测方法。更重要的是，我们评估了进化特征是否在临床和转录组预测因子之外提供额外预后信息。在调整临床变量和RNA衍生风险评分后，eTime在头颈部鳞状细胞癌（HNSC）和肝细胞癌（LIHC）中仍与生存显著相关。特征组分析进一步揭示了癌症特异性预后模式。在HNSC中，调整临床和分子因素后，T>G替换与死亡风险增加相关，包括在HPV阴性患者中，并有来自独立CPTAC-HNSCC队列的支持证据。总体而言，这些发现表明eTime捕获了与生存相关的进化信息，并突出其提供超出临床和转录组预测因子预后价值的潜力。

items.title_en: Effect of Gas Pressure and Molecular Structure in the Spatial-Mode Conversion of Terahertz Radiation from a Plasma Filament
items.title_zh: 气体压力和分子结构对等离子体丝产生太赫兹辐射空间模式转换的影响
items.abstract_en: In this work, the generation of terahertz (THz) radiation under single color filamentation of a femtosecond laser pulse in an optical cell with compressed gases (argon, nitrogen, CO2) in broad pressure range from 0.001 to 25 atm is experimentally studied for the first time. A nonmonotonic dependence of the integral energy of the THz signal on the gas pressure is revealed, which can be attributed to the competition between an increase in the plasma density and the development of plasma selfabsorption processes, multiple filamentation of the femtosecond pump, and collision induced absorption in the neutral medium. We show that the molecular structure of the gas critically determines the pressure optimum of generation, shifting the maximum of the THz energy yield to the region of elevated pressures (from 10 to 15 atm) for monatomic argon and to the region of subatmospheric pressures (approx. 0.1 atm) for molecular carbon dioxide due to strong vibrational rotational dissipation. On the basis of numerical 3D modeling, it is shown that the cylindrical metal waveguide insert used for signal collection operates in a strongly multimode regime and substantially transforms the angular spectrum of the THz source. We demonstrate that the conical structure of the THz radiation recorded in the experiment is a consequence of intermode interference and diffraction at the output end face of the waveguide, which transforms the true parameters of THz generation in the plasma channel.
items.abstract_zh: 本工作首次实验研究了在光学池中，飞秒激光脉冲在压缩气体（氩、氮、CO2）中单色丝化下，在 0.001 至 25 atm 的宽压力范围内产生太赫兹（THz）辐射。揭示了 THz 信号积分能量对气压的非单调依赖，这可归因于等离子体密度增加与等离子体自吸收过程发展、飞秒泵浦的多丝化以及中性介质中的碰撞诱导吸收之间的竞争。我们表明，气体的分子结构关键性地决定产生的最佳压力：对于单原子氩，THz 能量产额最大值移至高压区（10 至 15 atm），而对于分子二氧化碳，由于强烈的振动-转动耗散，最大值移至亚大气压区（约 0.1 atm）。基于数值三维建模表明，用于信号收集的圆柱形金属波导插入件在强多模状态下工作，并显著改变 THz 源的角度谱。我们证明，实验中记录的 THz 辐射锥形结构是波导输出端面处模间干涉和衍射的结果，这改变了等离子体通道中 THz 产生的真实参数。

items.title_en: Imputing Missing Near-Surface Air Temperature using Graph Attention Networks with Distance-Aware Edge Features
items.title_zh: 使用具有距离感知边特征的图注意力网络插补缺失的近地表气温
items.abstract_en: We introduce a graph attention network for reconstructing near-surface air temperature fields from incomplete observations. The model represents each grid cell as a node connected to its $k$ nearest neighbors, with attention weights that depend on node features, distance, and land-ocean transitions. This graph representation avoids the polar distortions associated with treating the globe as a flat latitude-longitude image, as most deep learning reconstruction methods do. This is particularly relevant for historical temperature records, which extend back to the mid-nineteenth century but remain incomplete, with the largest gaps early in the record and at high latitudes. We train our model on CMIP6 CESM2 historical simulations masked with the time-varying HadCRUT5 observational coverage from 1850 to 2014. We then compare our approach with ordinary kriging, GraphEM, and the LaMa inpainting network on a held-out realization. The graph model achieves the lowest spatial RMSE (0.997 K), 10.1% lower than LaMa and approximately 31% lower than kriging and GraphEM. The largest gains occur in the Arctic and Antarctic, while LaMa remains slightly more accurate in the densely observed tropics. The graph model's error also falls faster as coverage increases, so its advantage over LaMa grows by more than a third from the 1850s to the 2000s. An ablation study shows that the model's skill comes mainly from the geometric graph construction rather than from auxiliary physical covariates.
items.abstract_zh: 我们引入一种图注意力网络，用于从不完整观测重建近地表气温场。该模型将每个网格单元表示为一个节点，连接到其 $k$ 个最近邻，注意力权重取决于节点特征、距离和海陆过渡。这种图表示避免了大多数深度学习重建方法将地球视为平坦经纬度图像时所伴随的极地畸变。这对于历史温度记录尤其相关，这些记录可追溯至十九世纪中叶但仍不完整，最大的缺口出现在记录早期和高纬度地区。我们在 CMIP6 CESM2 历史模拟上训练模型，并用 1850 至 2014 年随时间变化的 HadCRUT5 观测覆盖进行掩码。然后，我们在一个留出实现上，将我们的方法与普通克里金、GraphEM 和 LaMa 修补网络进行比较。图模型取得最低的空间 RMSE（0.997 K），比 LaMa 低 10.1%，比克里金和 GraphEM 低约 31%。最大增益出现在北极和南极，而 LaMa 在观测密集的热带地区仍略更准确。随着覆盖增加，图模型的误差下降也更快，因此从 1850 年代到 2000 年代，其相对于 LaMa 的优势增长超过三分之一。消融研究表明，模型的技能主要来自几何图构建，而非辅助物理协变量。

items.title_en: An LLM Is All You Need: Data-Efficient Adaptation to Full-Duplex, Word-Level Spoken Dialogue
items.title_zh: 一个 LLM 足矣：面向全双工、词级口语对话的数据高效适配
items.abstract_en: Full-duplex spoken dialogue, in which a system listens while it speaks and can backchannel, yield the floor, and be interrupted, is usually obtained by training on hundreds of thousands to millions of hours of speech. This is costly, rewrites the language model that supplies the system's knowledge, and still leaves turn-taking either implicit or decided coarsely rather than word by word. We show that a frozen, general-purpose multimodal LLM can instead be adapted into a word-level full-duplex system with little data. Our system is a thinker-talker cascade on an 80 ms frame clock. The thinker keeps the LLM frozen and trains only lightweight adapters and a few new token embeddings (97M parameters); at every frame it emits one token of agent text, with pauses, yields, and onsets represented as tokens of the same vocabulary and kept legal by a finite-state machine. A four-stage curriculum, each stage anchored to the model's own behavior under the previous format, performs the conversion in about 30 GPU-hours. The talker reads only the thinker's discrete tokens, so the two halves are trained independently. On Full-Duplex-Bench and InteractionBench, the system is competitive with open-source full-duplex systems built through large-scale speech training: among them, it is the least likely to take the floor when the user merely pauses, backchannels most often, and leads in spoken-task accuracy, groundedness, and coherence over long conversations.
items.abstract_zh: 全双工口语对话，即系统在说话时同时聆听，并能进行反馈、让出话轮和被打断，通常通过训练数十万至数百万小时的语音来获得。这成本高昂，会重写提供系统知识的语言模型，并且仍使话轮转换要么是隐式的，要么是粗略决定而非逐词决定。我们表明，一个冻结的通用多模态 LLM 反而可以用很少的数据适配为词级全双工系统。我们的系统是一个在 80 ms 帧时钟上运行的“思考者-说话者”级联。思考者保持 LLM 冻结，仅训练轻量适配器和少量新 token 嵌入（9700 万参数）；在每个帧，它发出一个智能体文本 token，暂停、让出和起始被表示为同一词表中的 token，并由有限状态机保持合法。一个四阶段课程，每个阶段以模型在先前格式下的自身行为为锚点，在约 30 GPU 小时内完成转换。说话者仅读取思考者的离散 token，因此两半独立训练。在 Full-Duplex-Bench 和 InteractionBench 上，该系统与通过大规模语音训练构建的开源全双工系统具有竞争力：在它们当中，当用户仅仅停顿时，它最不可能夺取话轮，最常进行反馈，并在口语任务准确率、有据性和长对话连贯性方面领先。

items.title_en: What Can a VLA Learn from the Agent That Calls It? Task-Level Experience Distillation for Embodied Navigation
items.title_zh: VLA 能从调用它的智能体中学到什么？面向具身导航的任务级经验蒸馏
items.abstract_en: Navigation agents use a large language model (LLM) planner to call a vision-language-action (VLA) model. Each episode needs the LLM, adding cost and delay. We distill successful agent experience into the VLA instead of distilling the planner. The VLA then navigates alone at test time. Agent sessions are not VLA demonstrations. They include motions driven by planner tools and sub-instructions, along with detours. We present H2E, a task-level experience distillation method that converts these sessions into VLA training data. Every motion becomes a VLA action under the original task instruction, with the resulting poses as targets. H2E masks the loss on steps that move away from the goal. It labels every visited state within 1 m of the goal as a stop. We then update the VLA with low-rank adaptation. The VLA learns to stop at the goal and find goals the base model never reaches. On all 3,189 REVERIE-CE val-unseen episodes, H2E raises the success rate of an 8B VLA from 35.0% to 44.9%.
items.abstract_zh: 导航智能体使用大型语言模型（LLM）规划器来调用视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。每个回合都需要 LLM，增加了成本与延迟。我们将成功的智能体经验蒸馏到 VLA 中，而不是蒸馏规划器。于是 VLA 在测试时可单独导航。智能体会话并不是 VLA 演示。它们包含由规划器工具和子指令驱动的运动，以及绕行。我们提出 H2E，一种任务级经验蒸馏方法，将这些会话转换为 VLA 训练数据。每一次运动都在原始任务指令下成为一个 VLA 动作，并以所得位姿作为目标。H2E 对远离目标的步骤屏蔽损失。它将距离目标 1 m 内访问过的每个状态标记为停止。然后我们使用低秩适应更新 VLA。VLA 学会在目标处停止，并找到基础模型从未到达的目标。在全部 3,189 个 REVERIE-CE val-unseen 回合上，H2E 将 8B VLA 的成功率从 35.0% 提升到 44.9%。

items.title_en: Obscured Wildfire Flame Detection by Spatio-temporal Analysis of Smoke Patterns Using Frame-wise Transformers
items.title_zh: 利用逐帧Transformer对烟雾模式进行时空分析以检测被遮挡的野火火焰
items.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a new paradigm in wildfire management for detecting both visible and obscured fire using Deep Learning (DL). The essence of our method is the joint spatial and temporal analysis of RGB videos, embracing the fact that temporal patterns of smoke motions in consecutive video frames can indicate obscured fire flames. This perspective contrasts the traditional approach of independently analyzing images and individual video frames. To this end, we propose a frame-wise transformer architecture that applies an attention mechanism between the consecutive frames while preserving spatial information within frames as opposed to regular attention mechanisms like the non-local block, which combines spatial and temporal information into a single vector. We also optimize the temporal pattern lengths under different spatial resolutions to achieve the highest performance while reducing the computational cost. To investigate the applicability of our method in aerial image processing, we applied it to a curated version of the FLAME2 dataset that includes dual-mode RGB/IR videos. The IR video feed is used to extract ground truth, while the model is trained only on RGB videos to maintain applicability to lowcost commercial drones (which are equipped only with regular cameras) and facilitate processing existing RGB-only datasets. Our proposed method achieves a Segmentation Foreground Dice score of 92.61%, an Object Detection Precision and Recall rate of 93.21% and 91.73%, and clip-level classification accuracy of 98.02%, respectively. We also investigated the efficacy and generalizability of our method through ablation study
items.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一种野火管理的新范式，利用深度学习（DL）检测可见火焰和被遮挡火焰。我们方法的核心是对RGB视频进行联合空间和时间分析，接受连续视频帧中烟雾运动的时间模式可指示被遮挡火焰这一事实。这一视角与独立分析图像和单个视频帧的传统方法形成对比。为此，我们提出了一种逐帧Transformer架构，在连续帧之间应用注意力机制，同时保留帧内空间信息，这与非局部块等将空间和时间信息合并为单个向量的常规注意力机制相反。我们还优化了不同空间分辨率下的时间模式长度，以在降低计算成本的同时实现最高性能。为研究我们方法在航空图像处理中的适用性，我们将其应用于包含双模态RGB/红外视频的FLAME2数据集整理版本。红外视频流用于提取真值，而模型仅在RGB视频上训练，以保持对低成本商用无人机（仅配备普通相机）的适用性，并便于处理现有的仅RGB数据集。我们提出的方法分别达到92.61%的分割前景Dice分数、93.21%和91.73%的目标检测精确率和召回率，以及98.02%的片段级分类准确率。我们还通过消融研究考察了我们方法的有效性和泛化性。

items.title_en: Experimental Evidence of Cellular Sparing under Single-Pulse Picosecond Irradiation at Extreme Dose Rates
items.title_zh: 极端剂量率单脉冲皮秒辐照下细胞保护效应的实验证据
items.abstract_en: Understanding how biological cells respond to radiation delivered on extremely short timescales is central to resolving the fundamental mechanisms underlying radiotherapy and to defining new regimes of radiobiology. Experimentally accessing these earliest stages of physicochemical response is crucial to benchmark current numerical codes, whose predictions are known to vary substantially with under-constrained early-stage parameters. Using a laser-driven electron source, tunable doses up to 8Gy were delivered to normal and cancer human cell lines, in single pulses of picosecond-scale duration at mean dose rates above 10^10 Gy/s. Clonogenic survival assays and 53BP1 foci formation were compared with conventional X-ray irradiation at 2.4Gy/min. Surviving fractions are found to be comparable to conventional irradiation at doses up to 3Gy. At higher doses, however, all cell lines exhibited a consistent increase in surviving fraction, corresponding to an average RBE at 10% survival of 0.84+/-0.05. This sparing effect is associated with a statistically significant reduction in the beta parameter of the linear-quadratic model, indicating reduced cell killing from accumulated sub-lethal damage. Picosecond irradiation also produced a marked reduction in prompt 53BP1 foci, but no significant difference in residual foci at 24h and foci-size distributions. These results provide the first experimental evidence of cellular sparing following single-pulse picosecond-scale irradiation. Direct comparison with recent work at femtosecond timescales suggests the presence of a previously undetected sharp transition in biological response at the femtosecond/picosecond interface, giving critical insight on the possible mechanisms responsible for this differential response.
items.abstract_zh: 理解生物细胞如何对极短时间尺度上递送的辐射作出响应，是解析放疗基本机制并定义放射生物学新范畴的核心。通过实验获取这些物理化学响应的最早阶段，对于基准测试当前数值代码至关重要，因为已知这些代码的预测会随约束不足的早期阶段参数而显著变化。使用激光驱动电子源，以皮秒级持续时间的单脉冲、高于 10^10 Gy/s 的平均剂量率，向正常和癌症人类细胞系递送最高 8 Gy 的可调剂量。将克隆形成存活实验和 53BP1 焦点形成与传统 X 射线照射（2.4 Gy/min）进行比较。在剂量不超过 3 Gy 时，存活分数与传统照射相当。然而在更高剂量下，所有细胞系均表现出一致的存活分数增加，对应 10% 存活时的平均 RBE 为 0.84±0.05。这种保护效应与线性二次模型 β 参数的统计学显著降低相关，表明累积亚致死损伤导致的细胞杀伤减少。皮秒照射还使即时 53BP1 焦点显著减少，但 24 h 的残留焦点及焦点大小分布无显著差异。这些结果提供了单脉冲皮秒级照射后细胞保护效应的首个实验证据。与近期飞秒时间尺度工作的直接比较表明，在飞秒/皮秒界面存在此前未检测到的生物响应尖锐转变，为导致这种差异响应的可能机制提供了关键见解。

items.title_en: AI-assisted search for self-compressing gigawatt subcycle field waveforms
items.title_zh: AI 辅助搜索自压缩吉瓦级亚周期场波形
items.abstract_en: We explore the physics behind pulse self-compression to high-power subcycle field waveforms and search for the optimal regimes of such compression over the parameter space as laid out by multimode nonlinear dynamics of ultrashort laser pulses in gas-filled hollow fibers. With the pertinent physical criteria for pulse contrast and no pulse breakup formalized as operational stopping rules, a radical speedup of such search is achieved by delegating its tedious preliminary stages to generative pretrained transformer models. The precise adjustment of self-compression dynamics vis-a-vis the desired compressed pulse output is, however, not yet delegable to AI agents, as the criteria for such search are still largely subjective, operating with fine aspects of subcycle field structure, not yet formalizable as clear search-stopping instructions. An ultimate precision in such subcycle field engineering is attainable via a management of field-phase-sensitive nonlinear processes, enabling pulse self-compression to high-power subcycle field waveforms and opening paths toward fiber-optic attosecond lightwave engineering.
items.abstract_zh: 我们探索脉冲自压缩到高功率亚周期场波形背后的物理，并在充气空心光纤中超短激光脉冲的多模非线性动力学所给出的参数空间上，搜索此类压缩的最优区域。将脉冲对比度和无脉冲分裂的相关物理判据形式化为可操作的停止规则后，通过把其繁琐的初步阶段交给生成式预训练 Transformer 模型，实现了此类搜索的极大加速。然而，相对于所需压缩脉冲输出对自压缩动力学的精确调节，尚不能委托给 AI 智能体，因为此类搜索的判据在很大程度上仍是主观的，操作的是亚周期场结构的细微方面，尚不能形式化为明确的搜索停止指令。此类亚周期场工程的最终精度可通过管理场相位敏感的非线性过程来实现，从而使脉冲自压缩至高功率亚周期场波形，并为光纤阿秒光波工程开辟路径。
