items.title_en: Multimodal Semantic Communication using Shared and Unique Representation Decomposition
items.title_zh: 基于共享与独有表示分解的多模态语义通信
items.abstract_en: Semantic communication (SemCom) has emerged as a promising paradigm for bandwidth-constrained mobile and vehicular networks. This paper proposes a unified representation learning framework for multimodal SemCom (MSC), which encodes heterogeneous data into a compact semantic space for efficient transmission and source recovery. The framework addresses the multimodal semantic representation gap, which arises when at least one modality contains semantic information that cannot be fully inferred from the other. To preserve this information for reconstruction, the framework decomposes each representation into shared and modality-specific components. We formulate a mutual information objective for source reconstruction, cross-modal alignment of the shared components, and decoupling of the shared and modality-specific components. To enhance transmission efficiency, we introduce a shared knowledge base implemented as a compact codebook of semantic vectors learned during training. The shared components are transmitted digitally as codebook indices, while the modality-specific components are sent in analog form. We apply knowledge distillation during training, using a pretrained vision foundation model to guide the learning of quantized shared features. On image--text pairs over additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN) and Extended Vehicular A (EVA) channels, the proposed framework improves image reconstruction over conventional separate source-channel coding (SSCC) and representative multimodal and unimodal SemCom systems. Further evaluations show gradual degradation under channel-estimation mismatch, complementary effects of alignment, decoupling, and knowledge distillation on the shared representation, and alignment of shared features across modalities with separation of the modality-specific features.
items.abstract_zh: 语义通信（SemCom）已成为带宽受限的移动与车载网络中一种有前景的范式。本文提出一个面向多模态语义通信（MSC）的统一表示学习框架，将异构数据编码到紧凑的语义空间，以实现高效传输和源恢复。该框架解决多模态语义表示鸿沟，即当至少一个模态包含无法从另一模态完全推断的语义信息时出现的问题。为在重建中保留该信息，框架将每个表示分解为共享分量和模态特有分量。我们为源重建、共享分量的跨模态对齐以及共享与模态特有分量的解耦构建互信息目标。为提升传输效率，我们引入一个共享知识库，实现为训练期间学习到的语义向量紧凑码本。共享分量以码本索引形式数字传输，而模态特有分量以模拟形式发送。训练时采用知识蒸馏，使用预训练视觉基础模型指导量化共享特征的学习。在加性白高斯噪声（AWGN）和扩展车辆 A（EVA）信道上的图像—文本对上，所提框架在图像重建方面优于传统分离源信道编码（SSCC）以及代表性的多模态和单模态 SemCom 系统。进一步评估显示，在信道估计失配下性能逐渐下降，对齐、解耦和知识蒸馏对共享表示具有互补作用，并且跨模态的共享特征对齐且模态特有特征分离。

items.title_en: Sckwoky at SHROOM-Visions: Character-Level Hallucination-Span Detection in Image-Conditioned VLMs via Dual-Prompted LoRA Decoders
items.title_zh: Sckwoky在SHROOM-Visions：通过双提示LoRA解码器进行图像条件VLM中的字符级幻觉跨度检测
items.abstract_en: We present our system for the SHROOM-visions 2026 shared task on character-level hallucination span detection in image-conditioned vision-language model (VLM) responses, evaluated across English, French, Italian, and Chinese. The detector is built on a frozen Gemma-4-12B-it backbone with trainable LoRA adapters (approximately 10.7M parameters). Because the backbone is a causal decoder, hidden states read from a single copy of an answer cannot attend to subsequent tokens; we therefore repeat the candidate answer within one prompt and extract features from its second occurrence, giving every position approximate bidirectional context in a single non-autoregressive pass. A character-level locator combines intermediate hidden states to predict hallucination probabilities, BIO boundaries, and a response-level abstention score, while separate language-specific classifiers assign one of five hallucination types to each predicted span. On the closed test set, our system reaches a macro-averaged character IoU of 0.4404, more than doubling the official baseline (0.1854), and ranks 5th-6th on IoU across the four languages. On the English tuning split, controlled ablations attribute a gain to the repeated answer that is comparable to that of LoRA adaptation (its held-out gain is smaller and concentrated on hallucinated answers), and they show that the detector relies on the image-answer pairing: shuffling images across examples drives IoU down to the level of the predict-nothing floor or below it in every language. In deployments where the same Gemma-4-12B-it model also generates answers, its base weights can be reused, making the approach practical for local question-answering systems that cannot run a separate verifier.
items.abstract_zh: 我们介绍参加SHROOM-visions 2026共享任务的系统，该任务针对图像条件视觉语言模型（VLM）响应中的字符级幻觉跨度检测，并在英语、法语、意大利语和中文上进行评估。检测器建立在冻结的Gemma-4-12B-it骨干与可训练LoRA适配器（约10.7M参数）之上。由于骨干是因果解码器，从答案的单个副本读取的隐藏状态无法关注后续token；因此，我们在一个提示内重复候选答案，并从其第二次出现中提取特征，在单次非自回归过程中为每个位置提供近似双向上下文。字符级定位器结合中间隐藏状态来预测幻觉概率、BIO边界和响应级弃权分数，而单独的语言特定分类器为每个预测跨度分配五种幻觉类型之一。在封闭测试集上，我们的系统达到0.4404的宏平均字符IoU，超过官方基线（0.1854）一倍以上，并在四种语言上的IoU排名第5-6。在英语调优划分上，受控消融将一项增益归因于重复答案，其大小与LoRA适配相当（其留出增益较小且集中在幻觉答案上），并且表明检测器依赖图像-答案配对：在样本间打乱图像会使IoU降至“预测无”下限水平或在每种语言中低于该下限。在同一Gemma-4-12B-it模型也生成答案的部署中，其基础权重可被复用，使该方法适用于无法运行单独验证器的本地问答系统。

items.title_en: Reading the Table: Sim-to-Real Game State Detection for the Chef's Hat Card Game
items.title_zh: 读取牌桌：面向 Chef's Hat 卡牌游戏的仿真到真实游戏状态检测
items.abstract_en: Tabletop games offer a compelling scenario to study the interaction between artificial and human agents, combining social interaction with game state tracking and physical manipulation. To assess the game state, a robot needs to precisely detect closely related game objects, such as different card designs, requiring dedicated training data that is costly to annotate in the real world. Instead, we develop a fully automated synthetic data collection pipeline, using re-projection of known 3D coordinates to generate labels automatically and domain randomization to bridge the reality gap. This approach is used to collect a dataset of 25413 samples to finetune an object detection and a segmentation model, which are combined to assign detected cards to game-relevant zones and infer the game state. When evaluated on a real NICO humanoid robot, our pipeline achieves an F1-score of 0.906 for card-to-zone assignment, thus providing the perceptual foundation for a robot that can autonomously play Chef's Hat against human players.
items.abstract_zh: 桌面游戏提供了一个引人注目的场景来研究人工智能体与人类智能体之间的交互，将社交互动与游戏状态跟踪和物理操作相结合。为了评估游戏状态，机器人需要精确检测密切相关的游戏对象，例如不同的卡牌设计，这需要专门的训练数据，而在真实世界中标注这些数据成本高昂。相反，我们开发了一个全自动合成数据收集流水线，利用已知 3D 坐标的重投影自动生成标签，并使用域随机化来弥合现实差距。该方法用于收集包含 25413 个样本的数据集，以微调目标检测和分割模型，并将二者结合，将检测到的卡牌分配给游戏相关区域并推断游戏状态。在真实的 NICO 人形机器人上评估时，我们的流水线在卡牌到区域分配上达到 0.906 的 F1 分数，从而为能够自主与人类玩家玩 Chef's Hat 的机器人提供感知基础。

items.title_en: Lightweight Deep Learning Framework for Astrocyte-Centric 3D Reconstruction across Normal and Stress-associated Ultrastructural States
items.title_zh: 跨正常与应激相关超微结构状态的以星形胶质细胞为中心的轻量级深度学习三维重建框架
items.abstract_en: The morphology of astrocytes is closely associated with their ability to support and modulate neural circuit functions; however, its reconstruction from volume electron microscopy (vEM) data remains labor-intensive and computationally resource-intensive, placing substantial barriers on its broader adoption and scalability despite the high spatial resolution of vEM. We present AstroSeg-vEM, a lightweight, astrocyte-centric framework for morphology-preserving astrocyte segmentation, 3D reconstruction, and quantitative morphological analysis in vEM images. AstroSeg-vEM combines transformer-based 2D segmentation with dedicated post-processing methods and operates directly on high-resolution EM sections, making it well suited to anisotropic vEM data and downstream proofreading workflows while preserving the full in-plane resolution of the original EM data. Across four mouse hippocampal datasets representing normal and morphologically defined stress-associated astrocyte ultrastructural states, AstroSeg-vEM demonstrates robust performance and generalization, achieving average Dice and weighted Dice values of 0.92 and 0.95, respectively, on a held-out test dataset. Its lightweight architecture enables efficient, high-fidelity reconstruction on consumer-grade hardware, providing a scalable and accessible platform for large-scale astrocyte ultrastructure analysis and future astrocyte-neuron interaction studies.
items.abstract_zh: 星形胶质细胞的形态与其支持和调控神经回路功能的能力密切相关；然而，从体积电子显微镜（vEM）数据中重建其形态仍然耗费大量人力与计算资源，尽管vEM具有高空间分辨率，这仍为其更广泛采用和扩展设置了重大障碍。我们提出AstroSeg-vEM，一个轻量级、以星形胶质细胞为中心的框架，用于vEM图像中保持形态的星形胶质细胞分割、三维重建和定量形态分析。AstroSeg-vEM将基于Transformer的二维分割与专用后处理方法相结合，并直接在高分辨率电镜切片上运行，使其非常适合各向异性vEM数据和下游校对流程，同时保留原始电镜数据的完整面内分辨率。在代表正常和形态学定义的应激相关星形胶质细胞超微结构状态的四个小鼠海马数据集上，AstroSeg-vEM表现出稳健的性能和泛化能力，在留出测试数据集上分别达到0.92和0.95的平均Dice和加权Dice值。其轻量级架构可在消费级硬件上实现高效、高保真重建，为大规模星形胶质细胞超微结构分析和未来星形胶质细胞-神经元相互作用研究提供可扩展且可及的平台。

items.title_en: stMIND: Learning multiscale interaction dynamics from spatial-temporal transcriptomics
items.title_zh: stMIND：从时空转录组学学习多尺度相互作用动力学
items.abstract_en: Interactions within local cellular neighborhoods and across broader tissue scales jointly govern molecular state transitions and morphogenesis during development and regeneration. While time-resolved spatial transcriptomics simultaneously profiles gene expression and spatial coordinates, destructive sequencing samples distinct cells at each time point, leaving intermediate trajectories and multiscale intercellular interactions unobserved. Building upon our interacting mean-field neural stochastic differential equation framework, we present stMIND (Spatiotemporal Multiscale Interaction Neural Dynamics), a continuous-time generative framework that infers coupled molecular, spatial, and proliferation dynamics from unmatched spatiotemporal snapshots. stMIND decomposes cellular expression velocity vector/drift into three interpretable operators: a cell-intrinsic program, a local graph-difference attention operator that aggregates relative expression differences and spatial geometry within a co-evolving physical radius, and a nonlocal mean-field attention operator that captures long-range population context beyond the immediate neighborhood. By evolving dynamic spatial neighborhoods alongside cellular migration and enforcing orthogonality between intrinsic and interaction-driven drifts, stMIND resolves scale-specific intercellular influences through optimal transport in joint expression-position space. In axolotl and zebrafish benchmarks, stMIND leads in expression prediction, anatomical consistency and spatial coherence. Ablations confirm the need to combine disjoint local and nonlocal operators. It reveals a regenerative transition in axolotl telencephalon 10 to 15 days after injury, with a drift energy surge followed by nonlocal dominance and local counterbalance varying by cell type in reactive ependymoglial niches. It tracks developmental vector fields across zebrafish stages.
items.abstract_zh: 局部细胞邻域内以及更广泛组织尺度上的相互作用共同调控发育和再生过程中的分子状态转变与形态发生。虽然时间分辨空间转录组学可同时分析基因表达和空间坐标，但破坏性测序在每个时间点采样不同细胞，导致中间轨迹和多尺度细胞间相互作用未被观测。基于我们的相互作用平均场神经随机微分方程框架，我们提出stMIND（时空多尺度相互作用神经动力学），一个连续时间生成框架，可从未配对的时空快照推断耦合的分子、空间和增殖动力学。stMIND将细胞表达速度向量/漂移分解为三个可解释算子：细胞内在程序、局部图差分注意力算子（在共同演化的物理半径内聚合相对表达差异和空间几何）以及非局部平均场注意力算子（捕获紧邻邻域之外的远程群体上下文）。通过在细胞迁移的同时演化动态空间邻域，并强制内在漂移与相互作用驱动漂移之间的正交性，stMIND通过联合表达-位置空间中的最优传输解析尺度特异性细胞间影响。在美西螈和斑马鱼基准中，stMIND在表达预测、解剖一致性和空间连贯性方面领先。消融实验证实了结合分离的局部与非局部算子的必要性。它揭示了损伤后10至15天美西螈端脑的再生转变，表现为漂移能量激增，随后在反应性室管膜胶质细胞微环境中出现非局部主导和局部平衡，并随细胞类型变化。它追踪了斑马鱼各阶段的发育向量场。

items.title_en: Additively manufactured ceramic platforms for miniaturized optical frequency references and robust atomic sensor systems
items.title_zh: 用于小型化光学频率参考和稳健原子传感器系统的增材制造陶瓷平台
items.abstract_en: Transferring atomic quantum sensors from laboratory-scale physics packages to compact, alignment-free sensor heads suitable for field and space deployment requires a structural platform that combines mechanical, thermal, and optical functionality within a single, manufacturable component. We present such a platform based on additively manufactured technical ceramics: lithography-based ceramic manufacturing is used to fabricate monolithic micro-optical benches with application-specific mounting geometries, while high-precision active alignment and adhesive bonding realize long-term stable optical assemblies through micro-integration. As a first system-level demonstrator, we present a micro-integrated optical frequency reference based on Doppler-free spectroscopy of the rubidium D2 line, integrated within a 6 mL Al2O3 module. A laser stabilized to the reference reaches a fractional frequency instability of $3\times10^{-12}$ at 1 s. We extend the platform to a compact optically pumped magnetometer, exploiting the magnetic cleanliness and tailored thermal properties of high-purity ceramics for a 7 mL sensor head with picotesla sensitivity aimed at space-borne biomagnetometry, and to a micro-integrated optical dipole trap with active MEMS-mirror beam steering for cold-atom manipulation. Together, these demonstrators show that ceramic additive manufacturing and optical micro-integration form a versatile, robust platform for compact atomic sensor systems in field and space applications.
items.abstract_zh: 将原子量子传感器从实验室规模物理组件转移到适合现场和空间部署的紧凑、免对准传感器头，需要一种在单一可制造组件中结合机械、热和光学功能的结构平台。我们提出这样一种基于增材制造技术陶瓷的平台：采用基于光刻的陶瓷制造来制造具有应用特定安装几何结构的单片微光学台，同时通过微集成利用高精度主动对准和粘合剂键合实现长期稳定的光学组件。作为首个系统级演示器，我们展示一种基于铷D2线无多普勒光谱的微集成光学频率参考，集成在6 mL Al2O3模块内。稳定到该参考的激光在1 s时达到3×10^{-12}的分数频率不稳定度。我们将该平台扩展到紧凑型光泵磁力计，利用高纯陶瓷的磁洁净性和定制热性能，构建一个7 mL、具有皮特斯拉灵敏度的传感器头，面向星载生物磁测量；并扩展到具有主动MEMS镜光束转向的微集成光学偶极阱，用于冷原子操控。总之，这些演示器表明，陶瓷增材制造和光学微集成构成了一个通用、稳健的平台，适用于现场和空间应用中的紧凑原子传感器系统。

items.title_en: Personalized Affective Perception via Continual Learning in Human-Agent Negotiation
items.title_zh: 人-智能体谈判中通过持续学习实现个性化情感感知
items.abstract_en: Self-interested intelligent agents that negotiate with humans should interpret nonverbal expressions and adapt their behavior accordingly. However, generic facial-affect models degrade across individuals and contexts, creating a generalization gap. We introduce an affect-adaptive negotiation strategy that incorporates Continual Learning with Imagination for Facial Expression Recognition (CLIFER) to personalize valence-arousal perception in real time. Differential feedback converts changes in valence-arousal direction and intensity into adjustments of the agent's target utility. An asynchronous architecture updates CLIFER in the background during live interaction. In a counterbalanced within-subject study in which 66 participants negotiated with a humanoid robot, the CL-enabled agent achieved significantly higher individual utility and elicited higher participant concession rates than the FaceChannel baseline. The CL condition yielded significantly higher mean arousal estimates, alongside a broader output range. Participant utility and Nash distance did not change significantly between conditions. These outcomes support the practical value of coupling continual affective personalization with differential feedback for real-time negotiation.
items.abstract_zh: 与人类谈判的自利型智能体应解释非言语表达并相应调整其行为。然而，通用面部情感模型在个体和情境之间会退化，造成泛化差距。我们引入一种情感自适应谈判策略，该策略结合用于面部表情识别的想象持续学习（CLIFER），以实时个性化效价-唤醒度感知。差分反馈将效价-唤醒度方向和强度的变化转换为智能体目标效用的调整。异步架构在实时交互期间于后台更新CLIFER。在一项66名参与者与人形机器人谈判的平衡受试者内研究中，启用持续学习的智能体相比FaceChannel基线获得了显著更高的个体效用，并引发更高的参与者让步率。持续学习条件产生显著更高的平均唤醒度估计，同时输出范围更宽。参与者效用和纳什距离在不同条件之间没有显著变化。这些结果支持将持续情感个性化与差分反馈相结合用于实时谈判的实际价值。

items.title_en: AVCC: Audio-Visual Conversation Corpus for Turn-Taking Prediction with a Human Benchmark
items.title_zh: AVCC：用于轮次转换预测的视听对话语料库及人类基准
items.abstract_en: } Predicting who will speak next, and when, is a prerequisite for conversational agents and social robots that take turns without waiting for silence. Multiparty next-speaker prediction (NSP) has been studied on corpora with per-speaker sensors, each with its own event definitions. No public benchmark covers the single camera and microphone a robot has, and no model has been compared against how well people perform the same prediction. We turn AVCC, a 31-hour audio-visual corpus of two- and three-speaker online conversation recorded with a single static camera and microphone, into a public NSP benchmark. We add a speaker-disjoint seven-video test partition with 865 hold and 865 shift events at mutual-silence gaps, word-level forced-aligned transcripts for the whole corpus, and a human reference benchmark collected at the same events. We score an audio-only Role-Relative VAP model (RoleVAP) and the multimodal MuVAP model. Labels, transcripts, per-response human data, and the scripts that reproduce every number are released.
items.abstract_zh: 预测谁将接下来发言以及何时发言，是对话智能体和社交机器人无需等待静音即可进行轮次转换的前提。多方下一说话人预测（NSP）已在具有每位说话人独立传感器的语料库上研究，每个语料库有各自的事件定义。尚无公开基准覆盖机器人所具备的单个摄像头和麦克风，也没有模型与人类在同一预测任务上的表现进行比较。我们将 AVCC——一个使用单个静态摄像头和麦克风录制的、包含两人和三人在线对话的 31 小时视听语料库——转化为公开 NSP 基准。我们添加一个说话人不重叠的七视频测试分区，在相互静音间隙包含 865 个 hold 事件和 865 个 shift 事件；为整个语料库提供词级强制对齐转录；并在相同事件上收集人类参考基准。我们评估仅音频的角色相对 VAP 模型（RoleVAP）和多模态 MuVAP 模型。发布了标签、转录、逐响应人类数据以及可复现每个数值的脚本。

items.title_en: Large Language Model Explainability for Planning Lunar Rover Trajectories under Uncertainty
items.title_zh: 用于不确定性下月球车轨迹规划的大语言模型可解释性
items.abstract_en: Planning planetary rover trajectories under probabilistic uncertainty is a multi-objective optimization problem that science teams currently iteratively solve and verify by hand. This process becomes impractical when timelines and constraints frequently shift throughout the mission planning phase. Sampling-based planners such as Monte Carlo tree search can speed up this process, but their outputs do not preserve traceability to the science objectives that justify each plan, which the science team needs to verify. We propose an interactive assistant based on a large language model (LLM) that can explain planner trajectories using domain vocabulary and re-run the planner under user-specified conditions to compare alternatives. Previous work has used LLMs inside planner decision-making loops, but we explore using them for post-planning explanation, where they are more likely to be trusted since they do not directly influence planner decisions. Our framework pairs a simulator inspired by the NASA Volatiles Investigating Polar Exploration Rover (VIPER) mission with a ReAct queryable interface that calls curated action tools and retrieval functions. We evaluate the assistant on a query bank consisting of plan comparisons, feasibility, and lookup queries. Experiments show that 90.9% of the assistant's responses are faithful to the planner's outputs, a nearly 65% improvement over zero-shot prompting of the same LLM without tool access, demonstrating the potential for trustworthy explainability of uncertainty-aware traverses with an LLM-based system.
items.abstract_zh: 在概率不确定性下规划行星车轨迹是一个多目标优化问题，科学团队目前通过手工迭代求解和验证。当任务规划阶段时间线和约束频繁变化时，这一过程变得不切实际。基于采样的规划器如蒙特卡洛树搜索可以加速这一过程，但其输出不保留对证明每个计划合理的科学目标的可追溯性，而科学团队需要验证这一点。我们提出一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的交互式助手，它可以使用领域词汇解释规划器轨迹，并在用户指定条件下重新运行规划器以比较备选方案。先前工作已在规划器决策循环内使用 LLM，但我们探索将其用于规划后解释，在这种情况下它们更可能被信任，因为它们不直接影响规划器决策。我们的框架将受 NASA 挥发物调查极地探测车（VIPER）任务启发的模拟器与可 ReAct 查询的接口配对，该接口调用精选的动作工具和检索函数。我们在一个由计划比较、可行性和查找查询组成的查询库上评估该助手。实验表明，助手90.9%的响应忠实于规划器输出，相比同一 LLM 在无工具访问的零样本提示下提高近65%，展示了基于 LLM 的系统对不确定性感知遍历进行可信解释的潜力。

items.title_en: Scale-Consistent Monocular Fisheye Visual Odometry via Spherical Bundle Adjustment-Guided Unsupervised Depth Learning
items.title_zh: 通过球面光束法平差引导的无监督深度学习的尺度一致单目鱼眼视觉里程计
items.abstract_en: The wide field of view of fisheye cameras and the simplicity of a monocular setup make monocular fisheye visual odometry (VO) attractive for robotic localization and mapping. Nevertheless, scale drift remains a major challenge over long trajectories. Unsupervised depth learning can help to mitigate this issue, but the pronounced distortion of fisheye images poses challenges for accurate depth estimation. This article presents S$^2$D-FVO, a monocular fisheye VO framework integrating spherical bundle adjustment (SBA)-guided unsupervised depth learning to improve scale consistency and depth estimation accuracy. Given that pixel reprojection residuals do not uniformly reflect angular deviations between viewing rays and that the first-order linearization of a scalar angular reprojection residual is insensitive to perturbations along one tangent direction, SBA employs tangent-space angular reprojection residuals derived from the spherical logarithmic map. These residuals retain sensitivity along both tangent directions, with their norms equal to the corresponding scalar angular residuals. A median depth-based scale regularization term is further integrated into SBA to constrain the reconstruction scale. Building on these formulations, SBA replaces the pose estimation network during unsupervised depth learning, providing more reliable relative poses for view synthesis. In turn, depth estimates from the well-trained depth estimation network provide scale references for SBA, improving scale consistency while allowing individual 3-D landmark positions to be refined. Extensive experiments conducted on multiple public datasets, as well as two newly collected large-scale datasets, demonstrate that the proposed framework outperforms representative existing approaches in both depth and trajectory estimation accuracy and is applicable to different camera models.
items.abstract_zh: 鱼眼相机的宽视场和单目设置的简易性使单目鱼眼视觉里程计（VO）对机器人定位与建图具有吸引力。然而，尺度漂移在长轨迹中仍是主要挑战。无监督深度学习可帮助缓解此问题，但鱼眼图像的显著畸变给准确深度估计带来挑战。本文提出 S²D-FVO，一个单目鱼眼 VO 框架，集成球面光束法平差（SBA）引导的无监督深度学习，以提高尺度一致性和深度估计精度。鉴于像素重投影残差不能一致地反映视线之间的角度偏差，且标量角度重投影残差的一阶线性化对沿一个切方向的扰动不敏感，SBA 采用由球面对数映射导出的切空间角度重投影残差。这些残差在两个切方向上均保持敏感性，其范数等于相应的标量角度残差。进一步将基于中值深度的尺度正则项集成到 SBA 中以约束重建尺度。基于这些公式，SBA 在无监督深度学习过程中替代位姿估计网络，为视图合成提供更可靠的相对位姿。反过来，训练良好的深度估计网络得到的深度估计为 SBA 提供尺度参考，提高尺度一致性，同时允许细化各个三维地标位置。在多个公开数据集以及两个新采集的大规模数据集上进行的大量实验表明，所提框架在深度和轨迹估计精度上均优于代表性的现有方法，并适用于不同的相机模型。

items.title_en: On the minimum energy required to trigger a spike
items.title_zh: 关于触发尖峰所需的最小能量
items.abstract_en: We formulate and numerically study the problem of finding the minimum energy required to trigger a spike in a three-dimensional conductance-based excitable model. The variational formulation seeks a state trajectory that reaches the boundary of the spiking region with the least \textit{peak} cumulative work supplied through the membrane port. We approximate voltage histories by sums of real exponentials, reducing the problem to a finite-dimensional optimization. The best-found voltage waveform consists of a hyperpolarization phase followed by a depolarization phase, which seems to match the experimentally determined optimal stimulus in squid giant axons.
items.abstract_zh: 我们构建并数值研究在一个三维基于电导的可兴奋模型中寻找触发尖峰所需最小能量的问题。该变分表述寻找一条状态轨迹，其以通过膜端口提供的最小峰值累积功到达尖峰区域边界。我们用实指数之和近似电压历史，将问题简化为有限维优化。所找到的最佳电压波形由超极化阶段随后去极化阶段组成，这似乎与鱿鱼巨轴突中实验确定的最优刺激相匹配。

items.title_en: Weight-Space Programming of Variational Quantum Circuits: Large Language Models Write Quantum Circuit Parameters Without an Optimizer
items.title_zh: 变分量子电路的权重空间编程：大语言模型无需优化器即可编写量子电路参数
items.abstract_en: Variational quantum algorithms (VQAs) optimize circuit angles through repeated quantum-device evaluations, often facing vanishing gradients and high optimization costs. We ask whether a large language model (LLM) can write these angles directly. Extending *weight-space programming* from classical networks to quantum circuits, we provide a frontier LLM (\gpt) with the problem, circuit, and gate conventions. Its angles are executed exactly as written, without returning losses, gradients, or accuracy feedback. Across 139 requests, we test handwritten-digit classification, VQE ground-state estimation for spin chains and H$_2$, and MaxCut QAOA, comparing against random weights, classical optimization, and optimization initialized with LLM weights on the same circuit. When parameters have interpretable structure, the LLM matches or approaches the optimizer: it achieves 95--100\% of the energy spectrum on every VQE problem, derives the exact H$_2$ ground state in closed form, finds optimal depth-one QAOA angles for every graph, and reaches 93--96\% accuracy on digits 3 versus 8 with 12--18 hand-written weights, outperforming an optimizer trained on the same ten examples. Its weights are also strong warm starts: optimization reaches its best value after a median of one evaluation rather than hundreds. Allowed to design circuits, the LLM chooses data-dependent rotation chains encoding pixel importance in all 30 cases (one qubit for binary tasks, one chain per qubit for ten classes), reaching 65\% accuracy across ten digits. Yet the approach fails in opaque weight spaces: accuracy drops to chance when fixed circuits exceed 30 weights, while optimization improves. It is also sensitive to gate conventions: 6 of 42 QAOA replies reverse mixing-angle signs and fail. We release all prompts, replies, and scores.
items.abstract_zh: 变分量子算法（VQA）通过重复的量子设备评估来优化电路角度，常面临梯度消失和高优化成本。我们询问大语言模型（LLM）能否直接写出这些角度。我们将权重空间编程从经典网络扩展到量子电路，向一个前沿 LLM（\gpt）提供问题、电路和门约定。其角度完全按所写执行，不返回损失、梯度或准确率反馈。在 139 个请求中，我们测试手写数字分类、自旋链和 H$_2$ 的 VQE 基态估计以及 MaxCut QAOA，并与随机权重、经典优化以及在同一电路上用 LLM 权重初始化的优化进行比较。当参数具有可解释结构时，LLM 匹配或接近优化器：它在每个 VQE 问题上达到能谱的 95--100%，以闭式推导出精确的 H$_2$ 基态，为每个图找到最优深度一 QAOA 角度，并在 12--18 个手写权重下对数字 3 与 8 达到 93--96% 的准确率，优于在相同十个样本上训练的优化器。其权重也是强热启动：优化在中位一次评估后而非数百次后达到最佳值。允许设计电路时，LLM 在所有 30 个案例中选择编码像素重要性的数据依赖旋转链（二分类任务一个量子比特，十分类每个量子比特一条链），在十个数字上达到 65% 准确率。然而，该方法在不透明权重空间中失败：当固定电路超过 30 个权重时准确率降至随机水平，而优化会改善。它还对门约定敏感：42 个 QAOA 回复中有 6 个反转混合角符号并失败。我们发布所有提示、回复和分数。

items.title_en: Dual-Core Tensor Wheel Decomposition with Structure-Cached Acceleration for Tensor Recovery
items.title_zh: 用于张量恢复的双核张量轮分解与结构缓存加速
items.abstract_en: Tensor wheel decomposition captures complex correlations in high-dimensional data through interactions between outer-ring factors and a high-order central core. However, updating these components requires the explicit construction and manipulation of large-scale matrices, which limits computational efficiency and incurs particularly high computational and memory costs for the central-core update. To address these limitations, we propose dual-core tensor wheel decomposition (DCTW), which factorizes the central core into two lower-order cores linked by a shared latent bond. Each core is coupled to a different group of outer-ring factors. We further propose a structure-cached acceleration strategy that avoids explicit large-scale matrix multi- plications and caches intermediate tensors generated during tensor network contractions for reuse across block updates. This reuse reduces redundant computation and avoids the explicit construction of large matrices. Complexity analysis and experiments show that the strategy based on structural caching accelerates optimization compared with explicit and implicit up- date schemes while limiting the increase in peak memory as the ranks grow. Experiments on color video completion and robust denoising show that DCTW matches or outperforms representative tensor network methods in reconstruction quality, computational efficiency, and scalability.
items.abstract_zh: 张量轮分解通过外环因子与高阶中心核之间的交互来捕捉高维数据中的复杂相关性。然而，更新这些组件需要显式构造和操作大规模矩阵，这限制了计算效率，并且为中心核更新带来特别高的计算和内存成本。为解决这些限制，我们提出双核张量轮分解（DCTW），它将中心核分解为两个由共享潜在键连接的低阶核。每个核与不同组的外环因子耦合。我们进一步提出一种结构缓存加速策略，避免显式大规模矩阵乘法，并缓存张量网络收缩过程中生成的中间张量，以便在块更新之间复用。这种复用减少了冗余计算，并避免了大型矩阵的显式构造。复杂度分析和实验表明，与显式和隐式更新方案相比，基于结构缓存的策略加速了优化，同时限制了秩增大时峰值内存的增长。在彩色视频补全和鲁棒去噪上的实验表明，DCTW在重建质量、计算效率和可扩展性方面达到或优于代表性张量网络方法。

items.title_en: Repository-Context-Guided Image Understanding for Agentic Software Development
items.title_zh: 用于智能体软件开发的仓库上下文引导图像理解
items.abstract_en: Coding agents increasingly receive UI screenshots as part of bug reports, yet degraded image quality - caused by low resolution, compression artifacts, or small rendered text - can prevent them from identifying the relevant UI elements and source files. Vision-language models become less reliable as image quality deteriorates, while OCR-assisted approaches may propagate recognition errors from degraded inputs. Both approaches are limited when the visual evidence required for localization is no longer clearly observable in the query screenshot. We propose augmenting coding agents with repository-rendered reference images: crisp screenshots generated from the same codebase that the agent is tasked with modifying. These references provide readable visual evidence of the application's UI while preserving the current, potentially bug-containing implementation state. Because they are generated from the available repository rather than requiring a known bug-free version, they can be produced automatically for reproducible application states without manual image annotation. We evaluate the approach on a controlled benchmark derived from SWE-bench Multimodal by injecting visual UI bugs into a real web application. We vary screenshot degradation and reference-image provision and measure whether the coding agent identifies the correct source file. The results show that reference images improve file localization especially for degraded image quality, increasing the gold file match rate under fourfold downsampling with JPEG compression. We confirmed with further analysis that the proposed approach recognizes text approximately 12 percentage points better than language biased OCR under the same degradation.
items.abstract_zh: 编码智能体越来越多地收到作为缺陷报告一部分的 UI 截图，但图像质量下降——由低分辨率、压缩伪影或渲染文本过小造成——可能阻止其识别相关 UI 元素和源文件。当图像质量下降时，视觉语言模型变得不那么可靠，而 OCR 辅助方法可能传播来自退化输入的识别错误。当定位所需的视觉证据在查询截图中不再清晰可观察时，两种方法都受限。我们提出为编码智能体增强仓库渲染的参考图像：由智能体任务所要修改的同一代码库生成的清晰截图。这些参考提供应用 UI 的可读视觉证据，同时保留当前可能包含缺陷的实现状态。由于它们从可用仓库生成，而不需要已知无缺陷版本，因此可以针对可复现的应用状态自动生成，无需手动图像标注。我们在由 SWE-bench Multimodal 衍生的受控基准上评估该方法，通过向真实 Web 应用注入视觉 UI 缺陷。我们改变截图退化程度和参考图像提供情况，并测量编码智能体是否识别正确的源文件。结果表明，参考图像改善了文件定位，尤其是在图像质量退化时，在四倍下采样并 JPEG 压缩下提高了金标文件匹配率。我们通过进一步分析确认，在相同退化下，所提方法识别文本的准确率比语言偏置 OCR 高约12个百分点。

items.title_en: CSG-Nav: Confidence-Aware Semantic-Geometric Fusion for Robust Exploration and Accurate Zero-Shot Object-Goal Navigation
items.title_zh: CSG-Nav：面向鲁棒探索与准确零样本物体目标导航的置信度感知语义-几何融合
items.abstract_en: Zero-shot object-goal navigation requires autonomous agents to explore unseen environments and locate target objects without task-specific training, posing challenges in perceptual reliability under observation uncertainty and physically grounded goal termination. Although foundation-model-based approaches improve generalization, they remain vulnerable to unreliable long-range perception, hallucination-induced directional bias, and semantically plausible but geometrically incorrect stopping decisions. To address these limitations, we propose CSG-Nav, a zero-shot navigation framework centered on confidence-aware multimodal information fusion. CSG-Nav integrates three complementary fusion mechanisms. First, semantic-source fusion integrates open-vocabulary detection results, detection confidence, scene observations, and relational reasoning to produce more reliable direction-level semantic scores and suppress hallucination-induced directional bias. Second, spatial-confidence fusion weights multi-view semantic evidence using a Gaussian decay function, suppressing unreliable distant observations while accumulating spatially consistent exploration preferences. Third, semantic-geometric decision fusion combines semantic target detection with depth-based 3D localization to support physically grounded stopping decisions. Experiments on HM3Dv1, HM3Dv2, and MP3D demonstrate competitive zero-shot performance, achieving success rates of 58.9%, 71.6%, and 44.3%. Fusion-level ablations and real-world deployments in indoor and outdoor environments further verify the effectiveness and practicality of CSG-Nav for robust navigation under uncertain perception. Code is available at https://xr-ui.github.io/CSGNav.github.io/
items.abstract_zh: 零样本物体目标导航要求自主智能体在没有任务特定训练的情况下探索未见环境并定位目标物体，这在观测不确定性下的感知可靠性以及物理上合理的目标终止方面带来挑战。尽管基于基础模型的方法提高了泛化能力，但它们仍然容易受到不可靠的远距离感知、幻觉引起的方向偏差，以及语义上合理但几何上不正确的停止决策的影响。为解决这些限制，我们提出CSG-Nav，一个以置信度感知多模态信息融合为核心的零样本导航框架。CSG-Nav集成了三种互补的融合机制。第一，语义来源融合整合开放词汇检测结果、检测置信度、场景观测和关系推理，以产生更可靠的方向级语义分数，并抑制幻觉引起的方向偏差。第二，空间置信度融合使用高斯衰减函数对多视角语义证据加权，抑制不可靠的远距离观测，同时累积空间一致的探索偏好。第三，语义-几何决策融合将语义目标检测与基于深度的3D定位相结合，以支持物理上合理的停止决策。在HM3Dv1、HM3Dv2和MP3D上的实验展示了有竞争力的零样本性能，成功率分别达到58.9%、71.6%和44.3%。融合层面的消融实验以及在室内外环境中的真实世界部署进一步验证了CSG-Nav在不确定感知下进行鲁棒导航的有效性和实用性。代码见 https://xr-ui.github.io/CSGNav.github.io/

items.title_en: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
items.abstract_en: We present a method that achieves state-of-the-art results for synthesizing novel views of complex scenes by optimizing an underlying continuous volumetric scene function using a sparse set of input views. Our algorithm represents a scene using a fully-connected (non-convolutional) deep network, whose input is a single continuous 5D coordinate (spatial location $(x,y,z)$ and viewing direction $(θ, φ)$) and whose output is the volume density and view-dependent emitted radiance at that spatial location. We synthesize views by querying 5D coordinates along camera rays and use classic volume rendering techniques to project the output colors and densities into an image. Because volume rendering is naturally differentiable, the only input required to optimize our representation is a set of images with known camera poses. We describe how to effectively optimize neural radiance fields to render photorealistic novel views of scenes with complicated geometry and appearance, and demonstrate results that outperform prior work on neural rendering and view synthesis. View synthesis results are best viewed as videos, so we urge readers to view our supplementary video for convincing comparisons.

items.title_zh: NeRF：将场景表示为用于视图合成的神经辐射场
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种方法，通过使用稀疏的输入视图集优化底层连续体积场景函数，在合成复杂场景的新视图方面取得了最先进的结果。我们的算法使用全连接（非卷积）深度网络表示场景，其输入是单个连续的 5D 坐标（空间位置 $(x,y,z)$ 和观察方向 $(θ, φ)$），输出是该空间位置处的体积密度和与视图相关的发射辐射度。我们通过沿相机光线查询 5D 坐标来合成视图，并使用经典体积渲染技术将输出的颜色和密度投影到图像中。由于体积渲染天然可微，优化我们的表示所需的唯一输入是一组已知相机位姿的图像。我们描述了如何有效优化神经辐射场，以渲染具有复杂几何形状和外观的场景的逼真新视图，并展示了优于先前神经渲染和视图合成工作的结果。视图合成结果最好以视频形式观看，因此我们敦促读者观看我们的补充视频以进行有说服力的比较。

items.title_en: Short-term changes in a chicken comb vascular model mimicking port-wine stain after synchronous ultrasound parallel beam treatment: an exploratory study
items.title_zh: 模拟鲜红斑痣的鸡冠血管模型在同步超声平行束治疗后的短期变化：一项探索性研究
items.abstract_en: Synchronous ultrasound parallel beam (SUPERB) technology heats the mid-dermis without relying on hemoglobin as an optical chromophore, but its effect on the cutaneous microvasculature has not been reported. We examined short-term responses of a hypervascular chicken comb model to SUPERB treatment combined with applicator compression. In six adult roosters, two sites on the left comb surface each received a single pulse of 3 to 5 J after compression blanching, and the right surface served as a within-animal control. Full-thickness biopsies were taken immediately after treatment and on days 3 and 7; one rooster died on day 2, leaving five for analysis. Hematoxylin and eosin sections were assessed descriptively by a blinded pathologist, and vascular endothelial growth factor A (VEGF-A) positive area and Masson collagen area were quantified on day 7 at the animal level. Reduced microvascular caliber and fewer intraluminal erythrocytes were recorded at 1 of 10 sites immediately after treatment, 8 of 10 sites on day 3 and 8 of 9 evaluable sites on day 7. On day 7, VEGF-A positive area was lower on the treated side in all five animals (11.5% vs. 20.5%; mean paired difference -9.1 percentage points, 95% confidence interval -13.3 to -4.9; exact Wilcoxon p = 0.0625, the smallest value attainable with five pairs). Collagen area did not change consistently. Tissue temperature and perfusion were not measured, and no sham-compression group was included. These hypothesis-generating findings support controlled studies that separate the effects of compression and ultrasound energy.
items.abstract_zh: 同步超声平行束（SUPERB）技术无需依赖血红蛋白作为光学色基即可加热真皮中层，但其对皮肤微血管的作用尚未见报道。我们在富血管鸡冠模型中考察了SUPERB治疗联合探头压迫后的短期反应。在六只成年公鸡中，左侧鸡冠表面的两个位点分别在压迫变白后接受单次3至5 J脉冲，右侧表面作为同体对照。治疗后立即以及第3天和第7天取全层活检；一只公鸡在第2天死亡，余下五只纳入分析。苏木精-伊红切片由一名盲法病理学家进行描述性评估，并在第7天于动物水平量化血管内皮生长因子A（VEGF-A）阳性面积和Masson胶原面积。治疗后即刻10个位点中有1个、第3天10个位点中有8个、第7天9个可评估位点中有8个记录到微血管管径减小和管腔内红细胞减少。第7天，五只动物治疗侧的VEGF-A阳性面积均较低（11.5% vs. 20.5%；平均配对差值−9.1个百分点，95%置信区间−13.3至−4.9；精确Wilcoxon p=0.0625，为五对样本可达到的最小值）。胶原面积无一致变化。未测量组织温度和灌注，也未设置假压迫组。这些产生假设的发现支持开展受控研究，以区分压迫和超声能量的效应。

items.title_en: High-sensitivity sensing technology of 10 MHz radio frequency electric field based on Rydberg atoms
items.title_zh: 基于里德堡原子的10 MHz射频电场高灵敏度传感技术
items.abstract_en: To address the pressing need for high-sensitivity, miniaturized electric field sensors in the short-wave communication band (3-30 MHz), this study proposes and demonstrates a radio frequency electric field quantum sensing scheme based on cesium atomic Rydberg states and the electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT) effect. The scheme employs an all-infrared optical design, utilizing 852 nm probe light, 1470 nm dressing light, and 780 nm coupling light to efficiently prepare the 49P3/2 Rydberg state in a room-temperature cesium vapor cell, which is then probed non-destructively via ladder-type four-level EIT spectroscopy.
items.abstract_zh: 为满足短波通信频段（3-30 MHz）对高灵敏度、小型化电场传感器的迫切需求，本研究提出并演示了一种基于铯原子里德堡态和电磁诱导透明（EIT）效应的射频电场量子传感方案。该方案采用全红外光学设计，利用852 nm探测光、1470 nm缀饰光和780 nm耦合光，在室温铯蒸气池中高效制备49P3/2里德堡态，然后通过梯形四能级EIT光谱对其进行无损探测。

items.title_en: Symmetry in Time: A Representation Theory of Linear Recurrent Memory
items.title_zh: 时间中的对称性：线性循环记忆的表示理论
items.abstract_en: State space models (SSMs) are an emerging alternative to Transformers. SSMs offer linear-time inference and parallel training, but most implementations make the parallel scan efficient by making the recurrence diagonal: each channel of the hidden state is multiplied by an input-dependent real or complex number. These numbers commute, so the state records which inputs occurred but not their order. We formalize this with representation theory, which explains and fixes the state-tracking failures previously reported for SSMs. The state update defines a linear representation of the monoid of input sequences, and we show that an SSM tracks a group at every sequence length exactly when that group is a quotient of the group generated by its transition matrices. Two consequences follow. Diagonal real- and complex-valued SSMs can track only commutative groups, while the transition matrices of any SSM that can track a group must split into independent blocks over the real, complex, and quaternion numbers. We then introduce HyperSSM, which adds quaternion channels while keeping linear-time inference and parallel training. Trained only on final answers, HyperSSM solves the group tasks of recent state-tracking benchmarks exactly with at most five state numbers. This includes $S_5$ with 32 generators, where previous SSMs are at chance, and HyperSSM generalizes to sequences 25 times longer than those seen in training. Because the theory says what the transitions must encode, the learned weights of the linear recurrence can be interpreted directly. We demonstrate this by recovering the calibration of a real gyroscope, the rotations of imperfect qubit gates and the geometry of protein backbones.
items.abstract_zh: 状态空间模型（SSM）是 Transformer 的新兴替代方案。SSM 提供线性时间推理和并行训练，但大多数实现通过使循环对角化来使并行扫描高效：隐藏状态的每个通道乘以一个依赖输入的实数或复数。这些数可交换，因此状态记录发生了哪些输入，但不记录其顺序。我们用表示理论将其形式化，这解释并修复了先前报道的 SSM 状态跟踪失败。状态更新定义了输入序列幺半群的一个线性表示，并且我们表明，一个 SSM 在每种序列长度上都能跟踪一个群，当且仅当该群是由其转移矩阵生成的群的商群。由此得到两个推论。对角实值和复值 SSM 只能跟踪交换群，而任何能够跟踪一个群的 SSM 的转移矩阵必须在实数、复数和四元数上分解为独立块。然后我们引入 HyperSSM，它增加四元数通道，同时保持线性时间推理和并行训练。仅在最终答案上训练，HyperSSM 以至多五个状态数精确求解近期状态跟踪基准中的群任务。这包括具有 32 个生成元的 $S_5$，而先前的 SSM 在此处于随机水平，并且 HyperSSM 可泛化到比训练中所见序列长 25 倍的序列。由于理论说明了转移必须编码什么，线性循环的学习权重可以直接解释。我们通过恢复真实陀螺仪的校准、不完美量子比特门的旋转以及蛋白质骨架的几何结构来证明这一点。

items.title_en: Blind Variation, Selective Retention: Improving Creative Idea Generation in AI Scientists
items.title_zh: 盲变异、选择性保留：改进AI科学家的创意想法生成
items.abstract_en: Scientific discovery requires ideas that are original, useful, and non-obvious. Yet AI scientists are typically given as much task information as possible during idea generation, which can anchor generation toward familiar approaches. Inspired by the cognitive framework of Blind Variation and Selective Retention (BVSR), we propose a discovery framework that separates these two roles of information: it generates proposals under deliberately limited task information to broaden exploration, then learns from proposals previously verified on the same task and their outcomes to retain promising candidates for costly empirical evaluation. We evaluate BVSR across five proposer models and 12 scientific tasks. Limiting task information substantially increases proposal originality and non-obviousness, and produces a larger share of highly creative and high-utility proposals than existing state-of-the-art prompting-based baselines. Learning from prior proposal outcomes on the task further improves candidate selection, discarding half of the candidates while retaining most top-performing proposals. When incorporated into existing AI-scientist workflows, BVSR achieves stronger discoveries across gene expression analysis, drug response prediction, anomaly detection, scaling law discovery, and brain activity prediction. These results suggest that effective AI scientists should use information differently across stages of discovery: constrain task-specific information during exploration while exploiting accumulated empirical experience on the task.
items.abstract_zh: 科学发现需要原创、有用且非显而易见的想法。然而，AI科学家在想法生成时通常被给予尽可能多的任务信息，这可能会将生成锚定到熟悉的方法。受盲变异与选择性保留（BVSR）认知框架启发，我们提出一个发现框架，将信息的这两种角色分开：它在刻意有限的任务信息下生成提案以拓宽探索，然后从先前在同一任务上验证的提案及其结果中学习，以保留有希望的候选者用于昂贵的实证评估。我们在五个提案模型和12个科学任务上评估BVSR。限制任务信息大幅提高提案的原创性和非显而易见性，并比现有最先进的基于提示的基线产生更大比例的高创意和高实用性提案。从任务上先前提案结果中学习进一步改善候选选择，丢弃一半候选者，同时保留大多数表现最佳的提案。当纳入现有AI科学家工作流时，BVSR在基因表达分析、药物反应预测、异常检测、缩放定律发现和大脑活动预测中实现更强的发现。这些结果表明，有效的AI科学家应在发现的不同阶段以不同方式使用信息：在探索期间约束任务特定信息，同时利用任务上积累的实证经验。

items.title_en: UAV-Flow++: A Unified Suite for Benchmarking and Learning Language-Guided UAV Flight
items.title_zh: UAV-Flow++：用于基准测试与学习语言引导无人机飞行的统一套件
items.abstract_en: Language-guided UAV navigation has largely focused on long-horizon route planning, leaving short-range, object-relative flight maneuvers underexplored. To address this gap, we formulate Flying-on-a-Word (Flow), a task requiring a UAV to convert concise natural-language instruction, egocentric visual observation, and current state dynamics into continuous flight actions. Flow encompasses both primitive motion commands and complex object-interactive behaviors, assessing motion intent comprehension and spatial context grounding. To enable policy learning and closed-loop evaluation, we introduce UAV-Flow, a comprehensive dataset comprising 30,692 expert-piloted real-world trajectories across eight distinct motion categories, alongside 10,109 simulation trajectories in the UAV-Flow-Sim environment equipped with task-specific completion criteria. Furthermore, we develop FlowVLA, which undergoes imitation pretraining on mixed real-sim demonstrations and online post-training via Tail-Aware GRPO (TGRPO). By leveraging group reward distributions, TGRPO effectively reinforces high-reward action sequences. Evaluated on 273 held-out UAV-Flow-Sim episodes, pretrained FlowVLA achieves a mean success rate of 75.58%, outperforming the strongest baseline by 6.72 percentage points, which TGRPO post-training further elevates to 93.16% with superior sample efficiency. Physical UAV experiments demonstrate robust execution of object-relative commands in both indoor and outdoor real-world scenes. Together, Flow establishes a novel benchmark and learning framework for language-conditioned flight maneuvers.
items.abstract_zh: 语言引导的无人机导航在很大程度上集中于长时程路径规划，而短程、相对于物体的飞行机动仍探索不足。为弥补这一空白，我们提出 Flying-on-a-Word（Flow）任务，要求无人机将简洁的自然语言指令、以自我为中心的视觉观测和当前状态动力学转化为连续飞行动作。Flow 涵盖基本运动命令和复杂的物体交互行为，评估运动意图理解与空间上下文基础定位。为支持策略学习与闭环评估，我们引入 UAV-Flow，这是一个综合数据集，包含跨越八个不同运动类别的 30,692 条专家操控真实世界轨迹，以及 UAV-Flow-Sim 环境中配备任务特定完成标准的 10,109 条仿真轨迹。此外，我们开发 FlowVLA，其在混合真实-仿真演示上进行模仿预训练，并通过 Tail-Aware GRPO（TGRPO）进行在线后训练。通过利用组奖励分布，TGRPO 有效强化高奖励动作序列。在 273 个留出的 UAV-Flow-Sim 回合上评估，预训练 FlowVLA 取得 75.58% 的平均成功率，比最强基线高 6.72 个百分点，TGRPO 后训练进一步将其提升至 93.16%，并具有更优的样本效率。物理无人机实验证明，在室内和室外真实场景中均能稳健执行相对于物体的命令。总之，Flow 为语言条件飞行机动建立了一个新的基准和学习框架。

items.title_en: Duo: A Reciprocal World Model for Full-Duplex Interaction
items.title_zh: Duo：用于全双工交互的互惠世界模型
items.abstract_en: In this report, we introduce the Reciprocal World Model (RWM) and present Duo v1, a full-duplex world model that continuously perceives audiovisual inputs while responding to users in real time. The RWM treats intelligence and physical reality as equally fundamental to what constitutes a world. Existing world models largely focus on simulating the latter, leaving reasoning and decision-making as external controls rather than intrinsic parts of the world itself. In RWM, we identify two equally fundamental capabilities: Intent, which provides the cognition underlying world interactions, and Realization, which generates coherent audio-visual behavior. To realize this formulation, Duo v1 introduces three key technical designs: (1) Leveraging autoregressive modeling for continuous interaction reasoning and participation decisions, rather than restricting it to instruction understanding for diffusion models. (2) Constructing chunk-specific conditions and synchronize tokens across Intent and Realization on a unified timeline. Module-specific attention masks enforce causal dependencies both within and across chunks, preventing access to future inputs. (3) Mitigating distribution shift in both modules through dual rollout distillation, training on autoregressively generated Intent tokens and synthesized audiovisual histories from Realization. Both modules continuously perceive real-time audio, video, and text, enabling full-duplex interaction with spontaneous conversations and interruptions. Beyond conversation, users can share real objects, reshape virtual scenes, guide assistants, or play audiovisual games without mouse or keyboard controls. The release of Duo v1 makes our first step, with the next version coming soon. We look forward to broader exploration of this emerging field.
items.abstract_zh: 在本报告中，我们介绍互惠世界模型（Reciprocal World Model, RWM），并提出 Duo v1，这是一个全双工世界模型，可连续感知视听输入，同时实时回应用户。RWM 将智能与物理现实视为构成世界的同等基本要素。现有世界模型大多侧重于模拟后者，将推理和决策留作外部控制，而非世界本身的内在组成部分。在 RWM 中，我们识别出两种同等基本的能力：Intent，其为世界交互提供底层认知；以及 Realization，其生成连贯的视听行为。为实现这一表述，Duo v1 引入三项关键技术设计：（1）利用自回归建模进行连续交互推理和参与决策，而不是将其限制为扩散模型的指令理解。（2）构建块特定条件，并在统一时间线上同步 Intent 与 Realization 的 token。模块特定注意力掩码在块内和块间强制因果依赖，防止访问未来输入。（3）通过双 rollout 蒸馏缓解两个模块中的分布偏移，在自回归生成的 Intent token 和由 Realization 合成的视听历史进行训练。两个模块连续感知实时音频、视频和文本，从而实现具有自发对话和打断的全双工交互。除对话之外，用户无需鼠标或键盘控制即可分享真实物体、重塑虚拟场景、引导助手或玩视听游戏。Duo v1 的发布迈出了我们的第一步，下一版本即将推出。我们期待对这一新兴领域进行更广泛的探索。

items.title_en: User Experience of a Rehab Community-Based, Affordable Robot Exercise System (Rehab CARES) for Gamified Motor and Cognitive Stroke Rehabilitation
items.title_zh: 用于游戏化运动与认知卒中康复的社区康复低成本机器人锻炼系统（Rehab CARES）的用户体验
items.abstract_en: Purpose: Robot-assisted therapy predominantly targets motor impairment, although post-stroke motor and cognitive impairments co-occur. We report user experience in a longitudinal deployment of a Rehab Community-based Affordable Robot Exercise System (RehabCARES) for delivering personalized motor/cognitive training. Methods: Six adults with chronic stroke (FM-UE 20-61; MoCA 22-28) completed 12 therapy visits with THEAbot, a reconfigurable 1-DoF robot. Rehab CARES also included a haptic/biometric dynamic difficulty adjustment controller and eight games characterized by cognitive processes and motor/cognitive demand. We report gaming preference, usage, and user experience (pain, exertion, usability, affect, workload) across therapy. Results: User experience varied, but generally, self-reported pain was low, perceived exertion was light to moderate, enjoyment was strong and stable, and sense of control increased while excitement plateaued. Workload showed decreasing frustration and effort. Game selection during therapy was partially consistent with motor/cognitive clinical profiles; preferences and perceptual abilities may have influenced choices. Usability scores exceeded acceptability at all time points, peaking at the final visit (86 +/- 4.5 out of 100). Conclusions: RehabCARES provided personalized motor/cognitive training to a heterogeneous cohort in a community-based setting, delivering a positive user experience. Hardware reconfigurability and motor/cognitive game variety likely enabled this success.
items.abstract_zh: 目的：机器人辅助治疗主要针对运动障碍，尽管卒中后运动和认知障碍常同时发生。我们报告在纵向部署用于提供个性化运动/认知训练的社区康复低成本机器人锻炼系统（RehabCARES）中的用户体验。方法：六名慢性卒中成人（FM-UE 20-61；MoCA 22-28）完成了12次使用 THEAbot 的治疗访视，THEAbot 是一种可重构单自由度机器人。Rehab CARES 还包括触觉/生物特征动态难度调整控制器和八款以认知过程及运动/认知需求为特征的游戏。我们报告整个治疗过程中的游戏偏好、使用情况和用户体验（疼痛、用力、可用性、情感、工作负荷）。结果：用户体验各异，但总体而言，自我报告的疼痛较低，感知用力为轻至中度，愉悦感强烈且稳定，控制感增加而兴奋感趋于平稳。工作负荷显示挫败感和努力程度下降。治疗期间的 games selection 部分与运动/认知临床特征一致；偏好和感知能力可能影响了选择。可用性得分在所有时间点均超过可接受性，在最后一次访视达到峰值（86 +/- 4.5，满分100）。结论：RehabCARES 在社区环境中为异质性队列提供了个性化运动/认知训练，带来了积极的用户体验。硬件可重构性和运动/认知游戏多样性可能促成了这一成功。

items.title_en: Traces of Vacuum Squeezing: A Superconducting Transmission-Line Analogue of Cosmological Particle Creation
items.title_zh: 真空压缩的痕迹：宇宙学粒子产生的超导传输线类比
items.abstract_en: Particle creation in time-dependent quantum fields is a central phenomenon in early-universe cosmology, yet it remains experimentally inaccessible in its original context. We show theoretically that superconducting circuits based on a waveguide-like transmission line loaded with dc-SQUIDs can provide a direct analogue of a scalar field in a radiation-dominated Friedmann--Robertson--Walker universe in conformal time. The mode equation of the circuit reduces to the Weber equation, the same equation governing cosmological particle creation in a radiation-dominated background, admitting an exact solution in terms of parabolic cylinder functions and an exponentially suppressed particle spectrum. We analyse the conditions under which the analogy holds, which require a compromise between the duration of the pulse, the uniformity of the modulation and the symmetry of the SQUIDs, and show that dissipation does not erase the cosmological signal. We use the anomalous moment of each mode as a witness of the Bogoliubov mixing: it vanishes for any thermal state and survives dissipation, and, together with the photon number, it certifies squeezing, and with the purity of the state, it identifies whether the pairs created from the vacuum dominate.
items.abstract_zh: 含时量子场中的粒子产生是早期宇宙宇宙学的核心现象，但在其原始语境中仍无法通过实验触及。我们从理论上表明，基于加载直流 SQUID 的类波导传输线的超导电路，可以在共形时间中直接类比辐射主导的 Friedmann–Robertson–Walker 宇宙中的标量场。电路的模式方程可约化为 Weber 方程，该方程与辐射主导背景下控制宇宙学粒子产生的方程相同，并允许以抛物柱函数表示精确解以及指数抑制的粒子谱。我们分析该类比成立的条件，这些条件要求在脉冲持续时间、调制均匀性和 SQUID 对称性之间取得折中，并表明耗散不会抹除宇宙学信号。我们使用每个模式的反常矩作为 Bogoliubov 混合的见证：它对任何热态都消失，并在耗散下存留；它与光子数一起证明压缩，并与态纯度一起识别从真空产生的对是否占主导。

items.title_en: An Invariant Neural-Network Eddy-Viscosity Closure with Iterative Solver Coupling for Molten Salt Fast Reactor Thermal-Hydraulics
items.title_zh: 用于熔盐快堆热工水力的、具有迭代求解器耦合的不变神经网络涡黏性闭合
items.abstract_en: System thermal-hydraulics codes such as the System Analysis Module (SAM) close turbulence on coarse meshes with algebraic zero-equation mixing-length models. These models cannot represent the non-equilibrium turbulence, flow separation, and large-scale recirculation of open-cavity advanced reactors. We develop an invariant neural-network eddy-viscosity closure for SAM and apply it to the Molten Salt Fast Reactor (MSFR). The closure predicts the turbulent kinetic energy and timescale of each element from the flow and geometry of its neighbors, without solving turbulence transport equations. The resulting non-negative eddy viscosity enters the implicit diffusive operator, which keeps the momentum equations well conditioned. We prove that the closure is exactly invariant to translation, Galilean boost, rotation, reflection, and neighbor ordering. A network trained on high-order Nek5000 fields sees a different feature distribution on the coarse SAM mesh. We remove this covariate shift by iteratively retraining the network on SAM flow states against fixed Nek5000 targets. For a held-out steady state, the coupled closure reproduces the single recirculation cell and eddy-viscosity plume of the Nek5000 reference. In a 120 s pump-coastdown transient, it halves the velocity error of the mixing-length model, from 37.6% to 17.7%, and matches the Nek5000 eddy viscosity with a time-averaged relative error of 12%. The remaining velocity error comes from the coarse mesh. The coupled transient takes about 0.2 core-hours, compared with about 330 core-hours for Nek5000. The results show that the closure can recover two-equation RANS turbulence behavior in a coarse-mesh system code at a small fraction of the CFD cost.
items.abstract_zh: 诸如系统分析模块（SAM）之类的系统热工水力程序，在粗网格上使用代数零方程混合长度模型来封闭湍流。这些模型无法表示开放腔式先进反应堆的非平衡湍流、流动分离和大尺度回流。我们为 SAM 开发一种不变神经网络涡黏性闭合，并将其应用于熔盐快堆（MSFR）。该闭合根据每个单元邻域的流动与几何预测该单元的湍动能和时间尺度，而无需求解湍流输运方程。所得的非负涡黏性进入隐式扩散算子，从而使动量方程保持良态。我们证明该闭合对平移、伽利略助推、旋转、反射和邻域排序精确不变。在高阶 Nek5000 场上训练的网络，在粗 SAM 网格上会看到不同的特征分布。我们通过在 SAM 流动状态上针对固定的 Nek5000 目标迭代重新训练网络，来消除这种协变量偏移。对于留出的稳态，耦合闭合再现了 Nek5000 参考中的单一回流胞和涡黏性羽流。在 120 s 泵惰转瞬态中，它将混合长度模型的速度误差减半，从 37.6% 降至 17.7%，并以 12% 的时间平均相对误差匹配 Nek5000 涡黏性。剩余速度误差来自粗网格。耦合瞬态计算约需 0.2 核时，而 Nek5000 约需 330 核时。结果表明，该闭合能够在粗网格系统程序中以很小的 CFD 成本占比恢复两方程 RANS 湍流行为。

items.title_en: Visual Similarity in Adult Word Extension and Artificial Word Learning
items.title_zh: 成人词语扩展和人工词语学习中的视觉相似性
items.abstract_en: When two objects share a name, how much does their visual similarity explain, and what do the teaching examples add? First, we reanalyzed trial-level data from a large adult word-extension study (Lewis & Frank, 2018), computing each test image's distance to the examples shown in the space of a frozen self-supervised visual encoder (DINOv2). Distance was associated with extension (log odds -3.23 per standard deviation; 520 people), and an exploratory post hoc analysis suggested that this association persisted within the taught domain after controlling for taxonomic level and teaching condition. Example composition also mattered: after three examples, adults extended a word to 1.1% of superordinate items when the examples were subordinate and to 77.5% when they were superordinate. Second, in an artificial learner using the same encoder, words joining two categories were learned less accurately the farther apart the categories were (84.7%, 65.4%, and 53.0% naming accuracy for near, mid, and far pairs). The encoder's distances correlated with human similarity and confusability measures from three datasets (rho = .501-.795), but this representational alignment did not translate into conclusive evidence that human-derived distances predict learner difficulty, and a second encoder trained on one child's experience reproduced the tier ordering but not the pair-level effect. The secondary human data were analyzed under an internal plan fixed before the confirmatory analyses (not externally preregistered). Visual similarity accounts for part of how generalization is organized in both systems, while the composition of examples contributes what the distance we used does not capture.
items.abstract_zh: 当两个物体共享一个名称时，它们的视觉相似性解释了多少，教学示例又增加了什么？首先，我们重新分析了来自一项大型成人词语扩展研究（Lewis & Frank, 2018）的试次级数据，在冻结的自监督视觉编码器（DINOv2）空间中计算每张测试图像与所示示例的距离。距离与扩展相关（每标准差对数几率 -3.23；520人），一项探索性事后分析表明，在控制分类层级和教学条件后，这种关联在教学域内仍然存在。示例组成也很重要：在三个示例之后，当示例为下级层级时，成人将词语扩展到1.1%的上位项目；当示例为上位层级时，扩展到77.5%。其次，在使用同一编码器的人工学习者中，连接两个类别的词语在类别相距越远时学习准确率越低（近、中、远对的命名准确率分别为84.7%、65.4%和53.0%）。编码器的距离与来自三个数据集的人类相似性和混淆性测量相关（rho = .501–.795），但这种表征对齐并未转化为确凿证据表明人类衍生的距离能预测学习者难度，并且一个在单个儿童经历上训练的第二个编码器复现了层级排序，但没有复现配对级效应。次要人类数据是在确认性分析之前固定的内部计划下分析的（未进行外部预注册）。视觉相似性解释了两个系统中泛化组织方式的一部分，而示例组成贡献了我们所用距离未能捕捉的内容。

items.title_en: Maximizing LLM Utility While Managing LLM Fallibility
items.title_zh: 在管理 LLM 易错性的同时最大化 LLM 效用
items.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can supply autonomous systems with plans, predictions, and judgments, but these contributions are sometimes wrong. This review asks how a system can maximize an LLM's utility while managing its fallibility. Our answer is to adapt the system's reliance on the LLM as evidence about the LLM's performance accumulates. Systems built from imperfect components, such as noisy sensors and faulty software, have long worked in this way, and the classical methods they use can be applied to LLM-based systems as well. A system can change its reliance on an LLM in several ways, depending on the LLM's role and on the other components in the system. Each change needs an estimate of the LLM's reliability, and the LLM's role and the kind of contribution it makes determine what to estimate. Classical methods from decision theory, estimation, and online learning then turn these estimates into reliance decisions. These decisions can reduce how often LLM errors affect the system. However, some errors matter even when they are rare. An independently verified mechanism can prevent such errors from being executed. Without one, adapting reliance using reliability estimates can still keep their risk within a bound. Studies on adapting reliance on LLMs are emerging but limited, and the reviewed comparisons suggest that adapting reliance can improve system performance.
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）可以为自主系统提供计划、预测和判断，但这些贡献有时是错误的。本综述探讨系统如何在管理 LLM 易错性的同时最大化其效用。我们的答案是，随着关于 LLM 性能的证据不断积累，调整系统对 LLM 的依赖。由不完美组件（如有噪声的传感器和故障软件）构建的系统长期以来一直以这种方式工作，其使用的经典方法也可以应用于基于 LLM 的系统。系统可以通过多种方式改变对 LLM 的依赖，具体取决于 LLM 的角色以及系统中的其他组件。每种改变都需要对 LLM 可靠性进行估计，而 LLM 的角色及其贡献类型决定了需要估计什么。来自决策理论、估计和在线学习的经典方法随后将这些估计转化为依赖决策。这些决策可以减少 LLM 错误影响系统的频率。然而，有些错误即使很少发生也很重要。独立验证的机制可以防止此类错误被执行。在没有这种机制的情况下，使用可靠性估计调整依赖仍可将其风险保持在界限内。关于调整对 LLM 依赖的研究正在兴起但仍然有限，所综述的比较表明，调整依赖可以改善系统性能。

items.title_en: Transmission-Mode Multispectral Imaging for Estimation of Microcystis spp. Cell Concentration and ELISA-Equivalent Microcystin Concentration in Water
items.title_zh: 透射模式多光谱成像用于估计水中微囊藻属（Microcystis spp.）细胞浓度和 ELISA 等效微囊藻毒素浓度
items.abstract_en: Harmful algal blooms dominated by Microcystis spp. threaten freshwater systems through proliferation and microcystin (MC) production. Conventional measurements of cyanobacterial abundance and MC concentration commonly require laboratory processing, specialized instrumentation, or assay reagents. Because MC concentration cannot always be reliably inferred from cell abundance, complementary optical approaches for estimating both quantities are of interest. This study proposes and evaluates a transmission mode multispectral imaging (MSI) framework for estimating Microcystis spp. cell concentration and ELISA-equivalent MC concentration from culture derived dilution samples. A custom built MSI system acquiring twelve spectral bands from near-ultraviolet to near-infrared wavelengths measured transmitted light spectral responses. Following principal component analysis based dimensionality reduction, spectral variation was quantified using an aggregated Wasserstein distance descriptor for regression based prediction. Cell concentration estimation yielded $R^2=0.9819$ for calibration and $R^2=0.9754$ on held-out intermediate dilution levels, while ELISA-equivalent MC estimation yielded $R^2=0.9788$ for calibration and $R^2=0.9786$ on held-out intermediate dilution levels. These results demonstrate the feasibility of transmission-mode MSI as a dual output optical calibration framework for estimation of Microcystis spp. cell concentration and ELISA-equivalent MC concentration in water.
items.abstract_zh: 以微囊藻属（Microcystis spp.）为主导的有害藻华通过增殖和微囊藻毒素（MC）产生威胁淡水系统。蓝细菌丰度和 MC 浓度的常规测量通常需要实验室处理、专用仪器或检测试剂。由于并非总能从细胞丰度可靠推断 MC 浓度，因此用于估计这两个量的互补光学方法值得关注。本研究提出并评估一种透射模式多光谱成像（MSI）框架，用于从培养物衍生的稀释样品中估计微囊藻属细胞浓度和 ELISA 等效 MC 浓度。一个定制构建的 MSI 系统获取从近紫外到近红外波长的十二个光谱波段，测量透射光光谱响应。在基于主成分分析的降维之后，使用聚合 Wasserstein 距离描述符量化光谱变化，以进行基于回归的预测。细胞浓度估计在校准中产生 $R^2=0.9819$，在留出的中间稀释水平上产生 $R^2=0.9754$；而 ELISA 等效 MC 估计在校准中产生 $R^2=0.9788$，在留出的中间稀释水平上产生 $R^2=0.9786$。这些结果表明，透射模式 MSI 作为一种双输出光学校准框架，用于估计水中微囊藻属细胞浓度和 ELISA 等效 MC 浓度是可行的。
authors: K. A. D. S. A. Perera

items.title_en: Multimodal Reorganization of Gut--Brain Physiology During the Cephalic Phase of Digestion
items.title_zh: 消化头期肠–脑生理的多模态重组
items.abstract_en: The vagus nerve plays a central role in gut--brain communication, yet the physiological dynamics associated with cholinergic vagal signaling remain difficult to characterize non-invasively in humans. The cephalic phase response, which prepares the gastrointestinal system for food ingestion through anticipatory vagal pathways, offers a unique opportunity to investigate these interactions. Here, we used simultaneous recordings of cortical, gastric, cardiac, and swallow physiology in healthy adults to characterize brain--body responses during food anticipation and subsequent ingestion. Food-related sensory cues increased gastric myoelectric activity as well as swallow and heart rate while eliciting frequency-specific changes in cortical oscillations. Strikingly, anticipation was accompanied by opposing changes in physiological coordination: synchronization within cortical and gastric networks decreased, whereas coupling between the brain and stomach increased. These changes largely returned toward baseline following ingestion, suggesting a distinct anticipatory organization of brain--body activity. Moreover, gastric responses were associated with various aspects of subjective appetite, whereas cortical responses were selectively associated with craving. Both gastric and cortical responses independently explained the variation in participants' self-reported craving. Together, these findings reveal that food anticipation reorganizes physiological coordination within and across central and peripheral systems, establishing the cephalic phase as a non-invasive framework for investigating brain--body interactions associated with cholinergic vagal signaling in humans.
items.abstract_zh: 迷走神经在肠–脑交流中起核心作用，但与胆碱能迷走神经信号相关的生理动力学在人类中仍难以无创地表征。头期反应通过预期性迷走神经通路使胃肠道系统为进食做好准备，为研究这些相互作用提供了独特机会。在此，我们使用健康成人的皮层、胃、心脏和吞咽生理的同时记录，来表征食物预期及随后进食期间的大脑–身体反应。食物相关的感觉线索增加了胃肌电活动以及吞咽和心率，同时引起皮层振荡的频率特异性变化。引人注目的是，预期伴随着生理协调性的相反变化：皮层和胃网络内的同步性降低，而大脑与胃之间的耦合增加。这些变化在进食后大多回到基线附近，表明大脑–身体活动具有独特的预期性组织。此外，胃反应与主观食欲的多个方面相关，而皮层反应则选择性地与渴求相关。胃反应和皮层反应均独立解释了参与者自我报告渴求的变异。总之，这些发现揭示食物预期会重组中枢和外周系统内部及之间的生理协调，从而将头期确立为研究人类中与胆碱能迷走神经信号相关的大脑–身体相互作用的无创框架。

items.title_en: A deployed four-city entanglement-based QKD network with real-time key delivery, benchmarked against finite-key security bounds
items.title_zh: 一个已部署的四城市基于纠缠的QKD网络，具备实时密钥交付，并以有限密钥安全界为基准
items.abstract_en: Quantum key distribution (QKD) generates shared secret keys whose security rests on the laws of physics rather than on computational assumptions. We report the entanglement-based segment of the Slovak national quantum communication infrastructure, connecting four cities in western Slovakia over deployed telecommunication fiber. Polarization-entangled photons generated at a central node are passively routed by wavelength to form a trusted-node-free, fully meshed sub-network of three cities, with the fourth connected through the central node and all links operated simultaneously. We also introduce a matrix formalism for passive wavelength routing that enables the algorithmic construction of uniquely and fully connected topologies. Unlike most previous demonstrations, which estimate key rates from raw coincidences, all rates reported here are obtained after the complete post-processing chain, with keys delivered in real time via ETSI GS QKD 014. With partial non-local chromatic dispersion compensation, we obtain 13.5 bit/s over 109 km, and 4.3 bit/s over 32.1 dB of accumulated loss between two cities without a direct fiber link. Benchmarking against finite-key security bounds shows that the implemented heuristic privacy amplification can exceed the finite-key bound, and that replacing detect-and-discard with error correction would increase the finite-key rate by a factor of 4.1-6.6, and yield a positive finite-key rate on the 142.9 km link where the implemented scheme yields none.
items.abstract_zh: 量子密钥分发（QKD）生成共享秘密密钥，其安全性基于物理定律而非计算假设。我们报告斯洛伐克国家量子通信基础设施中基于纠缠的段落，在已部署的电信光纤上连接斯洛伐克西部四个城市。在中心节点产生的偏振纠缠光子通过波长被动路由，形成一个无可信节点、全网格的三城市子网，第四个城市经中心节点连接，且所有链路同时运行。我们还引入用于被动波长路由的矩阵形式体系，使得能够以算法方式构造唯一且全连接的拓扑。与大多数先前演示从原始符合计数估计密钥率不同，此处报告的所有密钥率均在全后处理链之后获得，密钥通过ETSI GS QKD 014实时交付。在部分非局域色散补偿下，我们在109 km上获得13.5 bit/s，在两个没有直接光纤链路的城市之间、累积损耗32.1 dB条件下获得4.3 bit/s。与有限密钥安全界进行基准比较表明，所实现的启发式隐私放大可能超过有限密钥界；并且将检测并丢弃替换为纠错会使有限密钥率提高4.1–6.6倍，并在142.9 km链路上产生正的有限密钥率，而所实现方案在该链路上没有产生任何有限密钥率。

items.title_en: Flexible Intelligent Metasurfaces for Enhancing Secure MISO Communications
items.title_zh: 用于增强安全MISO通信的柔性智能超表面
items.abstract_en: This letter investigates flexible intelligent metasurface (FIM)-aided secure multiple-input single-output (MISO) communications in the presence of a multi-antenna eavesdropper. By exploiting the morphing capability of the FIM, the transmit array geometry can be dynamically reconfigured to reshape the legitimate and eavesdropping channels. We formulate a secrecy rate maximization (SRM) problem by jointly optimizing the transmit covariance matrix and the FIM surface shape. For a given FIM surface shape, the optimal transmit covariance matrix is shown to be rank one and is obtained in closed form from the dominant generalized eigenvector. For a fixed transmit covariance matrix, a projected gradient ascent (PGA) method is developed to optimize the FIM shape. Based on these two subproblems, a block coordinate ascent (BCA) algorithm is proposed. Moreover, for the special line-of-sight (LoS) scenario, we derive a globally optimal closed-form joint transmit covariance matrix and FIM surface shape design under a sufficient morphing-range condition. Numerical results demonstrate that FIM effectively improves the secrecy rate over a conventional rigid antenna array (RAA). Moreover, FIM achieves a transmit-power saving of about 2.5 dB compared with the RAA benchmark at the same secrecy rate.
items.abstract_zh: 本文研究在多天线窃听者存在下，由柔性智能超表面（FIM）辅助的安全多输入单输出（MISO）通信。利用FIM的变形能力，可以动态重构发射阵列几何结构，以重塑合法信道和窃听信道。我们通过联合优化发射协方差矩阵和FIM表面形状，建立保密速率最大化（SRM）问题。对于给定的FIM表面形状，最优发射协方差矩阵被证明为秩一，并由主广义特征向量以闭式获得。对于固定发射协方差矩阵，开发了投影梯度上升（PGA）方法来优化FIM形状。基于这两个子问题，提出了块坐标上升（BCA）算法。此外，对于特殊的视距（LoS）场景，我们在足够的变形范围条件下，推导出全局最优的闭式联合发射协方差矩阵和FIM表面形状设计。数值结果表明，与常规刚性天线阵列（RAA）相比，FIM有效提高了保密速率。此外，在相同保密速率下，与RAA基准相比，FIM实现了约2.5 dB的发射功率节省。

items.title_en: Disentangling Spurious Correlations: How IRM Handles Diverse Shortcuts in Text Classification
items.title_zh: 解耦虚假相关：IRM如何处理文本分类中的多样捷径
items.abstract_en: In NLP, models trained via Empirical Risk Minimization (ERM) often exploit spurious correlations, such as dialectal markers, at the expense of robust linguistic features, thereby degrading their out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization. Invariant Risk Minimization (IRM) aims to suppress such shortcuts by identifying predictive relationships that remain stable across environments, but its practical utility for NLP remains debated. We use a causality-driven framework to evaluate IRM under three shortcut-generating mechanisms: label-generated features, confounding, and selection bias. Our results show that IRM successfully rejects shortcuts across the evaluated causal and anti-causal structures, including under limited environmental variation and increasing label noise. We then extend our analysis beyond controlled synthetic artifacts to two less constrained settings: gender-profession associations in Bias in Bios and semantically loaded actor-name shortcuts in ActorCorr. These experiments show that invariant learning can mitigate more realistic textual shortcuts, while semantically meaningful features require careful calibration of the invariance penalty.
items.abstract_zh: 在NLP中，通过经验风险最小化（ERM）训练的模型常常利用虚假相关（例如方言标记），而牺牲稳健的语言特征，从而降低其分布外（OOD）泛化能力。不变风险最小化（IRM）旨在通过识别跨环境保持稳定的预测关系来抑制此类捷径，但其在NLP中的实际效用仍有争议。我们使用因果驱动框架，在三种生成捷径的机制下评估IRM：标签生成特征、混杂和选择偏差。结果表明，IRM在所评估的因果和反因果结构中均成功拒绝捷径，包括在有限环境变化和标签噪声增加的情况下。随后，我们将分析从受控合成伪影扩展到两个约束较少的设置：Bias in Bios中的性别-职业关联，以及ActorCorr中语义负载的演员姓名捷径。这些实验表明，不变学习可以缓解更现实的文本捷径，而语义有意义的特征需要对不变性惩罚进行仔细校准。

items.title_en: Informative Path Planning with Gaussian Processes: Error Bounds, Algorithms, and Benchmarks
items.title_zh: 基于高斯过程的信息路径规划：误差界、算法与基准
items.abstract_en: Accurate environmental monitoring relies on Informative Path Planning (IPP) to deploy autonomous systems that maximize information gain. While Gaussian Processes (GPs) provide a robust mathematical foundation for modeling the environment, contemporary IPP approaches remain hindered by heuristic operational constraints and the lack of simultaneous theoretical guarantees for worst-case estimation error and approximation quality. Rather than introducing yet another heuristic, this paper presents a rigorous theoretical analysis of existing error bounds and algorithms to further develop the mathematical foundation for IPP. By evaluating probabilistic and deterministic bounds on reconstruction error, we establish that predictive variance is the theoretically ideal optimization objective for GP-based IPP. Furthermore, we analyze GreedyCover, a recent approach for optimizing predictive variance, and demonstrate that its near-optimal approximation guarantee matches the fundamental hardness-of-approximation limit for the problem. Comprehensive benchmarking confirms that this approach delivers superior estimation accuracy and computational efficiency compared to prominent information-theoretic objectives and optimization methods used in IPP. Finally, this theoretical analysis establishes a rigorous, near-optimal foundation for discrete offline IPP under bounded uncertainty constraints, offering clear and principled guidance for future work in continuous-space and online formulations.
items.abstract_zh: 准确的环境监测依赖于信息路径规划（IPP）来部署自主系统，以最大化信息增益。虽然高斯过程（GP）为环境建模提供了稳健的数学基础，但当前的IPP方法仍受启发式操作约束以及缺乏对最坏情况估计误差和近似质量的同时理论保证所阻碍。本文不是引入又一个启发式方法，而是对现有误差界和算法进行严格理论分析，以进一步发展IPP的数学基础。通过评估重构误差的概率界和确定性界，我们确立预测方差是基于GP的IPP在理论上理想的优化目标。此外，我们分析GreedyCover——一种近期用于优化预测方差的方法——并证明其近最优近似保证与该问题的基本近似硬度极限相匹配。全面的基准测试确认，与IPP中使用的突出信息论目标和优化方法相比，该方法提供更优的估计精度和计算效率。最后，这一理论分析为有界不确定性约束下的离散离线IPP建立了严格且近最优的基础，为未来连续空间和在线形式的研究提供清晰且有原则的指导。

items.title_en: Learning the Missing Derivative: Neural Multiple-Scattering Operators for Inverse Volume Rendering
items.title_zh: 学习缺失的导数：用于逆体渲染的神经多重散射算子
items.abstract_en: Reconstructing optically thick media from photographs requires modeling multiple scattering and its response to changes in extinction. Frozen-source tomography discards this derivative; differentiable path tracing estimates it through expensive, noisy sampling. We instead predict the multiple-scattering field with a neural operator and differentiate through it during inverse rendering, while computing transmittance and single scattering directly. A further challenge arises during optimization: an operator that predicts the field accurately on held-out media can still produce poor derivatives at the density states visited by the optimizer. We address this by fine-tuning on states generated during inversions driven by the operator, using Monte Carlo scattering-field supervision. On held-out optically thick clouds, our method improves relighting over frozen-source tomography at equal time and outperforms differentiable path tracing given substantially more time. Training on inversion trajectories also improves derivative alignment at visited states and reduces optimization drift.
items.abstract_zh: 从照片重建光学厚介质需要建模多重散射及其对消光变化的响应。冻结源层析丢弃了这一导数；可微路径追踪通过昂贵且有噪声的采样来估计它。我们改为用神经算子预测多重散射场，并在逆渲染期间通过它进行微分，同时直接计算透射率和单次散射。优化过程中还出现进一步挑战：一个在留出介质上准确预测场的算子，在优化器访问的密度状态下仍可能产生较差的导数。我们通过在由该算子驱动的反演过程中生成的状态上进行微调，并使用蒙特卡洛散射场监督来解决这一问题。在留出的光学厚云上，我们的方法在相同时间下相较冻结源层析改善了重光照，并在给予显著更多时间时优于可微路径追踪。在反演轨迹上训练还改善了访问状态处的导数对齐，并减少了优化漂移。

items.title_en: Activity drives local CaMKII synthesis and subcellular localization via autophosphorylation-dependent pathways
items.title_zh: 活动通过自磷酸化依赖性通路驱动局部CaMKII合成与亚细胞定位
items.abstract_en: Strong repeated stimulation of a neuron triggers an increase in local protein synthesis along with a change in localization of proteins, allowing the neuron to rapidly adjust its proteome in response to activity. One of these proteins, calcium/calmodulin-dependent protein kinase II (CaMKII), is involved in mediating structural and functional changes after activity. While postsynaptic CaMKII translation has been studied, very little is known about presynaptic synthesis, including its mechanisms and the functional consequences. We utilized the Drosophila larval neuromuscular junction (NMJ) as a model to study the molecular requirements for activity-dependent synthesis along with the localization of CaMKII protein. Presynaptic-specific tagging of endogenous CaMKII demonstrates that spaced stimulation rapidly increases presynaptic CaMKII through local translation of pre-existing mRNA, independently of somatic factors. This activity-dependent synthesis requires the distal 3' untranslated region (3'UTR) of the CaMKII mRNA, which is also necessary for steady-state synaptic accumulation. Additionally, we show that activity-dependent synthesis requires CaMKII T287 autophosphorylation-induced activation of the PI3K/Akt/mTor pathway. While activity-dependent redistribution of CaMKII has been previously identified, very little is known about how local synthesis and translocation may interact to define different pools of protein that may have distinct functions. We demonstrate that CaMKII with a T287D phosphomimetic mutant localizes to the synaptic membrane and pulse-chase experiments show that the localization of newly-synthesized CaMKII differs from pre-existing CaMKII, indicating neuronal activity generates spatially distinct, and likely functionally distinct, CaMKII populations which may underlie long-lasting plasticity.
items.abstract_zh: 对神经元的强重复刺激会触发局部蛋白质合成增加，并伴随蛋白质定位改变，使神经元能够根据活动快速调整其蛋白质组。其中一种蛋白质，钙/钙调蛋白依赖性蛋白激酶II（CaMKII），参与介导活动后的结构和功能变化。尽管突触后CaMKII翻译已有研究，但人们对突触前合成，包括其机制和功能后果，知之甚少。我们利用果蝇幼虫神经肌肉接头（NMJ）作为模型，研究活动依赖性合成的分子要求以及CaMKII蛋白的定位。对内源性CaMKII进行突触前特异性标记表明，间隔刺激通过翻译预先存在的mRNA迅速增加突触前CaMKII，且不依赖胞体因子。这种活动依赖性合成需要CaMKII mRNA的远端3'非翻译区（3'UTR），该区域也是稳态突触积累所必需的。此外，我们表明活动依赖性合成需要CaMKII T287自磷酸化诱导的PI3K/Akt/mTor通路激活。虽然CaMKII的活动依赖性重新分布此前已被发现，但关于局部合成与易位如何相互作用以定义可能具有不同功能的不同蛋白质池，人们知之甚少。我们证明，带有T287D磷酸模拟突变的CaMKII定位于突触膜，脉冲追踪实验显示新合成CaMKII的定位与预先存在的CaMKII不同，表明神经元活动产生空间上不同、且很可能功能上不同的CaMKII群体，这可能是持久可塑性的基础。

items.title_en: Implementation of a 1D Gaussian-modulated CV-QKD under finite-size parameter estimation
items.title_zh: 有限尺寸参数估计下一维高斯调制CV-QKD的实现
items.abstract_en: Continuous-variable quantum key distribution (CV-QKD) is a promising technology for quantum-secure communications, offering high secret-key rates and straightforward integration with coherent optical communication systems. Conventional Gaussian-modulated CV-QKD encodes information in both optical-field quadratures, increasing requirements for state preparation, modulation, and calibration, while potentially introducing additional preparation imperfections. Unidimensional (1D) Gaussian modulation offers a simpler alternative by encoding information in only one quadrature, while the conjugate quadrature constrains the protocol's security. However, an integrated experimental 1D implementation combining independent-laser coherent reception with practical reconciliation, finite-size parameter estimation, and privacy amplification remains challenging. Here, we experimentally demonstrate a 1D Gaussian-modulated CV-QKD system over 12~km of standard single-mode fiber using a local local oscillator (LLO) architecture with independent lasers and an integrated offline classical post-processing chain. The implementation includes coherent detection, digital signal processing, information reconciliation, parameter estimation, physicality-constrained security analysis, and privacy amplification. The 1D system achieves a privacy-amplified rate of $1.421$~Mbit/s under the asymptotic security treatment and $0.364$~Mbit/s under the finite-size scenario. These results establish an experimental baseline for the performance--complexity trade-off associated with unidimensional Gaussian modulation and provide an experimental basis for developing lower-complexity CV-QKD transmitters.
items.abstract_zh: 连续变量量子密钥分发（CV-QKD）是量子安全通信的一项有前景技术，具有高秘密密钥率以及与相干光通信系统直接集成的优势。传统高斯调制CV-QKD将信息编码在光场两个正交分量中，增加了态制备、调制和校准的要求，同时可能引入额外的制备不完美性。一维（1D）高斯调制仅在一个正交分量中编码信息，提供了一种更简单的替代方案，而共轭正交分量约束协议的安全性。然而，将独立激光器相干接收与实际协商、有限尺寸参数估计和隐私放大相结合的集成1D实验实现仍具挑战性。在此，我们实验演示了在12 km标准单模光纤上的1D高斯调制CV-QKD系统，采用具有独立激光器的本地本振（LLO）架构和集成的离线经典后处理链。该实现包括相干检测、数字信号处理、信息协商、参数估计、受物理性约束的安全分析和隐私放大。该1D系统在渐近安全处理下实现1.421 Mbit/s的隐私放大后速率，在有限尺寸场景下实现0.364 Mbit/s。这些结果为与一维高斯调制相关的性能—复杂度权衡建立了实验基线，并为开发更低复杂度的CV-QKD发射机提供了实验基础。

items.title_en: MutAtlas: A PDB-Wide Energy-Guided Atlas of Protein Mutation Effects
items.title_zh: MutAtlas：一个覆盖整个PDB、能量引导的蛋白质突变效应图谱
items.abstract_en: Protein mutation effect prediction is fundamental to protein engineering and disease variant interpretation, yet experimentally measured mutation data remain accurate but extremely sparse. To provide scalable supplementary mutation signals, we construct a PDB-wide mutation augmentation dataset that exhaustively enumerates single-site substitutions on experimentally resolved protein structures and aligns mutation signals from physics-based energy models, protein language models, and inverse folding models. Large-scale analysis under a unified mutation preference representation reveals substantial differences in the consistency, concentration, and substitution patterns of mutation distributions across models, indicating that disagreement is pervasive and reflects conflicting inductive biases rather than random noise. Motivated by these observations, we propose an unsupervised multi-source mutation preference distillation framework that learns from relative mutation preferences while explicitly modeling cross-source disagreement. Without using any experimental mutation labels during training, our approach achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated zero-shot baselines and naive multi-source fusion strategies on ProteinGym. We release the dataset and evaluation pipeline to support reproducible studies of protein mutation effects.
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质突变效应预测是蛋白质工程和疾病变异解读的基础，但实验测量的突变数据虽然准确却极其稀疏。为提供可扩展的补充突变信号，我们构建了一个全PDB范围的突变增强数据集，对实验解析的蛋白质结构上的单点替换进行穷举枚举，并对齐来自基于物理的能量模型、蛋白质语言模型和逆折叠模型的突变信号。在统一的突变偏好表示下进行大规模分析，揭示了不同模型在突变分布的一致性、集中度和替换模式上存在显著差异，表明分歧普遍存在，反映的是相互冲突的归纳偏置而非随机噪声。受这些观察启发，我们提出一种无监督多源突变偏好蒸馏框架，从相对突变偏好中学习，同时显式建模跨源分歧。训练期间未使用任何实验突变标签，我们的方法在ProteinGym上在所评估的零样本基线和朴素多源融合策略中取得了最佳总体性能。我们发布数据集和评估流程，以支持蛋白质突变效应的可复现研究。
