items.title_en: Thermodynamics of words
items.title_zh: 词的热力学
items.abstract_en: We introduce the word thermalization hypothesis according to which in a literary work there are effective interactions between words that drive them to thermalization where their word frequency distribution is the same as for the phenomenon of Rayleigh-Jeans (RJ) thermalization and condensation. In this concept, the different words play a role of classical oscillators (particles) and their word frequencies, or related tokens, are analogous to certain filling factors over energy state levels. The thermalization process is characterized by the conservation of total system energy, or total number of words/tokens, and total probability norm, or total number of different words. We apply this approach to analyze 16 literary works, including Bible, complete works of Shakespeare, and data from American National Corpus. We show that for these cases the effective system energy is very low and thus there is the RJ condensation phenomenon with a big fraction of total probability concentrated at the lowest energy states corresponding to a big fraction of rare words appearing only once or twice in the whole text. Such a RJ condensation is observed for light propagation in multimode optical fibers and other physical systems. We relate the thermalization of words to the recently proposed wealth thermalization for households in world countries. The economy concepts of Lorenz and Pareto curves, and also Zipf curves, are applied to the word frequency distributions of the selected 16 cases and it is shown that the thermalization theory gives a strikingly good description of real data.
items.abstract_zh: 我们引入词热化假设，据此在文学作品中词之间存在有效相互作用，驱动其达到热化，其词频分布与Rayleigh-Jeans（RJ）热化和凝聚现象相同。在这一概念中，不同词扮演经典振子（粒子）的角色，其词频或相关词元类似于能态能级上的某些填充因子。热化过程由系统总能量（即总词/词元数）和总概率范数（即不同词总数）守恒来表征。我们将此方法应用于分析16部文学作品，包括《圣经》、莎士比亚全集以及美国国家语料库的数据。我们表明，在这些案例中有效系统能量非常低，因此存在RJ凝聚现象，很大一部分总概率集中在最低能态，对应于很大一部分在整个文本中仅出现一次或两次的稀有词。这种RJ凝聚在多模光纤中的光传播和其他物理系统中被观察到。我们将词的热化与世界国家家庭最近提出的财富热化联系起来。将Lorenz曲线和Pareto曲线以及Zipf曲线等经济学概念应用于所选16个案例的词频分布，并表明热化理论对真实数据给出了惊人良好的描述。

items.title_en: DroneDiffusion: Uncertainty-Guided Diffusion Path Planner for UAV Navigation
items.title_zh: DroneDiffusion：面向无人机导航的不确定性引导扩散路径规划器
items.abstract_en: We present DroneDiffusion, a perception-aware diffusion planner for local 3-D UAV trajectory generation that explicitly models and avoids failure zones caused by lens flare, overexposure, and reflective surfaces. A vision-language perceptual safety estimator produces a pixel-aligned reliability map that highlights regions of degraded sensing. A denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) is conditioned on this map together with the onboard RGB image, goal point, and initial velocity to generate egocentric 3-D trajectories. To enforce obstacle avoidance at inference time without retraining, we apply training-free CHOMP guidance over a 3-D Euclidean signed distance field. The model is trained entirely in simulation and deployed zero-shot on a real drone. Reliability conditioning raises the mean perceptual reliability along generated trajectories to 0.71, compared with 0.63 for a geometric baseline, while guidance halves the collision rate of the learned prior from 14.7% to 7.8%. Perceptual safety conditioning and geometric guidance are therefore complementary: treating sensor reliability as a first-class signal reduces incursions into unreliable regions while maintaining competitive navigation performance.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出DroneDiffusion，一种感知感知的扩散规划器，用于局部三维无人机轨迹生成，显式建模并避开由镜头眩光、过曝和反射表面造成的失效区域。视觉-语言感知安全估计器生成像素对齐的可靠性图，突出显示感知退化的区域。去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）以该图以及机载RGB图像、目标点和初始速度为条件，生成以自我为中心的三维轨迹。为在推理时无需重新训练即可强制避障，我们在三维欧氏符号距离场上应用无需训练的CHOMP引导。模型完全在仿真中训练，并零样本部署到真实无人机上。可靠性条件将生成轨迹沿线的平均感知可靠性提高到0.71，而几何基线为0.63；引导将学习先验的碰撞率从14.7%减半至7.8%。因此，感知安全条件与几何引导是互补的：将传感器可靠性视为一等信号，可减少进入不可靠区域的侵入，同时保持有竞争力的导航性能。

items.title_en: Learning-Based Interpolation of Detector Gaps in Photon-Counting X-ray Imaging
items.title_zh: 光子计数X射线成像中探测器间隙的基于学习的插值
items.abstract_en: Image detectors assembled from tiled modules have physical gaps in the field of view that must be filled before downstream processing such as phase retrieval or tomographic reconstruction. Unlike natural-image inpainting, detector-gap interpolation must leave all other pixels unmodified and preserve the intensity statistics of the filled region, since even a small shift in mean intensity can cause ring artifacts after reconstruction. We adapted two generative models, a Wasserstein GAN with gradient penalty (WGAN-GP) and a conditional Pix2Pix model, to this task. We implemented a masking strategy that restricts all changes to the gap pixels and loss terms that constrain the mean intensity and the intensity distribution of the filled region. Both models were trained on nanoCT projections with simulated gaps and compared with linear interpolation, Navier--Stokes inpainting, and the deep image-inpainting network MADF, quantitatively on simulated gaps and visually on real detector gaps. WGAN-GP and Pix2Pix achieved the best perceptual similarity (LPIPS) and histogram distance and, apart from linear interpolation, the shortest inference time. Pix2Pix required about five times fewer training GPU-hours than WGAN-GP. Ablation studies showed that masking the network output contributes by far the most to plausible inpainting results. Applied to sinograms, Pix2Pix produced the most natural gap filling but improved the reconstruction only slightly compared with linear interpolation. The source code and the weights of the final Pix2Pix model are available at https://github.com/J-3TO/detectorGapRemoval_Pix2Pix.
items.abstract_zh: 由拼接模块组装而成的图像探测器在视场中存在物理间隙，必须在相位恢复或断层重建等下游处理之前填充。与自然图像修复不同，探测器间隙插值必须保持所有其他像素不变，并保持填充区域的强度统计特性，因为即使平均强度发生很小偏移，也可能在重建后造成环状伪影。我们将两种生成模型——带梯度惩罚的Wasserstein GAN（WGAN-GP）和条件Pix2Pix模型——适配到此任务。我们实现了一种掩蔽策略，将所有变化限制在间隙像素，并加入约束填充区域平均强度和强度分布的损失项。两种模型均在带有模拟间隙的nanoCT投影上训练，并与线性插值、Navier–Stokes修复和深度图像修复网络MADF进行比较：在模拟间隙上进行定量比较，在真实探测器间隙上进行视觉比较。WGAN-GP和Pix2Pix取得了最佳的感知相似度（LPIPS）和直方图距离，并且除线性插值外具有最短的推理时间。Pix2Pix所需的训练GPU小时数比WGAN-GP少约五倍。消融研究表明，对网络输出进行掩蔽对获得合理的修复结果贡献最大。应用于正弦图时，Pix2Pix产生了最自然的间隙填充，但与线性插值相比仅略微改善重建。最终Pix2Pix模型的源代码和权重可在https://github.com/J-3TO/detectorGapRemoval_Pix2Pix获取。

items.title_en: Detection of zoonotic Cryptosporidium parvum in invasive beavers from southern Tierra del Fuego, Chile
items.title_zh: 智利火地岛南部入侵河狸中人兽共患微小隐孢子虫的检测
items.abstract_en: Since their introduction to Tierra del Fuego in 1946, invasive beavers have expanded their population and caused extensive environmental degradation across the subantarctic region. Beaver dams have profoundly impacted peatlands, mature sub-Antarctic forests, and watercourses. Here, we report a pathogen in invasive beavers in Patagonia and discuss their potential role as a reservoir of waterborne zoonotic pathogens. We detected Cryptosporidium through microscopy using the Ziehl-Neelsen staining technique in beaver collected from southern Tierra del Fuego. Out of the 105 beavers examined, three tested positive to optical microscopy, which were then identified molecularly as Cryptosporidium parvum by sequence analysis of the 18S ribosomal DNA (rDNA). Given the potential impacts of Cryptosporidium parvum upon native species, wildlife, and human health, this finding highlights the potential risks associated with the ongoing expansion of beavers into other areas of the sub-Antarctic region. A potential role of invasive beavers as reservoirs of zoonotic Cryptosporidium spp. in Patagonia emphasizes the unknown consequences of human-introduced exotic species on pristine ecosystems.
items.abstract_zh: 自1946年引入火地岛以来，入侵河狸种群扩张，并在亚南极地区造成广泛环境退化。河狸坝深刻影响了泥炭地、成熟亚南极森林和水道。在此，我们报告巴塔哥尼亚入侵河狸中的一种病原体，并讨论其作为水源性人兽共患病原体宿主的潜在作用。我们采用Ziehl-Neelsen染色技术，通过显微镜检查从火地岛南部采集的河狸，检测隐孢子虫。在检查的105只河狸中，3只光学显微镜检测呈阳性，随后通过18S核糖体DNA（rDNA）序列分析在分子水平鉴定为微小隐孢子虫。鉴于微小隐孢子虫对本地物种、野生动物和人类健康的潜在影响，这一发现凸显了河狸持续向亚南极地区其他区域扩张相关的潜在风险。入侵河狸在巴塔哥尼亚可能作为人兽共患隐孢子虫属宿主的角色，强调了人类引入的外来物种对原始生态系统未知的后果。

items.title_en: Exact characterization of three-terminal fermion counting under one-body scattering
items.title_zh: 一体散射下三端费米子计数的精确表征
items.abstract_en: Quantum scattering is a fundamental probe of the scattering region and the quantum dynamics of outgoing particles. In two terminals, the statistics of non-interacting fermions is described by a generalized binomial distribution, that arises from the Pauli exclusion principle, while deviations are a signature of interactions. In this work, we extend this result to a scattering region coupled to three outgoing terminals (or channels), obtaining exact bounds for the statistics of the outgoing fermions. In particular, for two fermions and three terminals, four inequalities involving six measured probabilities determine whether a non-interacting scatterer can explain the observed statistics. Applying these inequalities to recent scattering experiments in cold atoms, we are able to identify a regime where interactions have a significant contribution on the outgoing particles. Therefore, our work opens up the possibility of identifying fermion interactions at the nanoscale in systems that range from mesoscopic conductors to optical traps in cold atoms.
items.abstract_zh: 量子散射是探测散射区域和出射粒子量子动力学的基本手段。在两终端情形下，非相互作用费米子的统计由泡利不相容原理产生的广义二项分布描述，而偏离则是相互作用的特征。在本工作中，我们将这一结果推广到与三个出射终端（或通道）耦合的散射区域，获得出射费米子统计的精确界限。特别地，对于两个费米子和三个终端，涉及六个测量概率的四个不等式决定了非相互作用散射体是否能解释观测到的统计。将这些不等式应用于近期冷原子散射实验，我们能够识别出相互作用对出射粒子有显著贡献的区间。因此，我们的工作为从介观导体到冷原子光阱等系统中在纳米尺度识别费米子相互作用开辟了可能性。

items.title_en: Bilayer Periodically Poled Piezoelectric Thin-Film Lithium Tantalate Platform for Passive-Layer-Free Flexural and Torsional Actuation
items.title_zh: 用于无被动层弯曲与扭转驱动的双层周期极化压电薄膜钽酸锂平台
items.abstract_en: This work demonstrates, to the best of our knowledge, the first passive-layer-free thin-film lithium tantalate (LT) actuator platform, supporting both out-of-plane flexural and in-plane torsional actuation from a single bilayer periodically poled piezoelectric film (P3F) X-cut LT stack. The polarity reversal across the bond interface flips the piezoelectric stress below the neutral axis, generating a bending moment without any passive elastic layer. Moreover, the two layers share identical elastic and thermal-expansion constants, making the stack thermally matched by construction. Suspended cantilever devices were fabricated on a single 2$\times$1.5 $μ$m X-cut LT stack and verified by laser Doppler vibrometry (LDV). The tapered flexural resonator exhibits a 5.5$\times$ tip velocity amplification and a measured peak tip velocity of 10.3 m/s at $Q=634$, and a 0.49 MHz torsional cantilever resonator with $Q=514$ is demonstrated on the same stack. These results position bilayer P3F LT as a thermally matched, passive-layer-free actuation platform for vacuum-operated and optically interrogated MEMS such as scanners, gyroscopes, and ultrasonic transducers.
items.abstract_zh: 本工作据我们所知首次演示了无被动层薄膜钽酸锂（LT）驱动器平台，可由单一双层周期极化压电薄膜（P3F）X切LT叠层同时支持面外弯曲和面内扭转驱动。跨键合界面的极性反转使中性轴以下的压电应力反向，从而在没有任何被动弹性层的情况下产生弯矩。此外，两层具有相同的弹性和热膨胀常数，使该叠层在构造上热匹配。在单个2×1.5 μm X切LT叠层上制造了悬浮悬臂器件，并通过激光多普勒振动测量（LDV）验证。锥形弯曲谐振器表现出5.5×的尖端速度放大，在Q=634时测得峰值尖端速度为10.3 m/s；同一叠层上还演示了Q=514的0.49 MHz扭转悬臂谐振器。这些结果使双层P3F LT成为热匹配、无被动层的驱动平台，适用于真空操作和光学询问的MEMS，如扫描器、陀螺仪和超声换能器。

items.title_en: OpticalRAG: Pixel-Space Compression for Token-Efficient Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.title_zh: OpticalRAG：面向令牌高效检索增强生成的像素空间压缩
items.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is bottlenecked by the token budget of large language models: feeding long documents into the context window is expensive, while aggressive textual compression discards fine-grained information that is irreversibly lost in a one-dimensional token sequence. We argue that this bottleneck is not fundamental to information density but to the choice of compression \emph{modality}. Modern visual encoders can pack the contents of a rendered text page into roughly a hundred visual tokens with little semantic loss, opening a new compression-fidelity tradeoff that purely textual methods cannot reach. We present \textbf{OpticalRAG}, a framework that renders documents as page images, encodes them with a frozen vision encoder, and distills the retrieved visual tokens into as few as $16$ injected tokens before passing them to the LLM. Two ingredients make this work without expensive cross-modal training: (i) \emph{Encoder-Bridged Retrieval}, which projects text-query states into the visual feature space of the frozen encoder, through a projection shared with the compressor, to retrieve visual tokens from a text query, with no contrastive training; and (ii) \emph{Query-Driven Distillation}, a lightweight cross-attention compressor that condenses the retrieved visual tokens into a small set of query-conditioned prefix tokens. On LongBench-v2, BAMBOO, and LooGLE-v2, OpticalRAG achieves the best compression-aware accuracy (CAP) on all three benchmarks while injecting only $16$ tokens, and improves the closed-book Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct backbone by $5.17$ points on LongBench-v2. Code is available at https://github.com/brighterr/OpticalRAG.
items.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）受限于大语言模型的令牌预算：将长文档输入上下文窗口代价高昂，而激进的文本压缩会丢弃在一维令牌序列中不可逆丢失的细粒度信息。我们认为这一瓶颈并非源于信息密度本身，而是源于压缩模态的选择。现代视觉编码器可以将渲染文本页面的内容打包成大约一百个视觉令牌，而语义损失很小，从而开启了一种纯文本方法无法达到的新的压缩–保真度权衡。我们提出OpticalRAG，一个将文档渲染为页面图像、用冻结视觉编码器进行编码，并在送入LLM之前将检索到的视觉令牌蒸馏为少至16个注入令牌的框架。两个要素使这一方法无需昂贵的跨模态训练即可奏效：(i) 编码器桥接检索，它通过一个与压缩器共享的投影，将文本查询状态投影到冻结编码器的视觉特征空间，从而从文本查询检索视觉令牌，且无需对比训练；(ii) 查询驱动蒸馏，一个轻量级交叉注意力压缩器，将检索到的视觉令牌浓缩为一小组以查询为条件的前缀令牌。在LongBench-v2、BAMBOO和LooGLE-v2上，OpticalRAG仅注入16个令牌，却在全部三个基准上取得最佳压缩感知准确率（CAP），并在LongBench-v2上将闭卷Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct主干提升5.17分。代码见https://github.com/brighterr/OpticalRAG。

items.title_en: Are We Ready for Snow-tonomous Driving? Challenges Toward Robust Automated Driving in Extreme Weather
items.title_zh: 我们准备好雪地自动驾驶了吗？极端天气下稳健自动驾驶面临的挑战
items.abstract_en: Automated driving has gained remarkable momentum over the past decade, with both industry and academia investing substantial resources in developing perception and control solutions to advance vehicle autonomy. However, these efforts have largely focused on clear-weather scenarios, leaving harsh conditions, such as snow, rain, and fog, comparatively understudied. As a result, inclement weather remains one of the most significant hurdles for autonomous vehicles, often leading to substantial performance degradation in downstream perception and control tasks. In this paper, we present insights from the EU-funded Horizon Europe project ROADVIEW, which aims to develop robust, weather-aware perception and control modules for connected and automated vehicles operating under severe conditions, including snow, rain, and fog. Drawing on four years of large-scale development and real-world demonstrations across multiple vehicle platforms in different locations, we identify ten key challenges that hinder the development of weather-resilient autonomy, including data scarcity, domain shifts, limitations in multimodal perception, control robustness, and validation gaps, among others. We summarize these challenges and lessons learned toward enabling reliable snow-autonomous driving, highlighting critical directions for future research and standardization.
items.abstract_zh: 过去十年，自动驾驶取得了显著进展，工业界和学术界投入大量资源开发感知与控制解决方案以推进车辆自主性。然而，这些努力主要集中在晴朗天气场景，对雪、雨和雾等恶劣条件的研究相对不足。因此，恶劣天气仍是自动驾驶汽车最重要的障碍之一，常常导致下游感知和控制任务性能大幅下降。本文介绍欧盟资助的Horizon Europe项目ROADVIEW的见解，该项目旨在为在雪、雨和雾等严苛条件下运行的网联自动驾驶车辆开发稳健、天气感知的感知与控制模块。基于四年的大规模开发和在多个地点不同车辆平台上的真实世界演示，我们识别出阻碍天气韧性自主性发展的十项关键挑战，包括数据稀缺、域偏移、多模态感知的局限、控制鲁棒性以及验证缺口等。我们总结这些挑战和经验教训，以推动可靠的雪地自动驾驶，并强调未来研究和标准化的关键方向。

items.title_en: STeP-C: Real-Time Neural Compression for Distributed Fiber-Optic Sensing at Scale
items.title_zh: STeP-C：面向大规模分布式光纤传感的实时神经压缩
items.abstract_en: Distributed fiber-optic sensing (DFOS) technologies such as Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) generate continuous, high-resolution spatio-temporal data at rates exceeding hundreds of megabytes per second, creating severe challenges for real-time storage and transmission. While neural compression methods can achieve strong rate-distortion performance on sensing data, prior approaches either require per-segment retraining incompatible with streaming, or have only been validated offline. None have been demonstrated end-to-end on a continuously streaming DAS acquisition system at scale. We present STeP-C (Spatio-Temporal Predictive Compression), a neural compression framework that decouples spatial encoding, temporal prediction, and entropy-optimized residual coding, trained end-to-end with a rate-distortion objective motivated by conditional entropy reduction. Critically, we identify entropy coding as the dominant bottleneck for streaming deployment. We address it through GPU-side symbol computation, cached probability tables, and parallel GIL-free arithmetic coding, together with FP16 inference and batched entropy coding, enabling a full real-time pipeline built around a GPU ring buffer. We validate this pipeline on a live DAS testbed, achieving a 98.85% file size reduction at 31.04 dB full-band PSNR and an average throughput of 535 MB/s, exceeding the 324 MB/s requirement for 1 kHz, 81 km DAS streams. We further show that STeP-C substantially outperforms conventional codecs at practical streaming bitrates, can be applied to unseen channel ranges within the same acquisition system without retraining, and largely maintains downstream detector consistency, with 96.62% high-confidence class agreement and 100% Jaccard similarity on detected event types.
items.abstract_zh: 分布式光纤传感（DFOS）技术，如分布式声学传感（DAS），以超过每秒数百兆字节的速率生成连续、高分辨率的时空数据，给实时存储和传输带来严峻挑战。尽管神经压缩方法能在传感数据上取得较强的率失真性能，但先前方法要么需要逐段重新训练，与流式处理不兼容，要么仅在离线环境中得到验证。尚无方法在大规模连续流式DAS采集系统上得到端到端演示。我们提出STeP-C（时空预测压缩），一种神经压缩框架，将空间编码、时间预测和熵优化残差编码解耦，并以由条件熵降低驱动的率失真目标进行端到端训练。关键的是，我们识别出熵编码是流式部署的主要瓶颈。我们通过GPU端符号计算、缓存概率表和并行无GIL算术编码，并结合FP16推理和批量熵编码来解决该问题，从而构建围绕GPU环形缓冲区的完整实时流水线。我们在实时DAS测试平台上验证该流水线，在31.04 dB全频带PSNR下实现98.85%的文件大小缩减，平均吞吐量达535 MB/s，超过1 kHz、81 km DAS数据流所需的324 MB/s。我们进一步表明，在实际流式比特率下，STeP-C显著优于传统编解码器，可在不重新训练的情况下应用于同一采集系统内未见过的通道范围，并在很大程度上保持下游检测器一致性，高置信类别一致率为96.62%，检测到的事件类型的Jaccard相似度为100%。

items.title_en: Ex vivo autologous immune cell assay to study modulation of type 2 Inflammation by processed- or novel food extracts in peanut allergy
items.title_zh: 离体自体免疫细胞测定用于研究花生过敏中加工或新型食物提取物对2型炎症的调控
items.abstract_en: Peanut allergy represents a major food-allergy burden, raising concerns about food processing and novel dietary products. Current diagnostics assess primarily allergic endpoints rather than immune mechanisms initiating and maintaining type 2 inflammation, particularly DC2-mediated Th2 polarization. Here, an ex vivo autologous type 2 inflammatory monocyte-derived dendritic cell (moDC) DC2/T cell and B cell assay has been introduced enabling to study immunomodulatory effects induced by unprocessed (P-D) versus processed (P-DH (heated) or P-DHG (heated and glycated)) peanut proteins. Separately, different emerging food samples were assessed (protein concentrates or whole biomass) enabling to study their capacities to modify inflammatory DC2/T cell responses. CD14+ monocytes, CD4+ T cells and CD19+ B cells were isolated from six peanut-allergic patients' PBMCs. MoDCs generated with IL4/GM-CSF were exposed (48h) to type 2 polarizing cytokine (DC2) mix, or DC2 mix combined with the food samples. Next, DC2s were co-cultured with T cells (5d), followed by B cells incubation with DC2/T cell supernatant and food samples (10d). Supernatants and cells were analyzed for Th1/Th2/Th-regulatory (Treg) cells, IgE and IgG profiles. DC2 induced a strong Th2 phenotype and activity, P-D DC2 further enhanced IL13 secretion and %Tregs. P-DH DC2 favored Th2, whereas P-DHG DC2 increased IFN{gamma}, with neither increasing %Treg. P-D and P-DH DC2 increased CD40L+CD25+ memory Th2, and P-DHG showed the same tendency. Wheat, whey and seaweed biomass had little effect on DC2/Th2 driven type 2 inflammation at the dose studied, whereas algae showed distinct immunomodulatory, adjuvant-like activity upon co-exposure during inflammatory DC2 maturation. In conclusion, this autologous in vitro assay captures modification of type 2 inflammatory response in DC2-Th2 interaction, which can compile both allergen-specific and generic reactivity to food samples, supporting the potential future use of this assay as an additional tool to assess type 2-driving potential and possible allergenicity of emerging foods and processing methods in peanut-allergic patients.
items.abstract_zh: 花生过敏是主要食物过敏负担，引发对食品加工和新型膳食产品的担忧。当前诊断主要评估过敏终点，而非启动和维持2型炎症的免疫机制，尤其是DC2介导的Th2极化。本文引入了离体自体2型炎症单核细胞衍生树突状细胞（moDC）DC2/T细胞和B细胞测定，能够研究未加工（P-D）与加工（P-DH（加热）或P-DHG（加热并糖化））花生蛋白所诱导的免疫调节效应。另外，评估了不同新兴食物样品（蛋白浓缩物或全生物质），以研究其改变炎症性DC2/T细胞反应的能力。从六名花生过敏患者的PBMC中分离CD14+单核细胞、CD4+ T细胞和CD19+ B细胞。用IL4/GM-CSF生成的moDC暴露（48小时）于2型极化细胞因子（DC2）混合物，或DC2混合物与食物样品组合。随后，DC2与T细胞共培养（5天），之后B细胞与DC2/T细胞上清和食物样品孵育（10天）。分析上清和细胞的Th1/Th2/Th调节性（Treg）细胞、IgE和IgG谱。DC2诱导强Th2表型和活性，P-D DC2进一步增强IL13分泌和%Treg。P-DH DC2偏向Th2，而P-DHG DC2增加IFN{gamma}，两者均未增加%Treg。P-D和P-DH DC2增加CD40L+CD25+记忆Th2，P-DHG显示相同趋势。在研究剂量下，小麦、乳清和海藻生物质对DC2/Th2驱动的2型炎症影响很小，而藻类在炎症性DC2成熟期间共暴露时显示出独特的免疫调节、佐剂样活性。总之，这种自体体外测定捕获了DC2-Th2相互作用中2型炎症反应的改变，可综合对食物样品的过敏原特异性和通用反应性，支持未来将该测定作为附加工具，评估新兴食物和加工方法在花生过敏患者中的2型驱动潜力和可能的致敏性。

items.title_en: Probing the extreme quantum violation of the Leggett-Garg inequality
items.title_zh: 探究Leggett-Garg不等式的极端量子违反
items.abstract_en: The Leggett-Garg (LG) inequalities were formulated for testing the incompatibility between the classical worldview of macrorealism and quantum theory. By analogy with the Tsirelson bound for Bell inequalities, the maximal quantum violation of LG inequalities is commonly referred to as the temporal Tsirelson bound (TTB). Nevertheless, several studies have claimed that, unlike the Tsirelson bound, the TTB can be exceeded within quantum theory. In particular, by employing degeneracy-breaking measurement in [\href{ https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevLett.113.050401}{Phys. Rev. Lett. \textbf{113}, 050401 (2014)}] and by using the superposition of unitaries in [\href{https://doi.org/10.1103/vydp-9qqq}{Phys. Rev. Lett. \textbf{135}, 220202 (2025)}], it is argued that the TTB can be violated. In this work, we critically examine the reasoning underlying these purported TTB violations and show that the corresponding arguments suffer from conceptual shortcomings. We further show that once these conceptual issues are addressed appropriately, the macrorealist bound of LG inequality reaches the algebraic maximum, and hence no violation of the TTB is obtained. In particular, we demonstrate that the proposed TTB violations rely on frameworks that go beyond the standard LG framework, and therefore are of no relevance for testing the incompatibility between macrorealism and quantum theory.
items.abstract_zh: Leggett-Garg（LG）不等式被提出用于检验宏观实在论的经典世界观与量子理论之间的不相容性。类比于Bell不等式的Tsirelson界，LG不等式的最大量子违反通常被称为时间Tsirelson界（TTB）。然而，若干研究声称，与Tsirelson界不同，TTB在量子理论内可以被超越。特别地，通过在[Phys. Rev. Lett. 113, 050401 (2014)]中采用破简并测量，以及在[Phys. Rev. Lett. 135, 220202 (2025)]中使用幺正算符的叠加，有人论证TTB可以被违反。在本工作中，我们批判性地审视这些所谓TTB违反背后的推理，并表明相应论证存在概念上的缺陷。我们进一步表明，一旦适当解决这些概念问题，LG不等式的宏观实在论界达到代数最大值，因此不会获得对TTB的违反。特别地，我们证明所提出的TTB违反依赖于超出标准LG框架的框架，因此与检验宏观实在论和量子理论之间的不相容性无关。

items.title_en: Full-Duplex Communication for Pinching Antenna Systems
items.title_zh: 夹持天线系统的全双工通信
items.abstract_en: This paper investigates multiuser full-duplex (FD) communication assisted by a multiwaveguide pinching-antenna system (PASS) where each dielectric waveguide can be dynamically configured to operate in either downlink transmission or uplink reception mode. We develop a channel model that accounts for in-waveguide power attenuation and cumulative pinching antenna (PA)-induced phase shift. Building on this model, we jointly optimize the waveguide modes, PA locations, PA radiation/collection coefficients, downlink beamformers, uplink receive combiners, and uplink transmit powers to maximize the downlink weighted sum-rate (WSR) subject to uplink quality-of-service (QoS) requirements and power constraints. To tackle the resulting mixed-integer nonconvex resource allocation problem, we propose a low-complexity hierarchical block coordinate descent algorithm that capitalizes on weighted minimum mean-square error, fractional programming, majorization-minimization, and the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) to obtain a high-quality suboptimal solution. Simulations demonstrate that the proposed FD-PASS outperforms an FD base station equipped with fixed antennas and exhibits greater robustness against residual self-interference. Moreover, ignoring cumulative PA-induced phase shifts can produce QoS-infeasible designs.
items.abstract_zh: 本文研究由多波导夹持天线系统（PASS）辅助的多用户全双工（FD）通信，其中每个介质波导可动态配置为在下行传输或上行接收模式下工作。我们建立了一个信道模型，该模型考虑了波导内功率衰减和夹持天线（PA）引起的累积相移。基于该模型，我们联合优化波导模式、PA位置、PA辐射/收集系数、下行波束成形器、上行接收合并器以及上行发射功率，以在上行服务质量（QoS）要求和功率约束下最大化下行加权和速率（WSR）。为处理由此产生的混合整数非凸资源分配问题，我们提出一种低复杂度分层块坐标下降算法，利用加权最小均方误差、分式规划、优化最小化和交替方向乘子法（ADMM）来获得高质量次优解。仿真表明，所提出的FD-PASS优于配备固定天线的FD基站，并对残余自干扰表现出更强的鲁棒性。此外，忽略PA引起的累积相移可能产生QoS不可行的设计。

items.title_en: AOP-Smart-Finder: A High-Throughput Human-AI Hybrid Framework for AOP Discovery and Evidence Mapping from Large-Scale Literature
items.title_zh: AOP-Smart-Finder：一种用于从大规模文献中发现AOP并进行证据映射的高通量人机混合框架
items.abstract_en: The rapid growth of scientific literature and the high heterogeneity of biological terminology and mechanistic descriptions make it difficult for researchers to integrate scattered research evidence, identify connections among biological events, and construct mechanistic networks. Here, we developed a high-throughput human-AI hybrid framework, AOP-Smart-Finder, for biological event discovery, relationship mining, and Adverse Outcome Pathway (AOP) construction and evidence mapping from large-scale literature. This framework integrates Large Language Models (LLMs), AOP-Smart retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) technology, and Python-based automation, supporting two analysis modes: one based on a single compound and the other based on a predefined set of biological events. In the di(2-ethylhexyl) phthalate (DEHP) case, the system processed 12,983 articles within 30 min and included 1,093 of them, from which it extracted 1,589 biological events (including 458 official key events [KEs] and 1,131 candidate KEs) and 2,519 key event relationships (KERs). In the amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) case, the system identified 55 stressors from 437 articles and extracted 278 biological events and 548 event relationships. Following manual curation and Weight of Evidence (WoE) evaluation, a mechanistic network comprising 16 KEs and 23 KERs was ultimately constructed. This framework can either use existing AOPs as knowledge guidance for mechanistic expansion and evidence supplementation, or discover novel event connections and construct mechanistic networks around user-specified research topics. It provides a high-throughput, traceable, human-AI hybrid methodology for complex biological mechanism elucidation and AOP discovery driven by large-scale literature.
items.abstract_zh: 科学文献的快速增长以及生物学术语和机制描述的高度异质性，使研究人员难以整合分散的研究证据、识别生物事件之间的联系并构建机制网络。在此，我们开发了一个高通量人机混合框架AOP-Smart-Finder，用于从大规模文献中进行生物事件发现、关系挖掘以及有害结局路径（AOP）构建和证据映射。该框架整合了大语言模型（LLM）、AOP-Smart检索增强生成（RAG）技术和基于Python的自动化，支持两种分析模式：一种基于单一化合物，另一种基于预定义的生物事件集合。在邻苯二甲酸二(2-乙基己基)酯（DEHP）案例中，系统在30分钟内处理了12,983篇文章，并纳入其中1,093篇，从中提取了1,589个生物事件（包括458个官方关键事件[KE]和1,131个候选KE）和2,519个关键事件关系（KER）。在肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）案例中，系统从437篇文章中识别出55个应激源，并提取了278个生物事件和548个事件关系。经过人工审编和证据权重（WoE）评估，最终构建了一个包含16个KE和23个KER的机制网络。该框架既可以利用现有AOP作为知识引导进行机制扩展和证据补充，也可以围绕用户指定的研究主题发现新的事件联系并构建机制网络。它为大规模文献驱动的复杂生物机制阐明和AOP发现提供了一种高通量、可追溯的人机混合方法。

items.title_en: Terrain-Aware Thompson Sampling for Multi-Drone Search and Rescue
items.title_zh: 用于多无人机搜索与救援的地形感知Thompson采样
items.abstract_en: In this work, we propose a decentralized terrain-aware multi-drone Thompson Sampling algorithm tailored for search and rescue (SAR) applications. A probability distribution of locating a lost person is informed by terrain data, using established SAR models (displacement ring, elevation, watershed, dispersion angle, and track offset) derived from historical SAR case data on lost person behavior. Exploration is conducted by a team of drones using Thompson Sampling, where candidate actions are selected by drawing samples from this probability distribution, represented by a per-cell Gaussian posterior whose mean and variance are updated through Bayesian inference. This approach balances exploration of uncertain regions with exploitation of high-probability areas to locate a lost person. Observation uncertainty is incorporated through fractional forest coverage, which measures the percentage of an observation occluded by tree coverage and accounts for reduced detection performance in densely vegetated areas. Simulations using real SAR case data (YOSAR) evaluate the proposed method against a coverage planner and a probabilistic active search method in search regions of 1.5 and 3.8 square kilometers, with 5, 10, 15, and 20 agents flying at 50 km/hr. We demonstrate that our method achieves a success rate of approximately 87% within 60 to 247 seconds in the 1.5 square kilometer region, and success rates of approximately 75% to 91% within 161 to 466 seconds in the 3.8 square kilometer region, across different agent configurations.
items.abstract_zh: 在本工作中，我们提出一种面向搜索与救援（SAR）应用的去中心化地形感知多无人机Thompson采样算法。寻找失踪人员的概率分布由地形数据提供信息，使用从有关失踪人员行为的历史SAR案例数据中得出的成熟SAR模型（位移环、海拔、分水岭、扩散角和轨迹偏移）。探索由一组无人机使用Thompson采样进行，其中候选动作通过从该概率分布中抽取样本来选择，该分布由逐单元高斯后验表示，其后验均值和方差通过贝叶斯推断更新。该方法在探索不确定区域与利用高概率区域以定位失踪人员之间取得平衡。观测不确定性通过分数森林覆盖率纳入，该覆盖率衡量观测被树木覆盖遮挡的百分比，并考虑植被密集区域中检测性能的下降。使用真实SAR案例数据（YOSAR）的仿真在1.5和3.8平方公里的搜索区域中，以5、10、15和20架以50 km/hr飞行的智能体，将所提方法与覆盖规划器和概率主动搜索方法进行比较评估。我们证明，在不同智能体配置下，我们的方法在1.5平方公里区域内于60至247秒内达到约87%的成功率，在3.8平方公里区域内于161至466秒内达到约75%至91%的成功率。

items.title_en: Automated PD-L1 Tumor Proportion Scoring with Uncertainty-Guided Triage in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
items.title_zh: 非小细胞肺癌中不确定性引导分诊的自动化PD-L1肿瘤比例评分
items.abstract_en: Programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) tumor proportion score (TPS) informs immunotherapy selection in non-small cell lung cancer. Near the 1% and 50% cutoffs, the score should also indicate when closer review is warranted. We designed a three-stage framework to follow the sequence of TPS assessment. Stage 1 identifies tumor regions and excludes macrophage-rich patches. Stage 2, a dual-branch cell counting network (D2Count-Net), counts PD-L1-positive and PD-L1-negative tumor cells in these regions to calculate TPS. Stage 3, TPS-Guard, an uncertainty-guided triage mechanism, reports model uncertainty as the disagreement among independently trained models, refers the most uncertain slides, and flags scores near the 1% or 50% cutoff when model estimates disagree across that cutoff. Flags state the reason for referral or alert the pathologist to possible scoring errors on auto-reported slides. In a retrospective, single-center study, 154 whole-slide images were scored by three pathologists, and the model and each pathologist were compared in turn with the mean of the other two. On the 114 slides unseen in training, model mean absolute error (MAE) was 6.96 percentage points, within the range of the three pathologists (4.24 to 8.29), and model uncertainty correlated with absolute TPS error (Spearman rho = 0.77) and inter-pathologist disagreement (rho = 0.71). After referral of the 15% most uncertain slides, model and pathologist MAE both decreased. Applied without retraining to an external, publicly available dataset, TPS-Guard still directed review to higher-error cases, and referring more uncertain cases raised sensitivity at the 50% cutoff. TPS-Guard provides reasons for reviewing individual automated scores and identifies slides that also produce greater disagreement among pathologists. Prospective reader studies should assess TPS-Guard's effect on TPS reporting.
items.abstract_zh: 程序性死亡配体1（PD-L1）肿瘤比例评分（TPS）为非小细胞肺癌的免疫治疗选择提供信息。在1%和50%临界值附近，评分还应指示何时需要进行更仔细的复核。我们设计了一个三阶段框架，以遵循TPS评估的顺序。第1阶段识别肿瘤区域并排除富含巨噬细胞的斑块。第2阶段是双分支细胞计数网络（D2Count-Net），在这些区域中计数PD-L1阳性和PD-L1阴性肿瘤细胞以计算TPS。第3阶段是TPS-Guard，一种不确定性引导的分诊机制，将模型不确定性报告为独立训练模型之间的不一致，将最不确定的切片转交复核，并在模型估计跨越1%或50%临界值不一致时标记接近该临界值的评分。标记说明转交复核的原因，或提醒病理学家自动报告切片上可能的评分错误。在一项回顾性单中心研究中，由三名病理学家对154张全切片图像进行评分，并将模型和每位病理学家依次与另外两人的平均值进行比较。在训练中未见的114张切片上，模型平均绝对误差（MAE）为6.96个百分点，处于三名病理学家的范围（4.24至8.29）内，模型不确定性与绝对TPS误差（Spearman rho = 0.77）以及病理学家间不一致性（rho = 0.71）相关。在将最不确定的15%切片转交复核后，模型和病理学家的MAE均下降。在未经重新训练的情况下应用于外部公开数据集时，TPS-Guard仍将复核引导至误差较高的病例，并且转交复核更多不确定病例提高了50%临界值处的敏感性。TPS-Guard为复核个体自动评分提供理由，并识别出在病理学家之间也产生更大不一致的切片。前瞻性阅片研究应评估TPS-Guard对TPS报告的影响。

items.title_en: Intellectual disability risk gene RFX4 regulates cortical neurogenesis by restraining neuronal differentiation
items.title_zh: 智力障碍风险基因RFX4通过抑制神经元分化调控皮质神经发生
items.abstract_en: Despite the recent identification of RFX4 as a neurodevelopmental disorder risk gene, its role in cortical development remained unclear. Here, we derived human stem cell models of deficiency and pathogenic mutation and demonstrated that RFX4 restrains neurogenesis by repressing pro-neuronal gene expression, while maintaining lineage-specific roles in regulating proliferation during cortical inhibitory neuron development. We also defined requirements for RFX4 in recruiting RFX3 to chromatin to regulate synaptic and activity-dependent gene expression in progenitors and neurons, respectively. RFX4 deficiency persistently dysregulated neuronal differentiation in cortical organoids, while not affecting neurons generated by direct differentiation. Finally, we modeled pathogenic mutation of the RFX4 DNA-binding domain, finding that DNA binding was strongly reduced but gene expression was dysregulated differently from our deficiency models, supporting a mechanism of pathogenicity distinct from haploinsufficiency. Together, this work identified requirements for RFX4 during cortical development, building a necessary foundation for elucidating the etiology of RFX4-associated disorders.
items.abstract_zh: 尽管最近将RFX4鉴定为神经发育障碍风险基因，但其在皮质发育中的作用仍不清楚。在此，我们构建了RFX4缺陷和致病突变的人类干细胞模型，并证明RFX4通过抑制促神经元基因表达来限制神经发生，同时在皮质抑制性神经元发育过程中维持谱系特异性的增殖调控作用。我们还确定了RFX4将RFX3招募到染色质所需的条件，以分别调控祖细胞和神经元中的突触基因表达和活动依赖性基因表达。RFX4缺陷在皮质类器官中持续导致神经元分化失调，但不影响通过直接分化产生的神经元。最后，我们对RFX4 DNA结合结构域的致病突变进行了建模，发现DNA结合显著降低，但基因表达失调模式与我们的缺陷模型不同，支持一种不同于单倍剂量不足的致病机制。总之，这项工作确定了RFX4在皮质发育过程中的需求，为阐明RFX4相关疾病的病因学奠定了必要基础。

items.title_en: Quantum Material Generation via Coherent Hamiltonian Search
items.title_zh: 通过相干哈密顿量搜索的量子材料生成
items.abstract_en: Discovering new materials with targeted properties is a central goal of materials science, yet the space of candidates is vast. Data-driven generative models learn the distribution of known materials, but they extrapolate poorly, and a generated structure is not known to be stable. A material's properties follow from its Hamiltonian, and a quantum computer can calculate them from it. We introduce the quantum material generative algorithm (QMage), a coherent search, guided by the Hamiltonian, over crystalline configurations of atomic composition, unit cell structure, and atomic positions, for one whose calculated properties meet the targets to within a given error tolerance. The computation is a single coherent quantum circuit in which each configuration's Hamiltonian is block-encoded, its target eigenstate isolated and properties evaluated, and the satisfying configurations amplified by fixed-point search and measured. One framework covers many targets, from formation energy and band gaps to elasticity and conductivity. We design the algorithm for the mature fault-tolerant era and estimate its cost in logical qubits and Toffoli depth from a classically routine benchmark to targets where established methods are unreliable. The approach generates candidate materials from first principles, rather than generalizing from those known, and could enable materials discovery when the target properties are difficult to predict classically.
items.abstract_zh: 发现具有目标性质的新材料是材料科学的核心目标，然而候选材料空间巨大。数据驱动的生成模型学习已知材料的分布，但其外推能力差，并且生成的结构并不已知是稳定的。材料的性质由其哈密顿量决定，量子计算机可以据此计算这些性质。我们引入量子材料生成算法（QMage），一种在哈密顿量引导下对原子组成、晶胞结构和原子位置的晶体构型进行相干搜索的方法，以寻找计算性质在给定误差容限内满足目标的构型。该计算是一个单一相干量子电路，其中每个构型的哈密顿量被块编码，其目标本征态被隔离并评估性质，满足条件的构型通过定点搜索放大并测量。一个框架涵盖许多目标，从形成能和带隙到弹性和电导率。我们针对成熟的容错时代设计该算法，并估计其成本（以逻辑量子比特数和Toffoli深度计），从经典上常规的基准到既有方法不可靠的目标。该方法从第一性原理生成候选材料，而不是从已知材料进行泛化，并可能在目标性质难以经典预测时实现材料发现。

items.title_en: TorchCurves: Differentiable Parametric Curves
items.title_zh: TorchCurves：可微参数曲线
items.abstract_en: We present TorchCurves, a PyTorch library that treats vector-valued parametric curves as learnable primitives. Its central operation maps batches of scalar inputs to points on curves represented in B-spline or Legendre polynomial bases, with differentiation through both inputs and coefficients. Curve coefficients can be optimized jointly with the surrounding model or produced by another network. The library provides trainable modules, reusable basis modules, and a functional interface, supporting applications ranging from continuous feature embeddings to Kolmogorov-Arnold networks and functional regression. Its implementation combines classical evaluation algorithms with vectorized PyTorch operations, emphasizing readability and maintainability without custom hardware kernels. Timing experiments compare curve evaluation against NumPy and SciPy and KAN training against EfficientKAN across a range of problem sizes. The results illustrate where this generality remains computationally practical and where overhead is substantial. Library is available on GitHub at https://github.com/alexshtf/torchcurves.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 TorchCurves，一个将向量值参数曲线视为可学习原语的 PyTorch 库。其核心操作将批量标量输入映射到以 B 样条或 Legendre 多项式基表示的曲线上的点，并可对输入和系数进行微分。曲线系数可以与周围模型联合优化，或由另一个网络生成。该库提供可训练模块、可复用基模块和函数式接口，支持从连续特征嵌入到 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络和函数回归等应用。其实现将经典求值算法与向量化 PyTorch 操作相结合，强调可读性和可维护性，不使用自定义硬件内核。计时实验在一系列问题规模上比较曲线求值与 NumPy 和 SciPy，以及 KAN 训练与 EfficientKAN。结果说明了这种通用性在何处仍在计算上实用，以及在何处开销显著。库见 GitHub：https://github.com/alexshtf/torchcurves。

items.title_en: Bits or permutations? Spending a fixed inference budget on weight precision or on option-order averaging in small local language models
items.title_zh: 比特还是排列？在小型本地语言模型中，将固定推理预算用于权重精度还是选项顺序平均
items.abstract_en: Local language models can save memory by storing weights in fewer bits, and they can reduce sensitivity to the order of answer options by averaging a few reorderings. We ask whether the first makes the second worse, and which is the cheaper way to spend a fixed budget. On Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B with simulated round-to-nearest weight quantization (8, 6, 4 and 3 bits, fp16 reference), read from the logits of the letters A to D on ARC-Easy, ARC-Challenge, MMLU and HellaSwag (300 items each), 6 bits lose no accuracy against fp16 (they score +1.8 (+1.0 to +2.5) and +0.9 (+0.3 to +1.5) points higher, which we do not explain), and 8 bits change it by -0.7 (-1.1 to -0.3) and -0.4 (-0.7 to -0.2) points. At 4 bits the answer-slot skew rises from 0.15 to 0.53 (0.6B) and from 0.07 to 0.12 (1.7B); Gaussian noise at the same weight SNR gives 0.15 and 0.37 (two draws) and 0.19 (one draw), so the control is inconclusive on whether rounding adds slot skew beyond equal-power noise. Flip rates rise but stay below an accuracy-matched baseline of independent uniform errors. Averaging four cyclic orders recovers +12.6 points at 4 bits for 0.6B (+5.3 at fp16). We price bits and passes in one machine-independent unit, weight bytes read times passes. In cost-matched pairs, extra orders beat extra bits only when the weights have 6 or more bits, and the decision table reduces to: use 6-bit weights and spend the rest of the budget on up to four orders, one pass each. Everything is simulated on two small models with the simplest quantizer; a title-level search found no earlier study of quantization together with option order.
items.abstract_zh: 本地语言模型可以通过以更少比特存储权重来节省内存，并可以通过平均若干重排序来降低对答案选项顺序的敏感性。我们问前者是否使后者更差，以及在固定预算下哪种花费方式更便宜。在Qwen3-0.6B和Qwen3-1.7B上，采用模拟的最近舍入权重量化（8、6、4和3比特，fp16参考），从ARC-Easy、ARC-Challenge、MMLU和HellaSwag（各300项）上字母A到D的logits读取，6比特相对fp16没有精度损失（得分分别高+1.8（+1.0至+2.5）和+0.9（+0.3至+1.5）分，我们未对此作出解释），8比特使其变化-0.7（-1.1至-0.3）和-0.4（-0.7至-0.2）分。在4比特时，答案槽偏斜从0.15升至0.53（0.6B），从0.07升至0.12（1.7B）；在相同权重SNR下的高斯噪声给出0.15和0.37（两次抽样）以及0.19（一次抽样），因此该对照无法确定舍入是否在等功率噪声之外增加了槽偏斜。翻转率上升但仍低于精度匹配的独立均匀误差基线。对四个循环顺序取平均在4比特下为0.6B恢复+12.6分（fp16下为+5.3）。我们以一个与机器无关的单位为比特和遍数定价：读取的权重字节数乘以遍数。在成本匹配的配对中，额外顺序仅在权重为6比特或更多时优于额外比特，决策表可简化为：使用6比特权重，并将剩余预算用于最多四个顺序，每个一遍。所有内容均在两个小型模型上使用最简单的量化器进行模拟；一项标题级检索未发现先前关于量化与选项顺序结合的研究。

items.title_en: Oscillatory Processing Units as a computing substrate for biomimetic intelligence
items.title_zh: 振荡处理单元作为仿生智能的计算基底
items.abstract_en: Biological intelligence emerges from neural activity that connects sensation, memory and action. Synaptic plasticity, neuronal assemblies and oscillations provide principles for biomimetic computing, but translating them into reusable operations requires a defined computational unit. We introduce Oscillatory Processing Units (OPUs), groups of synthetic neurons sharing a rhythm. Their directed interactions transform incoming activity and prior receiving state into an Oscillatory Occupancy Space (OOS), which becomes available to subsequent computation. We show that source--receiver conditions and oscillatory organization shape these transformations, including their geometry, persistence and historical accessibility. An Atlas of measured relationships supports prospective composition with predicted response classes. Configured circuits perform logical and numerical operations, express associative recall and generate closed-loop decisions with fixed synaptic weights. OPUs and OOS establish a computing substrate for biomimetic intelligence in which experience remains part of the state through which new input becomes action.
items.abstract_zh: 生物智能源于连接感觉、记忆和行动的神经活动。突触可塑性、神经元集群和振荡为仿生计算提供了原理，但将其转化为可复用操作需要一个定义明确的计算单元。我们引入振荡处理单元（OPUs），即共享同一节律的合成神经元群组。它们的有向交互将传入活动和先前的接收状态转换为振荡占据空间（OOS），该空间可供后续计算使用。我们表明，源-接收者条件和振荡组织塑造这些转换，包括其几何结构、持续性和历史可访问性。一个测量关系图谱支持带有预测响应类别的预期组合。配置后的电路以固定的突触权重执行逻辑和数值运算、表达联想回忆并生成闭环决策。OPUs和OOS为仿生智能建立了一个计算基底，其中经验仍是状态的一部分，新输入通过该状态转化为行动。

items.title_en: Fog-FWL: A Large-Scale Full-Waveform LiDAR Dataset for Recovering Fog-Hidden Objects
items.title_zh: Fog-FWL：用于恢复雾中隐藏目标的大规模全波形激光雷达数据集
items.abstract_en: LiDAR is a core sensor for autonomous driving, yet it is highly vulnerable to fog. Fog scattering produces strong backscatter near the sensor and attenuates reflections from objects behind it, so weak object returns are often discarded by the peak detection that converts received signals into point clouds. Full-waveform LiDAR (FWL), which records the received optical signal before peak detection, retains these weak returns, but the lack of suitable data has prevented research on recovering fog-hidden objects from FWL. We present Fog-FWL, a dataset foundation for this task that consists of a real-world benchmark, Fog-FWL-Real, and a large-scale synthetic training set, Fog-FWL-Sim. Fog-FWL-Real contains 7,527 real foggy FWL frames from 8 scenes and 58 sequences, which is 579x larger than the only existing real foggy FWL data, together with histogram-level Object/Fog/Noise labels, 10,719 3D bounding boxes, and three difficulty levels defined by the attenuation of object reflections. Fog-FWL-Sim contains 12,000 frames generated by our physics-based simulator, Fog-FWL-Simulator, which integrates spatially heterogeneous fog density fields, time-resolved light transport including multiple scattering, and a photon-counting SPAD receiver model. The two subsets share the same sensor format and annotation protocol, enabling a strict sim-to-real evaluation in which no real waveforms are used for training. Our analysis shows that, under the hardest condition, object returns are included in the three strongest peaks for only 34.9% of object rays, underscoring the need for waveform-level recovery. Fog-FWL-Real, Fog-FWL-Sim, and the Fog-FWL-Simulator will be publicly released to facilitate research on fog-robust LiDAR perception.
items.abstract_zh: 激光雷达是自动驾驶的核心传感器，但极易受雾影响。雾散射会在传感器附近产生强后向散射，并衰减其后目标的反射，因此微弱的目標回波常被将接收信号转换为点云的峰值检测丢弃。全波形激光雷达（FWL）在峰值检测前记录接收到的光信号，保留了这些微弱回波，但缺乏合适数据阻碍了从FWL恢复雾中隐藏目标的研究。我们提出Fog-FWL，一个用于该任务的数据集基础，由真实世界基准Fog-FWL-Real和大规模合成训练集Fog-FWL-Sim组成。Fog-FWL-Real包含来自8个场景和58个序列的7,527个真实雾天FWL帧，是唯一现有真实雾天FWL数据的579倍，并带有直方图级的目标/雾/噪声标签、10,719个3D边界框，以及由目标反射衰减定义的三个难度等级。Fog-FWL-Sim包含由我们的基于物理的模拟器Fog-FWL-Simulator生成的12,000帧，该模拟器集成了空间非均匀雾密度场、包括多次散射的时间分辨光传输，以及光子计数SPAD接收器模型。两个子集共享相同的传感器格式和标注协议，从而能够进行严格的仿真到真实评估，其中训练不使用任何真实波形。我们的分析表明，在最困难条件下，仅有34.9%的目标光线将目标回波包含在前三个最强峰值中，这凸显了波形级恢复的必要性。Fog-FWL-Real、Fog-FWL-Sim和Fog-FWL-Simulator将公开发布，以促进雾鲁棒激光雷达感知研究。

items.title_en: AToP: An Explainability Framework for Transformer-Based EHR Predictions Using Attribution-Guided Temporal Pattern Mining
items.title_zh: AToP：一种基于归因引导时序模式挖掘的 Transformer EHR 预测可解释性框架
items.abstract_en: Objective: To develop and evaluate AToP (Attribution to Temporal Patterns), a post-hoc explainability framework that converts per-token Integrated Gradients (IG) from a Transformer into structured temporal pattern narratives. Materials and Methods: AToP was applied to a single-stream Transformer trained on MIMIC-IV v3.1 (218,196 patients; 12.6% unplanned 30-day readmission). It mines frequent episodes from salient-token subsequences in the training cohort, aggregates attribution among patients whose records contain each token or pattern, and collapses near-duplicates by patient overlap. Validation used masking, reversed-order analysis, token-level faithfulness tests, and KernelSHAP comparison. Results: The Transformer achieved AUROC 0.77 and PR-AUC 0.34. Population-weighted attribution emphasized high-prevalence codes with small per-patient impact. Carrier-conditional attribution, the mean among patients with the token, surfaced rare high-attribution psychiatric markers including psychosis, self-harm overdose, suicidal ideation (SI), and severe major depressive disorder (MDD). Pattern-level attribution identified within-visit co-occurrences and cross-visit trajectories not captured by token rankings. Risk-increasing patterns included psychiatric sequences ({MDD, SI} [->] SI) and oncologic progressions (cancer anemia [->] ascites). Obstetric and chest pain evaluation patterns were associated with lower predicted readmission. Discussion: The framework provides two complementary views of model predictions: carrier-conditional aggregation highlights rare, highly attributed clinical features, while temporal pattern analysis identifies within-visit combinations and cross-visit trajectories missed by token-level rankings. Masking and visit-order reversal provided evidence of correspondence with model behavior, but pattern attributions do not represent unique effects or establish clinical validity. Conclusion: AToP turns a Transformer's attributions into visit-anchored temporal pattern narratives, showing which events, in which order, contribute to its readmission predictions.
items.abstract_zh: 目的：开发并评估 AToP（Attribution to Temporal Patterns），一种事后可解释性框架，将 Transformer 的逐 token 积分梯度（IG）转换为结构化的时序模式叙述。材料与方法：AToP 应用于在 MIMIC-IV v3.1（218,196 名患者；12.6% 非计划 30 天再入院）上训练的单流 Transformer。它从训练队列中的显著 token 子序列中挖掘频繁片段，在记录包含每个 token 或模式的患者中聚合归因，并通过患者重叠合并近重复项。验证使用掩蔽、顺序反转分析、token 级忠实性测试和 KernelSHAP 比较。结果：Transformer 达到 AUROC 0.77 和 PR-AUC 0.34。总体加权归因强调高流行率但每位患者影响较小的编码。携带者条件归因（即包含该 token 的患者的平均值）揭示了罕见的高归因精神科标志物，包括精神病、自伤过量、自杀意念（SI）和重度抑郁症（MDD）。模式级归因识别出 token 排名未捕捉到的就诊内共现和跨就诊轨迹。增加风险的模式包括精神科序列（{MDD, SI} [->] SI）和肿瘤进展（癌症贫血 [->] 腹水）。产科和胸痛评估模式与较低的预测再入院相关。讨论：该框架提供模型预测的两种互补视图：携带者条件聚合突出罕见的、高归因临床特征，而时序模式分析识别 token 级排名遗漏的就诊内组合和跨就诊轨迹。掩蔽和就诊顺序反转提供了与模型行为对应的证据，但模式归因不代表唯一效应，也不确立临床有效性。结论：AToP 将 Transformer 的归因转换为以就诊为锚点的时序模式叙述，显示哪些事件以何种顺序对其再入院预测有贡献。

items.title_en: Single Spin Hall Conversion in the Hall Response of Magnetic-Insulator/Heavy-Metal Bilayers Identified by Odd Spin-Hall-Angle Dependence
items.title_zh: 通过奇自旋霍尔角依赖关系识别的磁性绝缘体/重金属双层霍尔响应中的单次自旋霍尔转换
items.abstract_en: The Hall response of magnetic-insulator/heavy-metal bilayers is usually ascribed to two successive spin Hall conversions and is therefore expected to be even in the spin Hall angle. Using distinct magnetic-field windows, we separate the Hall voltage of yttrium iron garnet bilayers with Ta and Pt of opposite spin Hall angle into contributions from magnetization- and magnetic-field-driven precession as well as from ordinary Hall effect. The field-driven component reverses sign between Ta and Pt, revealing a Hall response odd-in-spin-Hall-angle. The magnetization-driven component also has opposite signs for Ta and Pt, except for the thinnest heavy-metal layers. A drift-diffusion model with interface-generated spin currents describes this behavior: the field-driven component is predominantly carried by a single spin Hall conversion, and the magnetization-driven component is consistent with one as well. Other potential explanations, based on a description with a finite imaginary spin-mixing conductance rather than interface-generated spin currents, require unusually large values of this conductance, making this mechanism unlikely. Our findings advance the understanding of Hall responses in magnetic-insulator/heavy-metal bilayers toward a more general description.
items.abstract_zh: 磁性绝缘体/重金属双层的霍尔响应通常归因于两次连续的自旋霍尔转换，因此预期在自旋霍尔角上为偶函数。利用不同的磁场窗口，我们将具有相反自旋霍尔角的Ta和Pt的钇铁石榴石双层的霍尔电压分离为来自磁化和磁场驱动进动以及普通霍尔效应的贡献。场驱动分量在Ta和Pt之间符号反转，揭示出霍尔响应在自旋霍尔角上为奇函数。磁化驱动分量在Ta和Pt上也具有相反符号，但最薄的重金属层除外。一个包含界面产生自旋流的漂移-扩散模型描述了这种行为：场驱动分量主要由单次自旋霍尔转换承载，磁化驱动分量也与单次转换一致。其他潜在解释基于有限虚自旋混合电导而非界面产生自旋流的描述，需要异常大的该电导值，使该机制不太可能。我们的发现推进了对磁性绝缘体/重金属双层中霍尔响应的理解，朝向更一般的描述。

items.title_en: Metal Sandbox: Isolated Execution and Command Scheduling for GPU Coding Agents on Apple Silicon
items.title_zh: Metal Sandbox：面向Apple Silicon上GPU编码智能体的隔离执行与命令调度
items.abstract_en: On-device inference requires kernels that make effective use of local accelerators. Efficient training and evaluation of models that generate Apple Metal kernels benefit from native macOS tools and concurrent agent sessions. These sessions alternate between model requests, development commands, and GPU execution, leaving GPU capacity idle for much of a rollout. We present Metal Sandbox, infrastructure that combines restricted per-instance file access, native command execution, and command-level scheduling across interconnected Macs. Each agent retains its workspace and private development environment. Parallel commands can run concurrently, while serial commands share one execution slot per node; eligible waiting commands can migrate to available Macs and return results to the original agent. Integration with Harbor supports task execution, automatic verification, and rollout collection through a common workflow. Controlled experiments on four Mac mini M4 nodes achieve $1.68\times$--$2.05\times$ gains in command throughput under concentrated demand. Sixteen static agent traces give an estimated $2.14\times$ sustained-throughput gain for four sessions per node versus one, assuming continuously replenished sessions and unchanged mean durations. Replaying these measured traces under dynamic scheduling reduces mean tool waiting by 18.8% and batch elapsed time by 22.3%, assuming unchanged phase durations. Metal Sandbox and its Harbor integration are open-source on GitHub.
items.abstract_zh: 端侧推理需要能有效利用本地加速器的内核。高效训练和评估生成Apple Metal内核的模型受益于原生macOS工具和并发智能体会话。这些会话在模型请求、开发命令和GPU执行之间交替，在rollout的大部分时间里使GPU容量空闲。我们提出Metal Sandbox，一种基础设施，结合了受限的按实例文件访问、原生命令执行以及跨互连Mac的命令级调度。每个智能体保留其工作区和私有开发环境。并行命令可以并发运行，而串行命令每个节点共享一个执行槽；符合条件的等待命令可以迁移到可用Mac并将结果返回给原始智能体。与Harbor的集成通过通用工作流支持任务执行、自动验证和rollout收集。在四个Mac mini M4节点上的受控实验在集中需求下实现$1.68\times$--$2.05\times$的命令吞吐量提升。十六条静态智能体轨迹估计，在假设会话持续补充且平均持续时间不变的情况下，每个节点四个会话相比一个会话可获得$2.14\times$的持续吞吐量增益。在假设阶段持续时间不变的情况下，在动态调度下重放这些测量轨迹将平均工具等待时间减少18.8%，批处理耗时减少22.3%。Metal Sandbox及其Harbor集成在GitHub上开源。

items.title_en: PolyRoute: A Twelve-Language and Code-Mixed Benchmark for Typed-Decision Routing, with Baselines and a Leaderboard
items.title_zh: PolyRoute：一个面向类型化决策路由的十二语言与代码混合基准，附带基线和排行榜
items.abstract_en: Typed-decision encoders answer a question about a text in one forward pass, but their behaviour outside English is rarely measured on a fixed yardstick. We release PolyRoute: 322 native-language support messages in 12 languages and 9 writing systems, 156 code-mixed or romanised messages (Hinglish, Spanglish, Arabizi), 967 optional native training rows, and a protocol for a three-way department-routing decision. Labels come from Qwen3.8-27B with a blind second pass (91% of candidates kept); an independent model, gemma4-31b, agrees on 97.2% of test items, and the largest character 5-gram similarity between any test text and any training text is 0.33. A leaderboard of 13 systems gives 61.2% for the English-root checkpoint, 77.3% for the shipped multilingual one and 96.6% for the best fine-tune; TF-IDF with logistic regression reaches 91.9%. On four withheld languages the three multilingual systems score 77%, 90% and 93%. On code-mixed text the English root (85%) is nominally ahead of the shipped multilingual checkpoint (79%; p=0.134). The split resolves differences only above about 4 points. All texts and labels are LLM-generated.
items.abstract_zh: 类型化决策编码器通过一次前向传播回答关于文本的问题，但其在英语之外的行为很少在固定标尺上被测量。我们发布 PolyRoute：12 种语言和 9 种书写系统中的 322 条母语支持消息，156 条代码混合或罗马化消息（Hinglish、Spanglish、Arabizi），967 条可选母语训练行，以及一个三路部门路由决策的协议。标签来自 Qwen3.8-27B 并带盲第二遍（保留 91% 的候选）；独立模型 gemma4-31b 在 97.2% 的测试项上一致，任意测试文本与任意训练文本之间的最大字符 5-gram 相似度为 0.33。13 个系统的排行榜给出：英语根检查点为 61.2%，发布的多语言检查点为 77.3%，最佳微调为 96.6%；TF-IDF 加逻辑回归达到 91.9%。在四种留出语言上，三个多语言系统分别得 77%、90% 和 93%。在代码混合文本上，英语根（85%）名义上领先于发布的多语言检查点（79%；p=0.134）。该划分只能分辨约 4 个百分点以上的差异。所有文本和标签均由 LLM 生成。

items.title_en: Fastener-centric acquisition and AND/OR graph representation of state-dependent disassembly knowledge from CAD-derived virtual assemblies
items.title_zh: 以紧固件为中心从CAD导出的虚拟装配体获取状态相关拆卸知识及与/或图表示
items.abstract_en: Design-stage disassemblability assessment requires knowledge of product structure and the operations available in each assembly state, but CAD assemblies do not directly specify state-dependent disassembly operations. This paper proposes a fastener-centric virtual-disassembly framework that acquires such knowledge from CAD-derived virtual assemblies. Fasteners jointly releasing the same constraint are grouped into operation-level sets, avoiding enumeration of arbitrary individual-fastener orders. Their removability is evaluated through state-dependent visibility and tool-access checks and torque-driven virtual-removal trials. After fastener removal, graph-based reasoning identifies candidate moving units, whose separation is evaluated by initial-motion screening, path generation, and physics-based validation. The acquired operations, states, dependencies, validated paths, and simulation-derived attributes are organized into a Transformed AND/OR Graph for subsequent planning and design evaluation. Exhaustive verification with a controlled toy assembly found no branching violations for introduced tool-accessibility and precedence conditions. Evaluation with a 54-component OpenManipulator Chain gripper demonstrated state-dependent fastener-removal and part- or subassembly-separation operations. Visibility and tool-accessibility evaluations pruned 51.4% of fastener-set candidate evaluations, while removal of obstructing components enabled previously inaccessible fastener operations. Operation-level grouping and screening thereby limited detailed physical validation to mechanically plausible candidates. The results demonstrate the feasibility of acquiring product-specific disassembly knowledge from CAD-derived virtual assemblies before manufacture, supporting subsequent disassembly reasoning and design-for-disassembly evaluation.
items.abstract_zh: 设计阶段的可拆卸性评估需要了解产品结构以及每个装配状态下可用的操作，但CAD装配体不直接指定状态相关拆卸操作。本文提出一个以紧固件为中心的虚拟拆卸框架，从CAD导出的虚拟装配体中获取此类知识。共同释放同一约束的紧固件被分组为操作级集合，避免枚举任意单个紧固件顺序。其可拆卸性通过状态相关可见性和工具可达性检查以及扭矩驱动的虚拟拆卸试验来评估。紧固件移除后，基于图的推理识别候选运动单元，其分离通过初始运动筛选、路径生成和基于物理的验证来评估。所获取的操作、状态、依赖关系、经验证的路径以及仿真导出的属性被组织成变换后的与/或图（Transformed AND/OR Graph），用于后续规划与设计评估。对受控玩具装配体进行穷举验证，未发现针对所引入工具可达性和优先顺序条件的分支违例。使用54个组件的OpenManipulator Chain夹爪进行评估，展示了状态相关的紧固件移除以及零件或子装配体分离操作。可见性和工具可达性评估剪除了51.4%的紧固件集合候选评估，而移除阻碍组件使先前不可达的紧固件操作成为可能。因此，操作级分组和筛选将详细物理验证限制在机械上合理的候选上。结果表明，在制造之前从CAD导出的虚拟装配体中获取产品特定拆卸知识是可行的，可支持后续拆卸推理和面向拆卸的设计评估。

items.title_en: Prompt2Echo (P2Echo): Text-Prompted Multi-View Echocardiography Segmentation with One Model
items.title_zh: Prompt2Echo（P2Echo）：基于文本提示的单模型多视图超声心动图分割
items.abstract_en: Automated segmentation in multi-view echocardiography is essential for comprehensive cardiac assessment, yet remains challenging due to substantial anatomical and appearance variability across standard acoustic windows. In this paper, we present P2Echo, a unified framework capable of segmenting diverse cardiac structures across multiple standard echocardiographic views using a single model controlled by structured view-aware text prompts. Unlike recent foundation model adaptations that rely on implicit latent priors, P2Echo explicitly conditions the segmentation process via a novel Dynamic Image-Text Alignment (DyITA) module. DyITA integrates a differentiable routing mechanism and token differential operators to dynamically modulate decoder features according to the requested view and target structure. This allows the network to adaptively switch its processing pathways for different views without architectural changes. Extensive experiments on a large-scale internal dataset (seen during training) and held-out evaluation on three external datasets demonstrate that P2Echo matches or exceeds both view-specific specialists and state-of-the-art universal models at a fraction of their computational cost, offering an efficient, controllable solution for multi-plane cardiac analysis. Code is available at: https://github.com/moeinheidari7829/P2Echo.
items.abstract_zh: 多视图超声心动图自动分割对于全面心脏评估至关重要，但由于标准声窗之间存在显著的解剖结构和外观差异，仍具有挑战性。本文提出 P2Echo，一个统一框架，能够使用由结构化视图感知文本提示控制的单一模型，在多个标准超声心动图视图中分割多种心脏结构。与近期依赖隐式潜在先验的基础模型适配不同，P2Echo 通过新颖的动态图像-文本对齐（DyITA）模块显式地以条件控制分割过程。DyITA 集成可微路由机制和 token 差分算子，根据请求的视图和目标结构动态调制解码器特征。这使得网络无需改变架构即可针对不同视图自适应切换其处理通路。在大规模内部数据集（训练中可见）上的广泛实验，以及在三个外部数据集上的留出评估表明，P2Echo 以一小部分计算成本达到或超过视图专用专家模型和最先进通用模型，为多平面心脏分析提供高效、可控的解决方案。代码见：https://github.com/moeinheidari7829/P2Echo。

items.title_en: Bulk transcriptomic subtypes in high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma (HGSC) are readouts of tumor cellular composition
items.title_zh: 高级别浆液性卵巢癌（HGSC）的批量转录组亚型是肿瘤细胞组成的读出
items.abstract_en: High-grade serous ovarian carcinoma (HGSC) is classified into four transcriptomic subtypes that are reproducible across cohorts but have not informed treatment. These subtypes are associated with stromal and immune content, yet they are assigned from bulk expression, from which composition is also estimated. We tested whether composition alone determines subtype. In tumors constructed from single cells with epithelial cells held constant, varying a single cell type within the range observed in primary tumors reassigned the subtype, and known composition distinguished all four subtypes. Varying epithelial cell identity at fixed composition displaced tumors approximately half as far in expression space. Across 2,161 primary tumors from ten cohorts, composition structured the leading axes of expression and predicted subtype in held-out cohorts (ROC-AUC 0.817 to 0.963). The consequence is prognostic. Adjustment for composition largely attenuated subtype associations with survival, whereas fibroblast content remained prognostic. Subtype-associated biology and prognosis therefore largely reflect the tumor microenvironment.
items.abstract_zh: 高级别浆液性卵巢癌（HGSC）被分为四种转录组亚型，这些亚型在不同队列中可重复，但尚未指导治疗。这些亚型与基质和免疫内容相关，然而它们是由批量表达分配的，而组成也是从批量表达估计的。我们检验了仅组成是否决定亚型。在由单细胞构建、上皮细胞保持恒定的肿瘤中，在原发肿瘤观察范围内改变单一细胞类型会重新分配亚型，而已知组成可区分所有四种亚型。在固定组成下改变上皮细胞身份，使肿瘤在表达空间中的位移约为一半。在来自十个队列的2,161例原发肿瘤中，组成构建了表达的主轴，并在留出队列中预测亚型（ROC-AUC 0.817至0.963）。其后果具有预后意义。对组成进行调整在很大程度上减弱了亚型与生存的关联，而成纤维细胞含量仍具有预后意义。因此，亚型相关生物学和预后在很大程度上反映了肿瘤微环境。

items.title_en: High-Speed Control of a Fluxonium Qubit via Picosecond Pulses from Josephson Digital Circuits
items.title_zh: 通过约瑟夫森数字电路产生的皮秒脉冲对Fluxonium量子比特进行高速控制
items.abstract_en: We develop a control strategy for fluxonium qubits based on picosecond single-flux-quantum (SFQ) pulses generated by Josephson digital circuits. A major challenge is that SFQ protocols originally designed for transmon control become inefficient for low-frequency fluxonium. In this regime, the asymmetry of flux and charge couplings leads either to excessive leakage or excessively long gate times. We show that this limitation can be overcome by two complementary protocols. The first protocol employs high-frequency SFQ pulse packets applied through the flux channel, offering a simple, analytically transparent, and robust approach for high-fidelity single-qubit control. The second protocol combines phase-shifted flux and charge pulse sequences to enhance the resonant drive and reduce the gate duration. Multilevel simulations demonstrate single-qubit gate fidelities above $99.99\%$; the simpler protocol remains robust under moderate variations of qubit parameters and flux bias, while the combined protocol preserves high fidelity while substantially accelerating the gate. These results establish SFQ-based cryogenic control as a realistic route to fast, accurate, and scalable manipulation of fluxonium qubits.
items.abstract_zh: 我们开发了一种基于约瑟夫森数字电路产生的皮秒单磁通量子（SFQ）脉冲的fluxonium量子比特控制策略。主要挑战在于，最初为transmon控制设计的SFQ协议对低频fluxonium变得低效。在此区间，磁通和电荷耦合的不对称性导致要么过度泄漏，要么门时间过长。我们表明，这一限制可通过两种互补协议克服。第一种协议采用通过磁通通道施加的高频SFQ脉冲包，为高保真单量子比特控制提供简单、解析透明且稳健的方法。第二种协议结合相移的磁通和电荷脉冲序列，以增强共振驱动并缩短门持续时间。多能级模拟表明单量子比特门保真度高于$99.99\%$；较简单的协议在量子比特参数和磁通偏置的适度变化下保持稳健，而组合协议在保持高保真的同时显著加速门。这些结果确立了基于SFQ的低温控制作为快速、准确且可扩展地操控fluxonium量子比特的现实途径。

items.title_en: Linear Regression with Self-Selection Bias in Polynomial Time
items.title_zh: 多项式时间内的自选择偏差线性回归
items.abstract_en: We revisit the problem of estimating $k$ linear regressors with self-selection bias in $n$ dimensions up to error $\varepsilon$ with the maximum self-selection criterion, as introduced by Cherapanamjeri, Daskalakis, Ilyas, and Zampetakis [CDIZ23, STOC]. Our main result is a $\mathrm{poly}(n,k,1/\varepsilon)$ time algorithm for the unknown-index variant of this problem, thereby improving upon the running times of the best known algorithms due to Gaitonde and Mossel [GM24] and Kalavasis, Mehrotra, and Zhou [KMZ26, COLT] with exponential dependence on $k$. Our algorithm succeeds in the presence of correlated noise between regressors, which captures the related setting of max-affine regression. Consequently, we also give the first polynomial-time algorithm for this problem, improving on the prior works of Ghosh, Pananjady, Guntuboyina, and Ramchandran [GPGR22, IEEE Transactions on Information Theory] and Gaitonde and Mossel [GM24] with exponential dependence on $k$. Prior works exhaustively search over a $k$-dimensional subspace spanned by the regressors, using conditional moments of the response to test candidates. In contrast, our algorithm is driven by an improved understanding of the moments of the covariates. We show that, restricting to observations with large response values, the degree-$(\log n)$ Hermite moment of the covariates approximately decomposes as a sum of tensor powers of the regressors. The first step of our algorithm can be viewed as a tensor decomposition algorithm for these implicitly represented high-order tensors, which outputs unit vectors parallel to the regressors. A secondary step based on a simple variant of ordinary least squares extracts estimates for the regressors given these unit vectors. We believe our analytic insight and algorithmic components may have applications to designing efficient algorithms for other latent-variable problems.
items.abstract_zh: 我们重新审视Cherapanamjeri、Daskalakis、Ilyas和Zampetakis [CDIZ23, STOC]提出的问题：在$n$维中以最大自选择准则估计$k$个具有自选择偏差的线性回归器，误差至多$\varepsilon$。我们的主要结果是该问题未知索引变体的$\mathrm{poly}(n,k,1/\varepsilon)$时间算法，从而改进了Gaitonde和Mossel [GM24]以及Kalavasis、Mehrotra和Zhou [KMZ26, COLT]给出的对$k$呈指数依赖的最佳已知算法的运行时间。我们的算法在回归器之间存在相关噪声时成功，这涵盖了max-affine回归的相关设定。因此，我们还给出了该问题的首个多项式时间算法，改进了Ghosh、Pananjady、Guntuboyina和Ramachandran [GPGR22, IEEE Transactions on Information Theory]以及Gaitonde和Mossel [GM24]对$k$呈指数依赖的先前工作。先前工作穷举搜索由回归器张成的$k$维子空间，使用响应的条件矩来测试候选。相比之下，我们的算法由对协变量矩的改进理解驱动。我们表明，限制在具有大响应值的观测上，协变量的度$(\log n)$ Hermite矩近似分解为回归器的张量幂之和。我们算法的第一步可以视为针对这些隐式表示的高阶张量的张量分解算法，其输出平行于回归器的单位向量。基于普通最小二乘的简单变体的第二步在给定这些单位向量时提取回归器的估计。我们相信我们的分析见解和算法组件可能应用于为其他潜变量问题设计高效算法。

items.title_en: From Large Language Models to Efficient System One Models via Adaptive Computation
items.title_zh: 通过自适应计算从大型语言模型到高效System One模型
items.abstract_en: Transferring LLMs into System One decision models typically replaces the language modeling head with a decision head while retaining the full backbone, making every decision pay for all layers. Yet it remains unclear how much depth such decisions require. We find that decision information is concentrated in intermediate layers, with early layers building essential features and the final six layers removable without loss, while independently trained smaller models largely mimic the full model rather than developing specialized decision capabilities. These findings suggest that efficiency requires not simply smaller backbones, but shared computation across different depths. Building on this, we propose \method{}, which jointly trains a full model with prefix sub-models that share its final layers and decision head through self-distillation. A lightweight gate reads the hidden state at each exit to determine whether additional computation is needed, allowing one model to operate at multiple layers. Across seven decision benchmarks, our approach matches or outperforms independently trained models at every depth, while achieving better accuracy-efficiency trade-offs through adaptive computation.
items.abstract_zh: 将LLM迁移为System One决策模型通常用决策头替换语言建模头，同时保留完整骨干，使每个决策都需为所有层付出代价。然而，此类决策需要多少深度仍不清楚。我们发现决策信息集中在中间层，早期层构建必要特征，最后六层可以在无损失的情况下移除，而独立训练的较小模型很大程度上模仿完整模型，而不是发展出专门的决策能力。这些发现表明，效率不仅需要更小的骨干，还需要跨不同深度共享计算。在此基础上，我们提出\method{}，它通过自蒸馏联合训练一个完整模型与其共享最终层和决策头的前缀子模型。一个轻量级门控读取每个出口处的隐藏状态，以确定是否需要额外计算，使一个模型能够在多个层上运行。在七个决策基准上，我们的方法在每个深度上匹配或超过独立训练的模型，同时通过自适应计算实现更好的精度-效率权衡。

items.title_en: RaMOD: Moving-Object Detection from Raw mmWave Radar Cubes under Ego Motion
items.title_zh: RaMOD：自运动下基于原始毫米波雷达立方体的运动目标检测
items.abstract_en: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar provides weather-robust sensing and direct Doppler measurements, yet automotive perception pipelines often reduce its output to sparse point clouds or two-dimensional projections, leaving raw range-azimuth-Doppler (RAD) cubes underutilized. Ego motion induces Doppler responses from world-static structures, while Doppler wrapping aliases radial velocities, complicating moving-object detection and velocity estimation. We present RaMOD (Radar-based Moving-Object Detection), a real-time framework for moving-object detection and velocity estimation from raw RAD cubes acquired by a vehicle-mounted single-chip radar. RaMOD explicitly estimates frame-wise ego motion and uses the estimated radar translational velocity to predict the Doppler region of world-static structures and suppress returns within it. It temporally encodes the suppressed cubes into multi-scale features to predict RAD-space boxes with class labels. For each detected object, it predicts radial and forward velocities under raw-Doppler and Doppler-unwrapped hypotheses, together with Doppler-wrapping probabilities. On our BRIDGE-Liv dataset, RaMOD outperforms all compared raw-radar methods across RAD-cube, RA, and RD detection settings, achieving 80.8% cube mAP at IoU 0.30, 15.7 percentage points above the strongest RAD-cube baseline. Velocity MAE is 1.128 m/s, with 99.87% Doppler-wrapping accuracy.
items.abstract_zh: 毫米波（mmWave）雷达提供耐天气的传感和直接多普勒测量，然而汽车感知流水线常将其输出简化为稀疏点云或二维投影，使原始距离–方位–多普勒（RAD）立方体未得到充分利用。自运动引起来自世界静态结构的多普勒响应，而多普勒卷绕会使径向速度发生混叠，从而使运动目标检测和速度估计复杂化。我们提出RaMOD（基于雷达的运动目标检测），一个从车载单芯片雷达获取的原始RAD立方体中进行运动目标检测和速度估计的实时框架。RaMOD显式估计逐帧自运动，并使用估计的雷达平移速度预测世界静态结构的多普勒区域，并抑制该区域内的回波。它将抑制后的立方体按时间编码为多尺度特征，以预测带有类别标签的RAD空间框。对于每个检测到的目标，它在原始多普勒和多普勒解卷绕假设下预测径向速度和前向速度，并给出多普勒卷绕概率。在我们的BRIDGE-Liv数据集上，RaMOD在RAD立方体、RA和RD检测设置下均优于所有比较的原始雷达方法，在IoU 0.30时达到80.8%的立方体mAP，比最强的RAD立方体基线高15.7个百分点。速度MAE为1.128 m/s，多普勒卷绕准确率为99.87%。

items.title_en: TTB: Test-time Baking for Efficient Rendering of Decoder-only View Synthesis Models
items.title_zh: TTB：面向仅解码器视图合成模型高效渲染的测试时烘焙
items.abstract_en: Decoder-only Large View Synthesis Models (LVSMs) with KV-cache have recently achieved state-of-the-art quality by regressing novel views from neural networks without reconstructing 3D geometry, while Test-Time Training (TTT) layers save computation but sacrifice quality. We propose Test-Time Baking (TTB), a strategy that learns to bake global scene information from cross-view attention into a lightweight MLP, enabling fast and high-fidelity novel-view decoding. The first key is to repurpose the fast-weight MLP of TTT to learn the cross-view attention mapping explicitly from its input-output pairs, rather than replacing attention entirely, achieving the same rendering efficiency as TTT while delivering substantially higher quality. The second key addresses a modality misalignment between context prefilling and novel-view rendering: we disentangle context tokens into camera-only context rendering tokens to serve as TTB input, and context ground-truth tokens with image content to serve as the TTB mapping target, ensuring the baked MLPs are relieved of the modality generalization challenge between context and novel-view processing. Our method achieves up to **23x** rendering speedup with quality on par with the state-of-the-art across several benchmarks. Project page: https://test-time-baking.github.io
items.abstract_zh: 带有KV-cache的仅解码器大型视图合成模型（LVSMs）最近通过从神经网络回归新视图而不重建3D几何，达到了最先进的质量，而测试时训练（TTT）层节省计算但牺牲质量。我们提出测试时烘焙（TTB），一种学习将来自跨视图注意力的全局场景信息烘焙到轻量级MLP中的策略，从而实现快速且高保真的新视图解码。第一个关键点是重新利用TTT的快速权重MLP，从其输入-输出对中显式学习跨视图注意力映射，而不是完全替换注意力，实现与TTT相同的渲染效率，同时提供显著更高的质量。第二个关键点解决上下文预填充与新视图渲染之间的模态错位：我们将上下文token解耦为仅相机上下文渲染token以作为TTB输入，以及带有图像内容的上下文真值token以作为TTB映射目标，确保烘焙后的MLP免于上下文与新视图处理之间的模态泛化挑战。我们的方法在多个基准上实现高达**23倍**的渲染加速，质量与最先进方法相当。项目页面：https://test-time-baking.github.io

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为视觉与成像，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 方法、实验条件与结论以原文为准；推荐分不等于已复现或同行评审认证。

items.title_en: Human and Machine Annotations Predict Brain Responses to Naturalistic Movies Across Development
items.title_zh: 人类与机器标注预测发育过程中对自然主义电影的大脑反应
items.abstract_en: Naturalistic movie watching provides a powerful framework for studying dynamic brain function, but linking movie content to neural responses typically relies on labor-intensive human annotation. We investigated whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can provide scalable socio-affective and semantic annotations for naturalistic fMRI. We compared MLLM-generated theory-of-mind (ToM) and valence ratings with human ratings and with regional BOLD responses across three animated movies. For two of these movies, we combined machine-derived visual features, natural-language scene descriptions, and socio-affective ratings in an ROI-wise encoding model of fMRI data from 66 participants aged 5--22 years. MLLM ratings partially tracked human judgments, but their neural correspondence differed by construct and model: ToM showed the most consistent human--machine overlap in visual cortex, whereas valence correspondence was largely movie dependent. In the encoding model, visual features yielded the strongest and most widespread prediction, whereas scene descriptions were more spatially selective, concentrated in dorsal-attention and visual regions and extending into right lateral temporal cortex. Age-group comparisons suggested feature-specific developmental differences: scene-description encoding in dorsal-attention cortex was higher in the oldest group, whereas visual-feature encoding in salience/ventral-attention, limbic, and control networks peaked in the middle group. Together, these findings indicate that MLLM-generated annotations capture meaningful aspects of human judgments and neural responses, supporting MLLMs as a scalable complement to, rather than a replacement for, human annotation in naturalistic neuroimaging.
items.abstract_zh: 自然主义观影为研究动态脑功能提供了强大框架，但将电影内容与神经反应关联通常依赖劳动密集的人工标注。我们研究多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）能否为自然主义 fMRI 提供可扩展的社会—情感与语义标注。我们在三部动画电影中比较了 MLLM 生成的心理理论（ToM）与效价评分同人类评分以及区域 BOLD 反应的关系。对于其中两部电影，我们将机器导出的视觉特征、自然语言场景描述和社会—情感评分结合到 ROI 级编码模型中，使用 66 名 5–22 岁参与者的 fMRI 数据。MLLM 评分部分跟随人类判断，但其神经对应关系因构念和模型而异：ToM 在视觉皮层表现出最一致的人—机重叠，而效价对应在很大程度上依赖电影。在编码模型中，视觉特征产生最强且最广泛的预测，而场景描述在空间上更具选择性，集中于背侧注意和视觉区域，并延伸至右侧外侧颞叶皮层。年龄组比较提示特征特异性的发育差异：背侧注意皮层中的场景描述编码在最大年龄组更高，而显著性/腹侧注意、边缘和控制网络中的视觉特征编码在中间组达到峰值。总之，这些发现表明 MLLM 生成的标注捕捉了人类判断和神经反应中有意义的方面，支持 MLLMs 作为自然主义神经影像中人工标注的可扩展补充而非替代。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: Quantum-Enhanced QSAR for DYRK1A: Evaluating Complementary and Utility QPU-Derived Molecular Representations
items.title_zh: 面向 DYRK1A 的量子增强 QSAR：评估 QPU 衍生分子表示的互补性与效用
items.abstract_en: In drug discovery, hit identification selects a limited set of compounds for experimental evaluation from a larger collection of candidates. Because laboratory screening capacity is limited, that choice determines which chemical series continue into further investigation. A hit that is not assayed does not enter confirmation or the analog series, and that chemical series is not opened. For the DYRK1A kinase, the same test molecules were scored from a tabular representation of molecular descriptors and from a vector measured on a quantum processor, with the same RBF-SVM. The question is whether the two models propose the same set for experimental evaluation: they propose different compounds. The model on the vector measured on the quantum processor includes compounds that the tabular representation leaves out, and among them are already-labeled actives. The tabular representation includes actives that the vector measured on the quantum processor leaves out. What is reported is that set: who enters, with what label, and whether published chemistry already mentions it. No formal quantum advantage is claimed, nor a mechanism for why the two vectors separate differently. Those compounds fall within the neighborhood that both representations already cover; what changes is which model marks them active. From that follows the cost of predictive disagreement: each model would send a different chemical series to experimental evaluation.
items.abstract_zh: 在药物发现中，命中识别从更大的候选集合中选出有限的化合物用于实验评估。由于实验室筛选能力有限，这一选择决定了哪些化学系列继续进入进一步研究。未被测定的命中不会进入确认或类似物系列，该化学系列也就不会被打开。对于 DYRK1A 激酶，相同的测试分子分别由分子描述符的表格表示和由在量子处理器上测量的向量进行评分，使用相同的 RBF-SVM。问题是两个模型是否提出相同的集合用于实验评估：它们提出的化合物不同。基于量子处理器测量向量的模型包含表格表示遗漏的化合物，其中已有带标签的活性化合物。表格表示包含量子处理器测量向量遗漏的活性化合物。所报告的是该集合：谁进入、以什么标签进入，以及已发表化学是否已经提及它。不声称形式化的量子优势，也不解释两个向量为何以不同方式分离的机制。那些化合物落在两种表示都已覆盖的邻域内；变化的是哪个模型将它们标记为活性。由此产生预测分歧的代价：每个模型会将不同的化学系列送入实验评估。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生物建模与实验，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 区分计算预测、回顾性分析与实验验证；不把模型输出作为临床结论，数据和权重许可需单独核对。

items.title_en: CoReMem: Cost-Internalizing Memory for Successive Coding Tasks with Prospective Valuation
items.title_zh: CoReMem：用于连续编码任务的成本内化记忆与前瞻性估值
items.abstract_en: Coding agents tackle successive tasks on an evolving repository, carrying forward edits and writing memory before the next task is known. Selecting memory for unknown next tasks requires balancing future usefulness against the costs of writing and reading it. The actor must also decide when acting on available memory saves effort as the task unfolds. We introduce Coding-Repository Memory (CoReMem), a cost-internalizing framework that guides memory design and actor adaptation through measured memory value on the next task. Prospective segment valuation compares runs of the next task with and without individual trajectory segments from the same inherited repository state, guiding a compact memory built around anchors: repository locations and executable checks. Actor adaptation estimates on-policy memory value within rollout groups with and without memory, using a reward that prioritizes resolution and penalizes step count in successful runs. Provenance-gated value credit assigns the additional value term to steps identified as using memory-supplied anchors, while every step retains outcome credit. On ChainSWE, CoReMem raises the 27B actor's resolve rate from 21.0% to 25.7%, with 17% fewer steps and 11% fewer total cache-aware tokens, including memory-module calls, relative to the untrained actor model without memory.
items.abstract_zh: 编码智能体在不断演化的代码仓库上处理连续任务，在下一任务已知之前就延续编辑并写入记忆。为未知的下一任务选择记忆，需要在未来有用性与写入和读取它的成本之间进行权衡。行动者还必须判断：随着任务展开，何时依据可用记忆采取行动能节省工作量。我们提出 Coding-Repository Memory（CoReMem），这是一个成本内化框架，通过测量下一任务上的记忆价值来指导记忆设计和行动者适配。前瞻性片段估值在相同的继承仓库状态下，比较下一任务在有和没有单个轨迹片段时的运行结果，指导构建以锚点为中心的紧凑记忆：仓库位置和可执行检查。行动者适配在带记忆和不带记忆的 rollout 组内估计 on-policy 记忆价值，所用奖励优先考虑解决，并在成功运行中惩罚步数。来源门控的价值信用将额外价值项分配给被识别为使用记忆提供的锚点的步骤，而每个步骤保留结果信用。在 ChainSWE 上，相对于不带记忆的未训练行动者模型，CoReMem 将 27B 行动者的解决率从 21.0% 提高到 25.7%，步数减少 17%，总缓存感知 token 数减少 11%（包括记忆模块调用）。

items.title_en: AutoVLA-D: Learn a Trajectory-Geometric Condition from Reasoning for Autonomous Driving VLA
items.title_zh: AutoVLA-D：为自动驾驶 VLA 从推理中学习轨迹几何条件
items.abstract_en: Autoregressive VLA planning usually predicts continuous trajectories as the final output, but driving instructions often describe actions rather than ego states, which weakens direct conditioning on the final continuous trajectory. We address this gap with TrajCond, which introduces a discrete trajectory-geometric condition for VLA planning. Specifically, we represent TrajCond as a 1D-Brohan differential action trajectory and learn it with a two-stage training framework before final continuous trajectory prediction. With the simultaneous autoregressive generation of discrete and numeric trajectories, we name our method AutoVLA-D (Double). Experiments on NAVSIM navtest, nuScenes, and NeuroNCAP show that discrete trajectories are weaker as direct outputs but more effective as TrajCond, consistently improving final continuous trajectory prediction across closed-loop and open-loop driving benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/ShivaTeam/AutoVLA-D.
items.abstract_zh: 自回归 VLA 规划通常将连续轨迹作为最终输出进行预测，但驾驶指令往往描述动作而非自车状态，这削弱了对最终连续轨迹的直接条件化。我们用 TrajCond 弥补这一缺口，它为 VLA 规划引入离散的轨迹几何条件。具体而言，我们将 TrajCond 表示为 1D-Brohan 微分动作轨迹，并在最终连续轨迹预测之前用两阶段训练框架学习它。由于同时自回归生成离散轨迹和数值轨迹，我们将方法命名为 AutoVLA-D（Double）。在 NAVSIM navtest、nuScenes 和 NeuroNCAP 上的实验表明，离散轨迹作为直接输出较弱，但作为 TrajCond 更有效，在闭环和开环驾驶基准上持续改善最终连续轨迹预测。代码见 https://github.com/ShivaTeam/AutoVLA-D。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对模型规模、上下文与任务难度；基准成绩不等同开放场景可靠性，代码和权重许可需分别检查。
